oioi555/claude-code-mods:plugins/cache-k.name: cache-keeper
oioi555/claude-code-mods:plugins/cache-k.description: Context, quota and prompt-cache meters above the prompt; while the session is idle on a 1-hour cache, keeps it alive and compacts before it lapses, holding off system sleep meanwhile (Linux, Windows, macOS).

sameerthapax/know-your-claude:brain-bar.name: brain-bar
sameerthapax/know-your-claude:brain-bar.description: A human-knowledge health bar that drains as Claude edits your code and refills when you pass a quiz about your own project.

betoescobar46/pituto:plugins/grid-tables.name: grid-tables
betoescobar46/pituto:plugins/grid-tables.description: Markdown tables drawn as a grid that fits the terminal width, instead of collapsing into a vertical list.

betoescobar46/pituto:plugins/inline-repl.name: inline-replies
betoescobar46/pituto:plugins/inline-repl.description: Answer Claude's questions and quote its paragraphs with a click: numbered questions with clickable options, a ❝ on every paragraph, and the full context sent along with your message.

betoescobar46/pituto:plugins/message-tim.name: message-times
betoescobar46/pituto:plugins/message-tim.description: The time next to each of your messages.

betoescobar46/pituto:plugins/quiet-lines.name: quiet-lines
betoescobar46/pituto:plugins/quiet-lines.description: Tool summaries and turn-duration lines in faint italic, with the time each turn finished.

betoescobar46/pituto:plugins/session-bar.name: session-bar
betoescobar46/pituto:plugins/session-bar.description: A bar under the prompt with compact, clear, effort, model and a color per folder, plus a side chat for quick questions that don't interrupt the task.

ryanraffel-nextroll/claude-code-mods:plu.name: mcp-gaps
ryanraffel-nextroll/claude-code-mods:plu.description: Logs every MCP tool call and flags likely MCP gaps: browser fallbacks, tool errors, and answers that say the MCP can't do something. /mcp-gaps opens a pane; /mcp-gaps report exports a paste-ready list.

jnk0vc/clawd-factory:plugins/clawd-facto.name: clawd-factory
jnk0vc/clawd-factory:plugins/clawd-facto.description: ツール呼び出しのたびにClawdが1匹増え、持ち場で働く様子をペインに表示する作業状況モニター

BrianHuang813/clawd-actor:..name: clawd-actor
BrianHuang813/clawd-actor:..description: While Claude works, Clawd acts out the spinner's -ing word above the prompt, and the tool that is running

monowu/claude-mod-token-usage:..name: token-usage
monowu/claude-mod-token-usage:..description: Pane showing remaining token usage: context window, rate-limit windows, cost

sidneyfrancois/barra-usage-model:..name: barra-usage-model
sidneyfrancois/barra-usage-model:..description: Usage bars for the 5-hour, weekly and context windows above the prompt, with a compact summary, model and effort below it

Aether-Technical/code-buddy:..name: code-buddy
Aether-Technical/code-buddy:..description: A rubber duck in your Claude Code session: a quiet second opinion on each turn, a guard for risky commands, reminders, and lessons about your codebase

angeldelbiondo/claude-chat-bubbles:chat-.name: chat-bubbles
angeldelbiondo/claude-chat-bubbles:chat-.description: Messenger-style chat for Claude Code: your prompts on the right in a rival color, Claude on the left, only running or failing tools stand out. 441 themes.

GGGODLIN/cc-mod-park:..name: cc-mod-park
GGGODLIN/cc-mod-park:..description: /park a session you will come back to; a new session in the same folder offers it back with one click.

anthonyzng/agent-cats:..name: agent-cats
anthonyzng/agent-cats:..description: A dashboard of the session's agents as coloured cats: their tasks, skills and run time, their questions answered in place with a meow, and the skills each task uses

RyanEmslie/paste-peek:..name: paste-peek
RyanEmslie/paste-peek:..description: Shows a small preview above the prompt of each image pasted into it

bryanlin850/claudefishing:..name: claudefishing
bryanlin850/claudefishing:..description: claudefishing: a shared fishing lobby you play while Claude Code is open; your cat gets a slight buff while Claude is working.

aikworks/claude-code-usage-meter:usage-m.name: usage-meter
aikworks/claude-code-usage-meter:usage-m.description: 週間使用量と5時間使用量を、プロンプトの上に常時表示する（週間を主役にした2段メーター）。

KyongSik-Yoon/claude-mods:desktop-look.name: desktop-look
KyongSik-Yoon/claude-mods:desktop-look.description: Make the terminal transcript look like the Claude Code apps: your prompts in a round bubble, tool calls as one line with a state mark, lists set in with bullets, the text between tool calls set apart, and an info band

KyongSik-Yoon/claude-mods:smooth-stream.name: smooth-stream
KyongSik-Yoon/claude-mods:smooth-stream.description: Reveal streaming assistant replies with a smooth typewriter effect

tboydar/claude-code-mods-research:exampl.name: research-tally
tboydar/claude-code-mods-research:exampl.description: Counts observed tool-call attempts without storing arguments or calling a model

nvsravank/multirepo-diff-mod:..name: multirepo-diff-mod
nvsravank/multirepo-diff-mod:..description: /multi-diff: a worktree-aware diff viewer for every git repo in your project folder, with uncommitted, staged, pull request and since-this-session views

aliemrevezir/mods:plugins/project-hop.name: project-hop
aliemrevezir/mods:plugins/project-hop.description: Start Claude in a folder of projects, browse them above the prompt, then open a new session or continue a recent one without leaving the terminal

aliemrevezir/mods:plugins/prompt-dock.name: prompt-dock
aliemrevezir/mods:plugins/prompt-dock.description: A rail of your prompts above the input (hover to preview, click to jump), a dock beside the transcript, and quote-reply from any selected text. Built on top of oikon48/prompt-rail

Vibe-Commit/claude-context-mods:plugins/.name: context-handoff
Vibe-Commit/claude-context-mods:plugins/.description: In the 60-70% context band, Claude writes a handoff, the handoff is rewound away, the session compacts, and Claude resumes from the file.

Vibe-Commit/claude-context-mods:plugins/.name: context-meter
Vibe-Commit/claude-context-mods:plugins/.description: Shows context-window usage in the prompt footer

paulbkim-dev/claude-code-cache-warmer:..name: cache-warmer
paulbkim-dev/claude-code-cache-warmer:..description: Keep the main conversation's prompt cache warm by automatically forking its last request, tools denied and billed like any request, shortly before the cache expires; switch its lifetime between 5m and 1h, and show each refresh's cost and estimated saving.

eduardocruz/cc-kit:mods/kit-sink.name: kit-sink
eduardocruz/cc-kit:mods/kit-sink.description: cc-kit kitchen sink: every candidate component on one pane, to judge and pick from

cmj-hub/gtm-operator-claude-mod:..name: gtm-operator
cmj-hub/gtm-operator-claude-mod:..description: The GTM operator mod for Claude Code: scores every go-to-market draft with its own skill pack's scorer, flags stale and inconsistent drafts across packs, pack dashboards, a guided sprint, analytics, and a guard that keeps brand-config.json and SOUL.md merged.

VibeMage/claude-mod-glance:..name: glance
VibeMage/claude-mod-glance:..description: A HUD under the Claude Code prompt: model, git, cost, context and rate-limit bars, tools, skills, MCP, agents and todos at a glance

s4duq/roco:..name: roco
s4duq/roco:..description: Pixel-art mascot that reacts live to what Claude does. Pick one of 8, recolor it or create your own with /roco:crear. Mascota pixel art para Claude Code.

pepperonas/usage-bars:..name: usage-bars
pepperonas/usage-bars:..description: Your Claude Code 5-hour and 7-day usage limits as animated bars under the prompt: percent, reset countdown, pace mark, projection, per-answer delta, styles (Pac-Man, beer, tank, battery, hourglass)

natea/move-coach:plugins/move-coach.name: move-coach
natea/move-coach:plugins/move-coach.description: Camera pane with pose landmarks, spoken coaching and optional Muse EEG for the Built to Move mobility tests (macOS)

deadraw/claude-code-oneliner:..name: oneliner
deadraw/claude-code-oneliner:..description: A calm instrument strip for Claude Code: 5-hour limit with forecast, prompt-cache countdown, context fill, one-click git ship, and next-step ideas, in one line above your prompt.

JPanna/claude-mods:plugins/autopilot.name: autopilot
JPanna/claude-mods:plugins/autopilot.description: Works through a GOALS.md goal tree turn after turn, with locked checks, its own check verdicts, lessons that carry over, safety guards and a progress band

JPanna/claude-mods:plugins/shortcuts.name: shortcuts
JPanna/claude-mods:plugins/shortcuts.description: Type ;cp, ;plan, ;go, ;tdd, ;ship or ;brief in a prompt to attach a saved instruction

baselane-sh/mods-catalog:test/fixtures/m.name: no-em-dash
baselane-sh/mods-catalog:test/fixtures/m.description: Never writes the em-dash character. Uses a comma, colon, period or parentheses.

Humpens/claude-mods:baton-notify.name: baton-notify
Humpens/claude-mods:baton-notify.description: Claude からバトンが渡ったとき（完了・質問・許可待ち）に、どのセッションかが分かる Mac の通知を出す

Humpens/claude-mods:status.name: status
Humpens/claude-mods:status.description: ツールバー（入力欄の上）の Menu から、TODO・通知・使用率表示の設定を開く

Humpens/claude-mods:today.name: today
Humpens/claude-mods:today.description: TODO を Today・◎・○・△ の段階で管理し、ステータスバーに今日の件数を出す。一覧の画面からボタンで移動・完了できる

Humpens/claude-mods:u.name: u
Humpens/claude-mods:u.description: 5時間・1週間・Fable の使用率と API 換算の料金をステータスバーに表示する

mashabek/claude-mods:plugins/secret-mask.name: secret-mask
mashabek/claude-mods:plugins/secret-mask.description: Masks secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords, .env values) in tool output and prompts before Claude reads them

5omeOtherGuy/slab-deck:mod/slab-deck.name: slab-deck
5omeOtherGuy/slab-deck:mod/slab-deck.description: SLAB/SIGNAL control center for Claude Code: live deck band, control pane, popups and tmux navigation

IKnowJot/clawd-plugins:plugins/clawd-arc.name: clawd-arcade
IKnowJot/clawd-plugins:plugins/clawd-arc.description: Clawd-themed games in a side pane while Claude works. Pauses when Claude needs you and tells you when Claude is done.

IKnowJot/clawd-plugins:plugins/clawd-tra.name: clawd-tracker
IKnowJot/clawd-plugins:plugins/clawd-tra.description: A Domino's-style order tracker above the prompt. Clawd acts out every step next to an honest progress bar, a learned ETA, a delivery receipt, plan usage and a delivery ding. Themes: pizza, coffee, rocket, construction.

balen-abd/claude-migration-guard:..name: migration-guard
balen-abd/claude-migration-guard:..description: Makes Claude ask before it touches your database migrations or runs destructive SQL, with the risk and what it found.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/achievements.name: achievements
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/achievements.description: Unlocks eight badges once each (first session, first green test run, 100 and 1,000 tool calls, 7-day streak, 10 blocked calls, a 2 hour session, night owl), with a toast and /achievements.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/agent-firewall.name: agent-firewall
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/agent-firewall.description: A live pane of every tool call the agent makes: green when it ran, red when it was blocked, with counters. Open it with /firewall.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ahead-behind.name: ahead-behind
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ahead-behind.description: A band above the prompt with the commits ahead and behind the upstream (↑2 ↓1), read with git status after each Bash call and file edit. Hidden when the branch has no upstream.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/audit-pack.name: audit-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/audit-pack.description: Three read-only audit commands in one mod: /secret-scan, /conflicts and /licenses. They read git, project files and dependency folders.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/authors.name: authors
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/authors.description: Adds /authors: the top 15 contributors by commit count with their last commit date, from git log. Names only, never email addresses. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/auto-format.name: auto-format
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/auto-format.description: Runs your project's own formatter on each file Claude writes or edits, only when the project has a formatter config, and tells Claude to re-read the file.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/auto-lint.name: auto-lint
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/auto-lint.description: Runs your project's own linter fix (eslint, ruff or golangci-lint) on each file Claude writes or edits, only when the project has that linter's config, and tells Claude what is left.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/band-pack.name: band-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/band-pack.description: The first six Baselane band meters in one row above the prompt: session cost, lattes, context bar, today's spend, the focus timer and the mood ring.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/battery-band.name: battery-band
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/battery-band.description: A band above the prompt with the Mac battery percent and charging state (🔋 87%, ⚡ 54% while charging), read from pmset once a minute. Hidden on other systems.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead.name: bead
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead.description: Adds /bead <id>: one bead with status, priority, labels, description, blockers and children. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead-chime.name: bead-chime
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead-chime.description: Plays a short chime when a Bash call that ran bd close (or bd done) ends with exit code 0. It reads only the command text and the result, and runs no program.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead-claim-nudg.name: bead-claim-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead-claim-nudg.description: At turn end, if Claude edited a file and no bead is in progress, shows a toast and reminds Claude at your next prompt, once per session. Reads with bd count; quiet without bd.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead-commit-nud.name: bead-commit-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead-commit-nud.description: At turn end, if a git commit named no bead id while a bead is in progress, shows a toast and reminds Claude at your next prompt. Reads with bd count and bd where; quiet without bd.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead-now.name: bead-now
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead-now.description: A band above the prompt with the bead in progress you updated last and how many more are in progress, read with bd list every 2 minutes and after Claude runs bd. Hidden when none is.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead-stale-nudg.name: bead-stale-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead-stale-nudg.description: At session start, one toast when beads in progress have had no update for 7 days, with their ids. Reads with bd stale, and says nothing without bd or a beads project.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead-streak.name: bead-streak
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bead-streak.description: Counts the days in a row you closed a bead, from Bash calls that ran bd close and exited 0. Adds /bead-streak and a toast on a new best. Reads command text only, runs no program.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-band.name: beads-band
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-band.description: A band above the prompt with your beads counts (bd 97 ready · 45 active · 29 blocked), read with bd status every 2 minutes and after Claude runs bd. Hidden without bd or a beads project.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-bars.name: beads-bars
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-bars.description: All six beads bands in one row: counts, the bead in progress, epic progress, done percent, closed today and open by priority, read with bd every 2 minutes and after Claude runs bd.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-done-bar.name: beads-done-bar
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-done-bar.description: A band above the prompt with how much of your beads project is closed, as a bar and a percent (beads █████████░ 88%), read with bd status every 2 minutes. Hidden without bd.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-guard.name: beads-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-guard.description: Asks before bd commands that delete data or rewrite history: delete, purge, prune, gc, sql, admin, import, rename, forget, restore, migrate and more. Reads only the command text, runs no bd.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-pane.name: beads-pane
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-pane.description: A live side pane of your beads: in progress, ready and blocked issues, 10 each, with counts. Read with bd, read-only, after Bash calls. Open it with /beads.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-prime.name: beads-prime
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-prime.description: Runs bd prime once per session and adds its text (max 8 KB) to the system prompt, from the repo's .beads files and bd memories. bd setup claude hooks may add it twice.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-standup.name: beads-standup
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-standup.description: Adds /beads-standup: beads closed since yesterday, in progress, and the next 5 ready. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-today-bar.name: beads-today-bar
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/beads-today-bar.description: A band above the prompt with the beads closed today against a daily goal you set (today ▮▮▮▯▯ 3/5), green when met, read with bd count. Hidden without bd or a beads project.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/big-diff-nudge.name: big-diff-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/big-diff-nudge.description: Suggests splitting the change once your edits added or removed more than 500 lines since the last git commit. A successful commit resets the count.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/big-file-guard.name: big-file-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/big-file-guard.description: Asks before a Write creates content over 1 MB, or git add names a file over 5 MB. Measures the files with find.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/branch-band.name: branch-band
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/branch-band.description: A band above the prompt with the git branch and the count of changed files, read with git status after each Bash call and file edit.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/branches.name: branches
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/branches.description: Adds /branches: local branches merged into the default branch or idle for 30 days, as a cleanup list, read with git. Never deletes.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/break-nudge.name: break-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/break-nudge.description: Suggests a short break once the session has run 90 minutes, and again every 90 minutes after that.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/british-english.name: british-english
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/british-english.description: British spelling and terms in prose (colour, organise, licence as a noun). Code identifiers stay as they are.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bullet-mode.name: bullet-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/bullet-mode.description: Replies as short bullet lists, at most one sentence per bullet, unless you ask for code.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/cache-meter.name: cache-meter
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/cache-meter.description: A band above the prompt with the share of prompt tokens the cache served this session (cache 87%). A high share means cheaper, faster turns.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/caveman-mode.name: caveman-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/caveman-mode.description: Prose in short caveman speech ("Fix bug. Test pass."), still accurate. Code and commands stay exact.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/changelog.name: changelog
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/changelog.description: Adds /changelog: commits since the last tag (or the last 30), read with git log and grouped by conventional-commit type, as Markdown.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/chmod-guard.name: chmod-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/chmod-guard.description: Asks before chmod makes files world-writable (777, a+w, o+w) or chmod or chown runs recursively on a broad path (/, a system folder, a home folder).

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ci-band.name: ci-band
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ci-band.description: A band above the prompt with the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (ci passed, ci failed, ci running), asked of the gh CLI every 2 minutes; branch read with git. Hidden without gh.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ci-config-guard.name: ci-config-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ci-config-guard.description: Asks before Write or Edit changes CI config: .github/workflows, .gitlab-ci.yml or .circleci/config.yml.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/clippy.name: clippy
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/clippy.description: One helpful toast per session per trigger, in the classic paperclip voice: when you edit a migrations folder, a Dockerfile or a GitHub workflow, or run rm -rf. At most one toast per turn.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/code-only.name: code-only
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/code-only.description: Replies with the code or command first and at most two short sentences of prose, unless asked to explain.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/command-pack.name: command-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/command-pack.description: The five original slash commands in one mod: /receipt, /standup, /changelog, /pr-description and /handoff. They read git; /handoff also writes .claude/handoff.md.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/commit-msg.name: commit-msg
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/commit-msg.description: Adds /commit-msg: a Conventional Commits message proposed from the staged diff, read with git. Heuristic, no model call, writes nothing.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/commit-nudge.name: commit-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/commit-nudge.description: Suggests a commit at turn end after 8 or more file edits since the last git commit. One toast per batch of edits; a successful git commit resets the count.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/conflicts.name: conflicts
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/conflicts.description: Adds /conflicts: tracked files that still hold merge conflict markers, with line numbers, found with git grep. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/context-meter.name: context-meter
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/context-meter.description: A band above the prompt with a 10 cell bar of the context window used, yellow from 60 percent, red from 80.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/context-pane.name: context-pane
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/context-pane.description: A live side pane of how full the context window is: the percent as a bar, the tokens used, and a short tip past 75 percent. Open it with /context-pane.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/conventional-co.name: conventional-commits
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/conventional-co.description: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits: type(scope): subject, imperative, under 72 characters.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/cost-meter.name: cost-meter
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/cost-meter.description: A band above the prompt with the session cost so far and what the last turn cost.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/cost-pane.name: cost-pane
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/cost-pane.description: A live side pane with the session cost, the cost of each of the last 10 turns as a bar, and the average per turn. Open it with /cost-pane.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/creator-band.name: creator-band
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/creator-band.description: The creator band in one row above the prompt: turn timer, count of TODO, FIXME and HACK lines (read with git), and the daily streak flame.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/cron-guard.name: cron-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/cron-guard.description: Asks before scheduled jobs or services are wiped or stopped: crontab -r, crontab replaced from stdin or a file, launchctl unload or bootout, systemctl stop, disable or mask.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ctx-nudge.name: ctx-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ctx-nudge.description: Reminds you to /clear or /compact when the context window passes 75 percent.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/curl-pipe-guard.name: curl-pipe-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/curl-pipe-guard.description: Asks before a download is piped into a shell or interpreter (curl | sh, wget -O- | bash, bash <(curl ...)).

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/daily-spend.name: daily-spend
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/daily-spend.description: A band above the prompt with today's total cost across all your sessions.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/db-reset-guard.name: db-reset-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/db-reset-guard.description: Asks before a framework wipes a database: prisma migrate reset, rails or rake db:drop and db:reset, alembic downgrade, django flush, supabase db reset, knex rollback --all.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/debug-print-nud.name: debug-print-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/debug-print-nud.description: At turn end, one toast naming the count of console.log, print(, debugger and dbg! lines your edits added this turn. Only code files count.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/deploy-guard.name: deploy-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/deploy-guard.description: Asks before a production deploy: vercel --prod, netlify deploy --prod, firebase deploy, fly deploy, gcloud app deploy, eb deploy, heroku rollback, serverless deploy to prod.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/deps.name: deps
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/deps.description: Adds /deps: direct dependencies with versions from package.json, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, go.mod and Cargo.toml at the git repo root. No network, no audit. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/desktop-notify.name: desktop-notify
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/desktop-notify.description: Shows a desktop notification when Claude Code needs your input: osascript on macOS, notify-send elsewhere when it is installed. The text is the project name and a short status only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/dev-band.name: dev-band
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/dev-band.description: The developer band in one row above the prompt: git branch and changed files (read with git status), wall clock and session age, tool counts, and failed tool calls.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/diff-stats.name: diff-stats
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/diff-stats.description: Edit and Write rows show a compact +12 -3 bar beside the file name: green for lines added, red for lines removed, up to 20 cells.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/discord-notify.name: discord-notify
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/discord-notify.description: Posts to a Discord webhook when Claude Code needs your input. Sends the project name and a short status only. Does nothing until you set a webhook URL.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/docker-guard.name: docker-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/docker-guard.description: Asks before Docker commands that delete data: system, volume or image prune, rm -f, volume rm and compose down -v.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/docs-nudge.name: docs-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/docs-nudge.description: At turn end, one toast when edits added exported code (an export statement in .ts or .js, or a public function signature) and no README or docs file was edited this session.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/docstring-mode.name: docstring-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/docstring-mode.description: Every new or changed public function gets a short doc comment in the language's normal style.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/eli5-mode.name: eli5-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/eli5-mode.description: Explains like the reader is new: analogies first, no jargon without a one-line definition.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/env-check.name: env-check
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/env-check.description: Adds /env-check: variable names in .env.example against .env at the git repo root, listing missing and extra names. Reads names only, never a value. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/env-example-nud.name: env-example-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/env-example-nud.description: At turn end, one toast when edits add a reference to an environment variable (process.env, os.environ, os.getenv, Deno.env) that .env.example does not list. Reads only .env.example names, never .env.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/env-exfil-guard.name: env-exfil-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/env-exfil-guard.description: Asks before a command prints your environment, echoes a secret variable or sends local data to a remote host.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/envinfo.name: envinfo
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/envinfo.description: Adds /envinfo: versions of git, node, npm, python3, go, rustc and docker if installed, by running each (2 s limit), and the OS. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/epic-bar.name: epic-bar
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/epic-bar.description: A band above the prompt with the progress of the epic you work on, or of the open epic nearest to done (bm-ooq ███████░ 7/8), read with bd. Hidden without epics or bd.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/epics-pane.name: epics-pane
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/epics-pane.description: A live side pane of each open beads epic: a bar of closed and total children, and a mark when it is ready to close. Read with bd, read-only. Open it with /epics.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/error-meter.name: error-meter
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/error-meter.description: A band above the prompt with how many tool calls failed this session (an error or a deny) and which tool failed last. Red from the first failure.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/exit-badge.name: exit-badge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/exit-badge.description: A failed Bash row shows a small red badge with its exit code, for example exit 2.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/explore-pack.name: explore-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/explore-pack.description: Five read-only repo exploration commands in one mod: /tree, /deps, /authors, /scripts and /env-check. They read git and project files.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/file-links.name: file-links
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/file-links.description: In Claude's replies, path/to/file.ts:42 references to files in your project become links. Click one to put @path/to/file.ts in the prompt.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/file-owners.name: file-owners
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/file-owners.description: Adds /owners <path>: the top 5 authors of a file or folder by lines, from git blame. Names only, never addresses. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/files-pane.name: files-pane
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/files-pane.description: A live side pane of the files Claude read, edited or wrote this session, grouped by action with a count per file, newest first. Open it with /files.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/focus-pack.name: focus-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/focus-pack.description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: commit after 8 edits, TODO/FIXME/HACK lines added, and debug prints added.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/fun-pack.name: fun-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/fun-pack.description: Fun habits in one install: caveman prose and gitmoji commit messages. They compose: caveman never touches commit messages.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/git-history-gua.name: git-history-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/git-history-gua.description: Asks before git commands that throw away work or rewrite history: reset --hard, clean, rebase, filter-branch, filter-repo, push --delete, branch -D and stash clear.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/git-pane.name: git-pane
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/git-pane.description: A live side pane, read with git: the branch, ahead and behind its upstream, changed files (staged and unstaged) and the last 5 commits. Refreshes after git commands and edits. Open it with /git.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/gitignore-check.name: gitignore-check
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/gitignore-check.description: Asks before git add or commit when secret-looking files are not ignored or are already tracked. Checks with git ls-files.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/gitmoji-commits.name: gitmoji-commits
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/gitmoji-commits.description: Commit messages start with the matching gitmoji (✨ feat, 🐛 fix). Composes with conventional-commits: emoji goes before the type.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/guard-devops.name: guard-devops
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/guard-devops.description: Asks before harsh DevOps commands: destructive Docker, Kubernetes and Helm calls, CI config edits, broad chmod and chown, and git commands that lose work. Add infra-guard for plain kubectl delete.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/guard-essential.name: guard-essentials
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/guard-essential.description: Asks only before harsh or disaster commands: destructive infra, git and SQL, piping downloads into a shell, sudo, leaking or committing secrets. Reads git. The quiet choice for daily work.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/guard-pack.name: guard-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/guard-pack.description: The 15 core Baselane guards in one mod (secrets, git, infra, packages, path jail). Some read git, measure files with find, read HOME with printenv, or check where a path really lands.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/haiku-commits.name: haiku-commits
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/haiku-commits.description: Commit messages get a normal conventional-commit first line, then a 5-7-5 haiku about the change in the body.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/handoff.name: handoff
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/handoff.description: Adds /handoff: writes a session summary with the git status to .claude/handoff.md (never overwriting) and answers with the path.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/heatmap.name: heatmap
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/heatmap.description: Adds /heatmap: a 12-week calendar grid of the days you used Claude Code, like a contribution graph, shaded by turns, naming your busiest day.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/hotspots.name: hotspots
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/hotspots.description: Adds /hotspots: the 10 files changed most often in the last 90 days, from git log, with change counts. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/infra-guard.name: infra-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/infra-guard.description: Asks before terraform destroy, kubectl delete, force-push, DROP TABLE or rm -rf.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/issue-links.name: issue-links
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/issue-links.description: #123 references in Claude's replies become links to that issue when the repository's origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/json-pretty.name: json-pretty
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/json-pretty.description: Bash output that is one long line of JSON is drawn pretty-printed, folded after 30 lines. Display only: Claude reads the output as it was.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/junior-mode.name: junior-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/junior-mode.description: Explains each step and why, and defines jargon once, for a learner.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/k8s-guard.name: k8s-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/k8s-guard.description: Asks before kubectl apply or replace with --force, kubectl drain, helm uninstall, and kubectl delete behind global flags (plain kubectl delete is infra-guard's).

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/langs.name: langs
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/langs.description: Counts the file types Claude edits across sessions and adds /langs: a bar list of the types edited most, each file counted once per session.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/latte-meter.name: latte-meter
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/latte-meter.description: A band above the prompt that counts the session cost in lattes. Set the latte price in the plugin options.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/licenses.name: licenses
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/licenses.description: Adds /licenses: the licence of each direct dependency, from node_modules and Python dist-info at the git repo root. Shows unknown when it cannot tell. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/lifecycle-pack.name: lifecycle-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/lifecycle-pack.description: The four original lifecycle mods in one: runs your formatter, sends ntfy.sh pushes for long commands and input waits, and appends to ~/.claude/journal.log.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/loc.name: loc
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/loc.description: Adds /loc: lines of tracked text files by language, read with git, sorted, with a total. Skips lockfiles and binaries. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/lockfile-guard.name: lockfile-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/lockfile-guard.description: Asks before a lockfile is written or edited by hand; the package manager should change it.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/lockfile-nudge.name: lockfile-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/lockfile-nudge.description: At turn end, one toast when dependencies in package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml or go.mod changed and neither the matching lockfile was edited nor an install command ran.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/long-run-notify.name: long-run-notify
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/long-run-notify.description: Sends a phone push through ntfy.sh when a Bash command ran longer than a threshold (60 seconds by default). Sends the project name and the seconds only. Does nothing until you set an ntfy topic.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/mentor-pack.name: mentor-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/mentor-pack.description: Mentor habits in one install: a hint and a guiding question first, assumptions listed before work, and a strict self-review after each change.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/migration-guard.name: migration-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/migration-guard.description: Asks before Write or Edit changes a migration that already exists; new migration files pass.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/migration-nudge.name: migration-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/migration-nudge.description: At turn end, one toast when a schema file changed (schema.prisma, models.py, SQL under schema/, a drizzle schema) and no migration file was created this session.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/model-badge.name: model-badge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/model-badge.description: A band above the prompt with the current model name and the context percent (opus-4-1 · 62%).

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/mood-ring.name: mood-ring
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/mood-ring.description: A band above the prompt with a colored dot and a word for the error and block rate of your last 20 tool calls: calm (green) under 10 percent, tense (yellow) under 30, stormy (red) from 30.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/night-owl.name: night-owl
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/night-owl.description: Records the hour of each prompt across sessions and adds /hours: a 24-hour histogram of when you work, naming your peak hour.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/no-em-dash.name: no-em-dash
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/no-em-dash.description: Never writes the em-dash character. Uses a comma, colon, period or parentheses.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/no-sycophancy.name: no-sycophancy
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/no-sycophancy.description: No flattery or filler. Disagreement is stated plainly, with the reason.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/no-verify-guard.name: no-verify-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/no-verify-guard.description: Asks before git hooks are skipped (--no-verify, commit -n, HUSKY=0, core.hooksPath=/dev/null).

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/noir-mode.name: noir-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/noir-mode.description: Prose like a hard-boiled detective narrator, light and clear. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/notify-pack.name: notify-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/notify-pack.description: Local alerts in one: a desktop notification when Claude Code needs your input (osascript or notify-send), and a spoken line (say) on macOS when a long turn ends.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/now-playing.name: now-playing
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/now-playing.description: A band above the prompt with the track Music or Spotify plays on your Mac (♪ Song - Artist), read with pgrep and osascript once a minute, only from a player that runs. Hidden when nothing plays.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ntfy-notify.name: ntfy-notify
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ntfy-notify.description: Sends a phone push through ntfy.sh when Claude Code needs your input. The message is generic. Does nothing until you set an ntfy topic.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/nudge-pack.name: nudge-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/nudge-pack.description: Two turn-end reminders in one mod: test-reminder and ctx-nudge.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ops-band.name: ops-band
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ops-band.description: The ops band in one row above the prompt: commits ahead and behind the upstream (git), the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (gh), and the Mac battery (pmset).

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/package-guard.name: package-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/package-guard.description: Asks before a new dependency is installed (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, uv, poetry, cargo, go, gem) and names the packages.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/path-jail.name: path-jail
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/path-jail.description: Asks before Write, Edit or NotebookEdit changes a file outside the working directory, by real path.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/path-shorten.name: path-shorten
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/path-shorten.description: Tool rows draw long absolute file paths shorter: the project root as ./ and your home folder as ~. Display only; Bash commands are drawn as they ran.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/personal-bests.name: personal-bests
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/personal-bests.description: Tracks your records across sessions (longest session, most tool calls in a session, most files edited in a day, cheapest session over 30 minutes), toasts a new one, and lists them with /bests.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/pirate-mode.name: pirate-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/pirate-mode.description: Talks like a pirate in prose, never inside code, commands or file contents.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/plain-english.name: plain-english
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/plain-english.description: Writes in ASD-STE-100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, active voice, simple words.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/pomodoro.name: pomodoro
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/pomodoro.description: A band above the prompt with a 25/5 focus timer (focus 18:42, break 03:10). Start and stop it with /pomodoro; a toast marks each switch.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/port-watch.name: port-watch
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/port-watch.description: A live side pane of the local TCP ports that listen, with the process name and pid, refreshed every 10 seconds while open. Reads lsof (macOS, most Linux). Open it with /ports.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/pr-description.name: pr-description
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/pr-description.description: Adds /pr-description: title, summary, diff totals and a test plan stub for the current branch against main or master, read with git.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/priority-bar.name: priority-bar
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/priority-bar.description: A band above the prompt with your open beads by priority (P0 2 · P1 14 · P2 60 · P3 50), red while a P0 is open, read with bd count every 2 minutes. Hidden without bd.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/process-pane.name: process-pane
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/process-pane.description: A live side pane of the processes the session's Bash calls started that still run, with pid, age and command. Read-only: one ps every 5 seconds. Open it with /procs.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/prod-db-guard.name: prod-db-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/prod-db-guard.description: Asks before destructive SQL runs in a command: TRUNCATE, DELETE or UPDATE with no WHERE.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/protect-main.name: protect-main
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/protect-main.description: Asks before a commit, push or merge while you are on main or master. Reads the branch with git.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/publish-guard.name: publish-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/publish-guard.description: Asks before a package is published: npm, pnpm, yarn or bun publish, cargo publish, twine upload, gem push, poetry or uv publish. Dry runs pass.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/quality-pack.name: quality-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/quality-pack.description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: type check after TypeScript edits, lockfile after dependency edits, and a split suggestion past 500 changed lines.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/readme-check.name: readme-check
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/readme-check.description: Adds /readme-check: which common README sections are missing (install, usage, licence, contributing) and which relative links are broken, at the git repo root. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ready.name: ready
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ready.description: Adds /ready: the 20 top ready beads, one line each, and the total. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/receipt.name: receipt
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/receipt.description: Adds /receipt: a shareable receipt of the session (tools, files, commands, blocks, context, cost), printed and copied.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/recent.name: recent
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/recent.description: Adds /recent: your last 15 commits across all local branches (author is git user.name), with branch and date. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/registry-push-g.name: registry-push-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/registry-push-g.description: Asks before an image or chart is pushed to a registry: docker push, docker buildx --push, podman push, helm push, gcloud artifacts docker push. Local registries pass.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/release-pack.name: release-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/release-pack.description: Asks before a release leaves your machine: package publish, tag push, production deploy and registry push guards in one mod. The tag guard reads tags with git.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/render-pack.name: render-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/render-pack.description: Both original rendering mods in one: diff-stats bars on Edit and Write rows, and file-links in Claude's replies (a click puts @path in the prompt).

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/render-plus.name: render-plus
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/render-plus.description: Three row badges in one: time-badge, exit-badge and size-badge.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/reply-language.name: reply-language
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/reply-language.description: Answers in the language you set (English by default). Code, identifiers and commands stay as they are.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/repo-pack.name: repo-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/repo-pack.description: Five read-only repo commands in one mod: /todos, /loc, /hotspots, /commit-msg and /branches. They read git.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/reviewer-mode.name: reviewer-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/reviewer-mode.description: After each code change, reviews its own diff like a strict senior reviewer and lists each issue it found and fixed.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/rubber-duck.name: rubber-duck
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/rubber-duck.description: Restates the problem in its own words and lists its assumptions before it starts work.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/say-done.name: say-done
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/say-done.description: On macOS, speaks "Claude is done" with the say command when a turn ends after more than 30 seconds. Does nothing on other platforms.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/scripts.name: scripts
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/scripts.description: Adds /scripts: runnable tasks from package.json scripts, Makefile targets, justfile recipes and pyproject scripts at the git repo root. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/secret-commit-g.name: secret-commit-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/secret-commit-g.description: Asks before a git commit that would record a credential or a secret-named file. Reads the staged diff with git.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/secret-filename.name: secret-filename-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/secret-filename.description: Asks before a Bash command touches a secret-looking file (.env, private keys, credentials).

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/secret-guard.name: secret-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/secret-guard.description: Asks before a live API key, token or private key is written, edited or run.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/secret-output-g.name: secret-output-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/secret-output-g.description: Tells Claude not to repeat a credential that showed up in command or file output, and names the source to rotate.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/secret-scan.name: secret-scan
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/secret-scan.description: Adds /secret-scan: tracked files and line numbers that hold secret-shaped text, found with git grep. Never prints a matched value. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/security-mode.name: security-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/security-mode.description: Checks each change for injection, secrets, authorization and unsafe input, and states the risks it checked.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/session-clock.name: session-clock
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/session-clock.description: A band above the prompt with the wall clock and how long the session has run (14:05 · 1h 12m).

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/session-journal.name: session-journal
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/session-journal.description: Appends one line per session end (time, directory, reason) to ~/.claude/journal.log.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sha-links.name: sha-links
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sha-links.description: Commit SHAs in Claude's replies, and in the output of git commands, become links to the commit page when origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/shakespeare-mod.name: shakespeare-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/shakespeare-mod.description: Prose in Early Modern English flair. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ship-safe-pack.name: ship-safe-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ship-safe-pack.description: The release-pack guards plus db-reset-guard and upload-guard: asks before publish, tag push, production deploy, registry push, database wipes and file uploads. Reads tags with git.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/size.name: size
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/size.description: Adds /size: the 15 largest tracked files and the total tracked size at HEAD, read with git. Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/size-badge.name: size-badge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/size-badge.description: Read and Write rows show how much was read or written: the line count, for example 312 lines, or the file size for images and PDFs.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/slack-notify.name: slack-notify
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/slack-notify.description: Posts to a Slack incoming webhook when Claude Code needs your input. Sends the project name and a short status only. Does nothing until you set a webhook URL.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/socratic-mode.name: socratic-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/socratic-mode.description: For learning: answers a question with a short hint and one guiding question first, and gives the full answer when you ask. Code and commands stay exact.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-arcade.name: sounds-arcade
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-arcade.description: Arcade blips: a coin when tests pass, a game-over drop when they fail, a buzz when a call is blocked, a power-up when a turn ends.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-minimal.name: sounds-minimal
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-minimal.description: Very short, quiet clicks and ticks for a subtle signal: a tick when tests pass, two low ticks when they fail, a click when a call is blocked, a soft tick when a turn ends.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-nature.name: sounds-nature
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-nature.description: Soft nature sounds: a bird chirp when tests pass, a plunk into water when they fail, a gust of wind when a call is blocked, a water drop when a turn ends.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-office.name: sounds-office
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-office.description: Quiet office sounds: a soft click when tests pass, a low thud when they fail, paper when a call is blocked.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-retro.name: sounds-retro
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-retro.description: 8-bit sounds: a coin when tests pass, a buzz when they fail, a chime when a turn ends.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-scifi.name: sounds-scifi
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-scifi.description: Sci-fi console sounds: a beep when tests pass, an alarm when they fail, a warp when a turn ends.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-zen.name: sounds-zen
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sounds-zen.description: Soft bells and singing-bowl tones: a bell when tests pass, a low bowl when they fail, a muted chime when a call is blocked, a bowl when a turn ends.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sports-narrator.name: sports-narrator
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sports-narrator.description: One line of sports play-by-play at turn end. OFF by default: one haiku call per turn with tools. Turn on the enabled option. Sends tool names, file names and the first two words of each command.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ssh-guard.name: ssh-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ssh-guard.description: Asks before a private key in .ssh is read, authorized_keys or the SSH config is changed, or ssh-keygen would overwrite a key. Public keys and ssh -i pass. Reads HOME with printenv.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/standup.name: standup
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/standup.description: Adds /standup: Yesterday, Today and Blockers from your git log and this session's record, printed and copied.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/stashes.name: stashes
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/stashes.description: Adds /stashes: git stashes with their age and the branch each was made on. Read-only, never applies or drops.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/stats-pack.name: stats-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/stats-pack.description: The three original stats mods in one: /wrapped, streaks and achievements on one shared daily rollup.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ste-mode.name: ste-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/ste-mode.description: Replies in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: approved words, short sentences, one instruction each, active voice.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/streak-flame.name: streak-flame
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/streak-flame.description: A band above the prompt with your daily streak, the days in a row you finished a turn (🔥 5d). The mod keeps the count in its own store.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/streaks.name: streaks
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/streaks.description: Counts consecutive days you used Claude Code: a Day N streak toast at session start, and /streak to ask.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sudo-guard.name: sudo-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/sudo-guard.description: Asks before sudo, doas or su -c runs a command with elevated rights.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/tag-guard.name: tag-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/tag-guard.description: Asks before release tags go to a remote: git push --tags, --follow-tags or --mirror, a push of a tag ref, and a push that deletes a remote tag. Dry runs pass. Reads tags with git.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/tdd-mode.name: tdd-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/tdd-mode.description: Writes a failing test first, watches it fail, then implements.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/team-pack.name: team-pack
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/team-pack.description: Team habits in one install: Conventional Commits, test-first work and a security check on every change.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/terse-mode.name: terse-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/terse-mode.description: Short answers: no preamble, no recap.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/test-pane.name: test-pane
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/test-pane.description: A live side pane with the last test run (vitest, jest, pytest, go test, cargo test, bun test, claude plugin test): runner, pass, fail and skip counts, duration and first failures. Open it with /tests.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/test-reminder.name: test-reminder
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/test-reminder.description: Reminds you at turn end when source files changed but no test command ran since.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/time-badge.name: time-badge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/time-badge.description: Tool rows show how long the call ran, for example 2.4s, when it took over one second. The time is the tool's own run time, without permission prompts.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/timeline-pane.name: timeline-pane
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/timeline-pane.description: A live side pane of this session's turns, newest first: start time, length, tool calls and cost of each, with a total. Open it with /timeline.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/todo-count.name: todo-count
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/todo-count.description: A band above the prompt with how many lines in tracked files hold TODO, FIXME or HACK (todo 12), counted with git after edits. Hidden when there are none.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/todo-nudge.name: todo-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/todo-nudge.description: At turn end, one toast with the count of TODO, FIXME and HACK lines your edits added this turn. Quiet when none were added.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/todo-pane.name: todo-pane
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/todo-pane.description: A live side pane of the TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files (git grep), grouped by file and capped at 30. It refreshes after file edits while open. Open it with /todo-pane.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/todos.name: todos
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/todos.description: Adds /todos: TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files, found with git grep, grouped by file (50 lines at most). Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/tool-counter.name: tool-counter
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/tool-counter.description: A band above the prompt with your tool calls this session, the top three by tool (Bash 41 · Edit 18 · Read 12).

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/tree.name: tree
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/tree.description: Adds /tree: tracked files (git ls-files) as a tree, 2 levels deep, folders with file counts (80 lines at most). Read-only.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/turn-timer.name: turn-timer
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/turn-timer.description: A band above the prompt with how long the current turn has run (turn 0:42). It shows while a turn runs and hides between turns.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/typecheck-nudge.name: typecheck-nudge
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/typecheck-nudge.description: At turn end, one toast when .ts or .tsx files were edited and no type check (tsc, vue-tsc, a typecheck script or a build) ran since the last edit.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/upload-guard.name: upload-guard
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/upload-guard.description: Asks before local files go to a remote host: scp or rsync to host:path, piped input to nc, curl -T, sftp put. Local copies, downloads and localhost pass.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/url-links.name: url-links
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/url-links.description: https links (and http://localhost) in tool output are listed as clickable links under the result, up to five. Display only: Claude reads the output as it was.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/weekly.name: weekly
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/weekly.description: Adds /week: this week (since Monday) against last week, with sessions, turns, tool calls, files edited and cost, and the change for each.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/wrapped.name: wrapped
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/wrapped.description: Adds /wrapped: a screenshot-ready Claude Code Wrapped for the last 7 days (or /wrapped month for 30), printed and copied.

baselane-sh/mods:plugins/yoda-mode.name: yoda-mode
baselane-sh/mods:plugins/yoda-mode.description: Speaks like Yoda in prose. Code, commands and commit messages stay normal.

RektyRowdyy/claude-mods:plugins/usage-ba.name: usage-band
RektyRowdyy/claude-mods:plugins/usage-ba.description: Band above the prompt: 5h/7d rate-limit usage with reset countdowns, session cache tokens and cost

saksham10arora-dotcom/claude-lofi:..name: lofi
saksham10arora-dotcom/claude-lofi:..description: A lofi soundtrack that follows the session: calm while Claude is idle, focus while it works, flow during heavy editing, a chime when tests pass and a low note when they fail. Off until /lofi on. Original music, synthesised for this mod. Needs function hooks (early access).

saksham10arora-dotcom/claude-frugal:..name: frugal
saksham10arora-dotcom/claude-frugal:..description: Cost-free mode for Claude Code. Helper subagents (Explore and friends) run on Haiku, and a summarize_free tool lets Claude hand big files and logs to a free Gemini model instead of reading them whole. /frugal on, off, status. Needs function hooks (early access).

saksham10arora-dotcom/claude-vhs:..name: vhs
saksham10arora-dotcom/claude-vhs:..description: A tape of every edit Claude makes. /vhs opens a replay pane: watch each change type itself in, step with h and l, auto-play with p, and press r twice to rewind a file to any step. Needs function hooks (early access).

saksham10arora-dotcom/claude-teach-me:..name: teach-me
saksham10arora-dotcom/claude-teach-me:..description: Learn while Claude codes. After a turn that changed code, a quick question about that exact change appears above the prompt; answer with /a 1-4, see your weak spots with /teach stats. Needs function hooks (early access).

arafathusayn/cc-mods:mods/usage-meter.name: usage-meter
arafathusayn/cc-mods:mods/usage-meter.description: Shows your plan's 5-hour and weekly usage limits in one line above the prompt, with the time to each reset; /usage-meter opens a pane with your pace and when you would run out

nicodunks/goodfriend:..name: goodfriend
nicodunks/goodfriend:..description: be a goodfriend and remember your friends' birthdays. birthdays from contacts and the people you text show up right in claude code, with a one-tap happy birthday text.

fabiopbarbieri/claude-test-progress:..name: test-progress
fabiopbarbieri/claude-test-progress:..description: Acompanha em segundo plano os testes dos módulos cadastrados no workspace, com contadores observados, estado e logs por módulo.

apolenkov/agent-compact-advisor:..name: agent-compact-advisor
apolenkov/agent-compact-advisor:..description: Status line score 0-100 for how good a moment it is to /compact now, with reasons; offers a ready /compact that keeps goal, decisions, leftovers and paths, and adds that template to every compaction. Never compacts by itself.

davideiffert/check-it:..name: check-it
davideiffert/check-it:..description: A list of the things to look at with your own eyes after Claude changes something you can see, each with a link and a tick.

russellpope/claude-mods:outputs-pane.name: outputs-pane
russellpope/claude-mods:outputs-pane.description: Side pane listing files Claude writes or edits, split into planning, code and scratch, with a filter; click one to open it in your editor

theagitist/claude-mods:box-status.name: box-status
theagitist/claude-mods:box-status.description: Status line: which box you're on, the out-of-band ping channel it resolves (telegram/email/none), and whether passwordless sudo is available.

theagitist/claude-mods:dot-guard.name: dot-guard
theagitist/claude-mods:dot-guard.description: Block `git add` of a whole $HOME work-tree (dot add -A/./*), which would stage your entire home directory.

theagitist/claude-mods:emdash-watch.name: emdash-watch
theagitist/claude-mods:emdash-watch.description: Flag em-dashes you introduce into public-facing prose (notes, docs, READMEs, HTML); internal files (CLAUDE.md, memory) are exempt. Non-blocking note to the model.

theagitist/claude-mods:home-path-guard.name: home-path-guard
theagitist/claude-mods:home-path-guard.description: Flag hardcoded user home paths (/home/<user>, /Users/<user>) you write into files; nudge $HOME / ~ instead. Machine-local (*.local.*) files exempt. Non-blocking.

theagitist/claude-mods:idle-ping.name: idle-ping
theagitist/claude-mods:idle-ping.description: When a turn that did real work ends, ping the user out of band (Telegram if a bot token + TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID are set, else email via CLAUDE_PING_EMAIL + a mailer).

ricardo-martincoski/claude-lab:plugins/s.name: show-usage
ricardo-martincoski/claude-lab:plugins/s.description: Shows context window usage and 5-hour/7-day session usage limits in the status line

ricardo-martincoski/claude-lab:plugins/w.name: warn-usage
ricardo-martincoski/claude-lab:plugins/w.description: Warns when context window usage or 5-hour/7-day session usage limits reach a threshold

MaryCache/claude-code-companion-mod:plug.name: companion
MaryCache/claude-code-companion-mod:plug.description: A Claude Code companion: a Markdown kanban board pane (/board), a "please look" queue, a mood sprite, and rate-limit usage bars

elkinaguas/claude-mods:pixelbar.name: pixelbar
elkinaguas/claude-mods:pixelbar.description: Status bar++: an animated pixel-art band above the prompt with model, context, rate limits, cost and git

manuacl/claude-mods:plugins/otto-hud.name: otto-hud
manuacl/claude-mods:plugins/otto-hud.description: Otto, a blue octopus, forecasts your context window on one line above the prompt, in the Claude Code desktop app for now: weather scaled to auto-compact with what fills the context on hover, the tokens each recent prompt added, and your 5-hour and 7-day limits with a pace projection. Labels in English or French. Fork of Anthropic's Token Weather (Apache-2.0).

ziedgithub/claude-code-mods:context-bar.name: context-bar
ziedgithub/claude-code-mods:context-bar.description: A footer showing the model and effort, how full the context window is, and the prompt cache, with one-click compact and clear

ziedgithub/claude-code-mods:crab-buddy.name: crab-buddy
ziedgithub/claude-code-mods:crab-buddy.description: A pixel-art Claude crab above the prompt that works, thinks, cheers and sleeps with the session, with a small crab in its own color for each subagent

ziedgithub/claude-code-mods:warm-compact.name: warm-compact
ziedgithub/claude-code-mods:warm-compact.description: Compacts an idle session just before its prompt cache goes cold, or keeps the cache warm while you're away, so your next prompt doesn't re-read the whole conversation uncached. Two chips under the prompt, /warm-compact and /keep-warm turn each on or off for a session.

MohabYasser2/claude-code-mods:cache-band.name: cache-band
MohabYasser2/claude-code-mods:cache-band.description: Shows how hot or cold the prompt cache is above the prompt, with a Compact button.

MohabYasser2/claude-code-mods:git-sync-b.name: git-sync-band
MohabYasser2/claude-code-mods:git-sync-b.description: A band above the prompt with branch, ahead/behind, changed files and last push; pulls before your prompt when it is safe; Pull, Files and Commit & push buttons that run git without a model turn.

MohabYasser2/claude-code-mods:scout-rout.name: scout-router
MohabYasser2/claude-code-mods:scout-rout.description: Before a subagent starts on Opus, a Haiku judge reads its task and moves it to Sonnet unless it needs Opus's judgment.

leepokai/claude-mod-cutroom:..name: cutroom
leepokai/claude-mod-cutroom:..description: Cutroom: a cutting-room pane for HyperFrames projects inside Claude Code — frame preview, timeline, trim/split/move/delete/undo, Studio selection bridge, and point-and-ask edits sent to Claude.

ipartington/claude-mods:bg-task-band.name: bg-task-band
ipartington/claude-mods:bg-task-band.description: A band above the prompt showing running background tasks, their elapsed time and last output line

ipartington/claude-mods:handoff-on-clear.name: handoff-on-clear
ipartington/claude-mods:handoff-on-clear.description: Saves a handoff when you /clear or exit, and offers it back on your next prompt

ipartington/claude-mods:merge-followthro.name: merge-followthrough
ipartington/claude-mods:merge-followthro.description: Watches your PRs, and when one merges it pulls main and deletes the branch, then tells Claude

ipartington/claude-mods:review-ledger.name: review-ledger
ipartington/claude-mods:review-ledger.description: Keeps review findings (H1, M3, L2...) per repo across sessions and ticks them off when their PR merges

ipartington/claude-mods:tts-lite.name: tts-lite
ipartington/claude-mods:tts-lite.description: Speaks a one-line summary of each reply without starting a headless claude session

menufactory43/buildreel:..name: buildreel
menufactory43/buildreel:..description: Turns your Claude Code session into a 30-second build-in-public video: it records the moments, films your app, and gives you an editing table before anything is shared.

kshitiz-swim/claude-plugins:plugins/play.name: play-button
kshitiz-swim/claude-plugins:plugins/play.description: Repo-agnostic play/pause button that detects and runs the app, with a hover card of running services

kshitiz-swim/claude-plugins:plugins/prog.name: progress-bar
kshitiz-swim/claude-plugins:plugins/prog.description: Live progress bar with % estimate and elapsed time above the prompt

cldotdev/claude-todo-list:..name: todo-list
cldotdev/claude-todo-list:..description: Keeps a running list of open items from the conversation and shows it above the prompt.

jonathan-fielding/dotclaude:plugins/mess.name: message-time
jonathan-fielding/dotclaude:plugins/mess.description: Shows when you sent each message, under it in the transcript.

KaiC5504/clawd-bar:..name: clawd-bar
KaiC5504/clawd-bar:..description: Clawd, Claude Code's crab, lives in a band above your prompt: he acts out the session, shows what's running, your context and usage limits, and races your CI builds. Unofficial fan mod.

RafeSymonds/claude-mods:plugins/latex.name: latex
RafeSymonds/claude-mods:plugins/latex.description: Reads your LaTeX header's macros so math renders in the desktop app, and draws math as Unicode in the terminal

RafeSymonds/claude-mods:plugins/refs.name: refs
RafeSymonds/claude-mods:plugins/refs.description: Tracks the reference codes (F1, D2, A3) Claude defines: a /refs pane, and cited codes resolved for the model

DamianPala/sessile:mod.name: sessile
DamianPala/sessile:mod.description: Your Claude Code sessions in a pane docked beside the conversation: search, rename, archive, export and delete, here or in every project

ohade/claude-mods:image-thumbs.name: image-thumbs
ohade/claude-mods:image-thumbs.description: Shows pasted images as framed thumbnails under the prompt; click to expand, open in a pane, or /image

joydeep-pm/usage-band:..name: usage-band
joydeep-pm/usage-band:..description: Usage band above the prompt: 5h/7d limits, token totals and session cost

m-mahiro/claude-code-mods:mods/btw-fix.name: btw-fix
m-mahiro/claude-code-mods:mods/btw-fix.description: Replaces /btw's blocking side panel with a plain, scrollable transcript answer.

yahyabedirhan/claude-mods:plugins/sessio.name: session-status
yahyabedirhan/claude-mods:plugins/sessio.description: A read-only pane that shows the session's live status: doing now, decisions, progress, surprises and the last update.

ShriD5/claude-mods:chai-meter.name: chai-meter
ShriD5/claude-mods:chai-meter.description: A taxi meter for the session's cost in the status line, in dollars and cups of chai.

ShriD5/claude-mods:commit-coach.name: commit-coach
ShriD5/claude-mods:commit-coach.description: Rewrites lazy commit subjects into conventional commits from the staged diff, and strips AI attribution trailers

ShriD5/claude-mods:main-guard.name: main-guard
ShriD5/claude-mods:main-guard.description: A red band when you are on main or in prod, and no force-push, reset --hard or unconfirmed push to a protected branch

ShriD5/claude-mods:night-mode.name: night-mode
ShriD5/claude-mods:night-mode.description: Late at night Claude gets more careful and asks before deploys, force pushes and rm -rf

ShriD5/claude-mods:phone-approve.name: phone-approve
ShriD5/claude-mods:phone-approve.description: Approve or deny Claude Code's permission prompts from Telegram, with the terminal prompt as the fallback.

ShriD5/claude-mods:rubber-duck.name: rubber-duck
ShriD5/claude-mods:rubber-duck.description: A fast second opinion on every edit: a small model flags removed error handling, deleted tests, secrets and more

ShriD5/claude-mods:secret-guard.name: secret-guard
ShriD5/claude-mods:secret-guard.description: Stops Claude from writing API keys, tokens, private keys and database passwords into files.

ShriD5/claude-mods:ship-log.name: ship-log
ShriD5/claude-mods:ship-log.description: /ship turns what you built this session into a build-in-public post for X or LinkedIn

ShriD5/claude-mods:standup.name: standup
ShriD5/claude-mods:standup.description: /standup writes yesterday's standup (since Friday on Mondays) from your git commits and copies it

ShriD5/claude-mods:whoopgate.name: whoopgate
ShriD5/claude-mods:whoopgate.description: Live WHOOP heart rate in the status line; risky Bash commands are blocked while it is over your limit

MridulNegi2005/glyph-hud:..name: glyph-hud
MridulNegi2005/glyph-hud:..description: Dot-matrix HUD for Claude Code: chat tokens by model, 5-hour limit estimates, cache timer and code stats. Local only, no model calls.

3dnow/claude-mods:weektoken.name: weektoken
3dnow/claude-mods:weektoken.description: Rate-limit pace for Claude Code's 5-hour and weekly windows: usage against elapsed time, plain-language forecast, per-model quotas and burn-up history. A band above the prompt and a full /weektoken pane, in English or Chinese.

marcsstevenson/claude-mods:src/better-re.name: better-recap
marcsstevenson/claude-mods:src/better-re.description: A structured /recap, and a recap header with the session name, model and context use

rlpb/pitwall:..name: pitwall
rlpb/pitwall:..description: The pit wall for Claude Code: see what is loaded and what it costs, switch it on and off, and reconfigure with a built-in assistant, without leaving the session.

abyigiter/claude-usage-bar:usage-bar.name: usage-bar
abyigiter/claude-usage-bar:usage-bar.description: See your Claude Code session at a glance: context left, cost and today's spend, rate limits, git diff and PR status, right above the prompt. Set /budget limits and get a toast before you go over. Open the detail panel for context breakdown, turns, cache hit rate and top tools. Works in the CLI and the desktop Code tab.

lucenity0/claude-readout:..name: readout
lucenity0/claude-readout:..description: Shows which files Read opened, which lines, and what each search looked for, on the folded tool line

LucasAntunesdeAlmeida/laa-claude:plugins.name: laa-mods
LucasAntunesdeAlmeida/laa-claude:plugins.description: Mods for the laa toolkit: blocks file changes and commits on the default branch, shows laa status above the prompt, a pane to triage open learnings, and a /laa:retro nudge when a pipeline ends.

redzrush101/claude-mods:plugins/context-.name: context-meter
redzrush101/claude-mods:plugins/context-.description: Band above the prompt: context fill, prompt-cache countdown, usage limits, and a guard for resuming cold sessions

atomashevic/claude-latex-math:..name: latex-math
atomashevic/claude-latex-math:..description: Typesets the LaTeX math in Claude's replies as images in the terminal, through the kitty graphics protocol

Aaravkataria24/aarav-mods:plugins/clack.name: clack
Aaravkataria24/aarav-mods:plugins/clack.description: Mechanical keyboard sounds for Claude Code: you and Claude both clack, on 13 real switches, with a little keyboard that lights up.

Aaravkataria24/aarav-mods:plugins/drunk.name: drunk
Aaravkataria24/aarav-mods:plugins/drunk.description: Give Claude a /shot. It gets tipsy, then drunk, then wasted. It still does the work. Mostly.

Aaravkataria24/aarav-mods:plugins/sulky.name: sulky
Aaravkataria24/aarav-mods:plugins/sulky.description: Yell at Claude and it sulks. It still does the work. It just won't be happy about it.

CemalMertDal/clawdcraft:plugins/clawdcra.name: clawdcraft
CemalMertDal/clawdcraft:plugins/clawdcra.description: Watch Claude work in a 2D Minecraft world: Clawd fishes while fetching data, mines while searching, and a creeper blows up when something fails.

zwbao/longpi-mod:..name: longpi
zwbao/longpi-mod:..description: LongPi: turns Claude Code into your personal longevity coach.

clockendbader/dancing-claude:mods/deep-s.name: deep-space
clockendbader/dancing-claude:mods/deep-s.description: A deep-space themed Claude Code: space verbs, a starfield with a pixel mascot, local Spotify controls and a violet palette.

lperezmo/cache-caffeine:plugins/cache-ca.name: cache-caffeine
lperezmo/cache-caffeine:plugins/cache-ca.description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while you step away: a short poke before the cache expires, so the next turn reads the cache instead of writing it again. A row above the prompt turns it on and off and edits the message. Near the usage limit it books Claude a wake right after the reset.

pkkid/claude-mods:plugins/aitools.description: Subscription usage, API-equivalent cost and context bar above the prompt

tommy5dollar/claude-mods:effort-router.name: effort-router
tommy5dollar/claude-mods:effort-router.description: Picks the reasoning effort each task needs. Your session's own model assesses each of your first prompts, knowing what each level can do on that model, and moves the level only when it's confident. Then it locks. Subagents get their own level, chosen by the agent that starts them. The footer shows what it's doing, and /er report shows where your effort went.

alexcz-a11y/claude-mods:dispatch-pilot.name: dispatch-pilot
alexcz-a11y/claude-mods:dispatch-pilot.description: Dispatch Pilot: a decision model outside Claude (Jev or Clef, your choice) picks the main agent's reasoning effort each time you send a message (and when an agent's report or a task notice starts a turn), sets it on every request of the turn, and decides it again every few steps while the turn runs. It also picks the model and effort of each agent the main agent dispatches and of each agent a Workflow script starts, by Artificial Analysis benchmarks (sonnet and opus at medium effort at least). The main agent's model never changes, so the prompt cache survives (on a Claude Code subscription; not on Bedrock, Vertex or a gateway, where switching effort breaks the cache). It also keeps the full skill listing out of the main agent's context and suggests the few skills that fit each message; mid-turn, the main agent can look skills up with the find_skill tool. When an agent's tool calls keep failing it raises that agent's effort (a failing haiku agent goes on as sonnet), unless the failures are what the work expects.

alexcz-a11y/claude-mods:docs/research/ev.name: event-probe
alexcz-a11y/claude-mods:docs/research/ev.description: Observer: logs the order and payloads of the engine's events around a turn, to answer what the engine sends when.

davidho27941/cockpit:plugins/auto-handov.name: auto-handover

davidho27941/cockpit:plugins/blast-radiu.name: blast-radius

davidho27941/cockpit:plugins/gcloud-guar.description: Holds gcloud and gsutil commands that would create, change or delete cloud resources, shows the account, project, location and the current state of the targets, and asks you to Proceed or Cancel.

davidho27941/cockpit:plugins/secret-guar.name: secret-guard

Singh-AP/awesome-claude-mods:mods/cost/c.description: Always know what a session costs: live $ / context / rate-limit status line, the cost of every turn, context warnings, and an optional budget that asks before spending more.

Singh-AP/awesome-claude-mods:mods/safety.name: secret-shield

Tihi321/claude-mods:plugins/eol-guard.name: eol-guard
Tihi321/claude-mods:plugins/eol-guard.description: Keeps files' git line endings (CRLF/LF) after Claude's edits and shell commands, and stops prettier checks failing on a CRLF checkout.

Tihi321/claude-mods:plugins/mod-doctor.name: mod-doctor

Bearisbug/cc-mods:shot-view.description: 收集 Claude 截下或查看的 PNG，ctrl+x s 在侧边面板里看图；n/p 翻页，按住 o 在终端里放大、松开收起，轻按 o 用快速查看打开；看过的按 r 标为已读就不再出现（u 撤销）

Bearisbug/cc-mods:task-eta.name: task-eta
Bearisbug/cc-mods:task-eta.description: 长任务进度行：一轮跑满 3 分钟时让模型估一次剩余步骤，之后按工具调用推进状态栏里的步骤、进度条和剩余时间

himazintom/claude-code-sea:..name: sea
himazintom/claude-code-sea:..description: 入力欄の上に、真上から見た浅瀬の波をドット絵で動かす Claude Code のモッド。朝・夕焼け・夜が巡り、波の音 (Windows / macOS / Linux) と、ときどき Claude くんが遊びに来る。(非公式)

BuddyLim/claude-code-mod-parked:..name: parked
BuddyLim/claude-code-mod-parked:..description: A per-project backlog of items needing your attention, parked by you or the orchestrator

AskTinNguyen/ather-mods:ather-automata.name: ather-automata
AskTinNguyen/ather-mods:ather-automata.description: Ather Automata: what needs you and what is next in every S2 session and web app repository (Plan, Build, Prove, Ship), a newcomer tour, autonomy windows, and guards that catch false build passes and lost merge edits.

AskTinNguyen/ather-mods:week-calendar.name: week-calendar
