AskTinNguyen/ather-mods:week-calendar.description: Weekly calendar and agent-effectiveness report of Claude Code sessions: PRs merged and productive agent time per machine, published to a team repo

vutran-tvg/grammar-police:..name: grammar-police
vutran-tvg/grammar-police:..description: Blocks a prompt with a typo or a grammar error until you fix it

SorcererAres/CC-Usage-Band:usage-band.name: usage-band
SorcererAres/CC-Usage-Band:usage-band.description: A band above the prompt showing your 5-hour and 7-day limits, context window and prompt-cache hit rate, styled for the terminal and the desktop app

muellerei/enable-todo-tools:..name: enable-todo-tools
muellerei/enable-todo-tools:..description: Switches Claude Code's todo tools on for models that have them left out

muellerei/task-line:..name: task-line
muellerei/task-line:..description: One clean line per task list above the prompt, filled from Claude's own todo tools, same look in the terminal and the desktop app

zhuoxingzhang/pixel-at-work:..name: at-work
zhuoxingzhang/pixel-at-work:..description: A pixel-art animation above the prompt that shows what Claude is doing right now, with computer-science jokes on the spinner and holiday decorations

ben-rogerson/claude-counter-strike:..name: cs-radio
ben-rogerson/claude-counter-strike:..description: Counter-Strike 1.6 radio calls for Claude Code: 'Fire in the hole' on deploys, 'Bomb has been defused' when a long turn lands. /radio to toggle.

Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/auto.name: auto-checkpoint
Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/auto.description: Snapshots the working tree into hidden git refs at the start of every turn, with /checkpoints to list them and /undo-turn to roll back.

Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/bran.name: branch-guard
Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/bran.description: Stops Claude from editing files or running mutating git commands on main or master, and points it at a worktree instead.

Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/cost.name: cost-bar
Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/cost.description: A one-row band above the prompt with session cost, 5h/7d plan limits and an optional budget bar.

Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/file.name: file-tree-pane
Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/file.description: Adds /tree: a side pane with a lazy file tree coloured by git status. Press a file to put @path in the prompt.

Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/noti.name: notify-on-finish
Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/noti.description: Sends a desktop notification when a long turn finishes, so you can look away while Claude works.

Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/path.name: path-guard
Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/path.description: Blocks Write, Edit and MultiEdit calls that target a path outside the project root or inside .git, plus optional deny globs.

Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/powe.name: powerline-bar
Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/powe.description: A one-row powerline-style band above the prompt: directory, git branch and state, model, context fill.

Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/secr.name: secret-guard
Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/secr.description: Blocks Write, Edit and Bash calls that would put an API key, token or private key into a file or command.

Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/sens.name: sensitive-file-guard
Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/sens.description: Blocks Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob and Bash calls that touch .env files, private keys and credential stores.

Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/spin.name: spinner-stats
Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/spin.description: Adds elapsed time, the running tool and the tool-call count to Claude Code's own spinner.

Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/test.name: test-guard
Justmalhar/awesome-claude-mods:mods/test.description: Blocks edits that make tests pass by weakening them: new skip/only markers, fewer assertions, a gutted test file, or deleting a test file.

varunmoka7/side-chat:..name: side-chat
varunmoka7/side-chat:..description: Ask Claude a side question in a pane next to your work. The main conversation never sees it. Works like the desktop app's /btw.

whoisclebs/openspec-governance:..name: openspec-governance
whoisclebs/openspec-governance:..description: OpenSpec lifecycle governance for Claude Code: stage band, fail-closed edit gate, task progress and an append-only execution log.

az9713/claude-mod-pack:mod-pack.name: mod-pack
az9713/claude-mod-pack:mod-pack.description: A pack of small Claude Code mods that share the band above the prompt without overwriting each other. Turn each one on or off with /mods.

codejunkie99/claude-code-file-explorer:..name: file-explorer
codejunkie99/claude-code-file-explorer:..description: A file manager pane for Claude Code: colored tree, editable code, Git and PR diff, search, new/rename/delete.

yunjiaz7/claude-timeline-mod:..name: timeline
yunjiaz7/claude-timeline-mod:..description: A pane with one card per turn of the session: what you asked, what Claude did, what it touched. Click a card to jump to that turn.

philsimon/orange-prompt:..name: orange-prompt
philsimon/orange-prompt:..description: Paints the draft you are typing white on orange. Pair it with the Orange Dark theme to color your sent messages.

Amnesiac9/claude-mods:account-badge.name: account-badge
Amnesiac9/claude-mods:account-badge.description: Signed-in org abbreviation in the prompt footer

Amnesiac9/claude-mods:context-bar.name: context-bar
Amnesiac9/claude-mods:context-bar.description: Colored context-window fill bar in the prompt footer

Amnesiac9/claude-mods:usage-limits.name: usage-limits
Amnesiac9/claude-mods:usage-limits.description: 5-hour and weekly rate-limit bars in the prompt footer

reecelikesramen/claude-task-list:..name: task-list
reecelikesramen/claude-task-list:..description: Opt-in persistent task checklist: the agent asks to use it, the user approves, checks items off and alone can clear or disable it.

AbhiramDwivedi/claude-mods:plugins/pit-s.name: pit-stop
AbhiramDwivedi/claude-mods:plugins/pit-s.description: Keeps subagents small: tells the main agent how to size and split work, asks a growing subagent to checkpoint, and refuses its tools past a hard limit so a fresh agent takes over

AbhiramDwivedi/claude-mods:plugins/sessi.name: session-models
AbhiramDwivedi/claude-mods:plugins/sessi.description: Shows the main model, how many agents use each model (and how many are live), and warns about agent crowds and huge contexts

AbhiramDwivedi/claude-mods:plugins/usage.name: usage-limits
AbhiramDwivedi/claude-mods:plugins/usage.description: Keeps the 5-hour and weekly limit windows, their burn rate, a run-out projection, context fill, session cost and prompt-cache drops in a dim line above the prompt

juninmd/cc-litellm:plugins/litellm-key.name: litellm-key
juninmd/cc-litellm:plugins/litellm-key.description: See your LiteLLM virtual key inside Claude Code: budget, spend, limits, expiry, models and recent usage. Admins can also create and edit keys, grant extra budget and read router fallbacks.

sTomerG/agent-kit:plugins/crab-cam.name: crab-cam
sTomerG/agent-kit:plugins/crab-cam.description: A crab above the prompt acts out what Claude is doing: reading, writing code, thinking, searching and more. A shell beside it shows context and rate-limit usage.

ntkode/notkode-mods:jev/plugins/jev.name: jev
ntkode/notkode-mods:jev/plugins/jev.description: Jev picks the tool that fits Claude's next step and Claude gets it as a hint, shown live and measured against a control group. Native to Claude Code: no gateway, no proxy.

nmorton13/sidecast:..name: sidecast
nmorton13/sidecast:..description: A podcast player inside Claude Code: subscribe to feeds, browse episodes in a pane, and play them with a now-playing bar above the prompt

Vatroslav/cc-mod-ferro:plugin.name: cc-mod-ferro
Vatroslav/cc-mod-ferro:plugin.description: Ferro (a Norwich Terrier) runs across a pixel-art meadow in a band above the prompt while Claude works on a long turn; now and then she stops to poop, and after 3 minutes she falls asleep

Vatroslav/mod-ferro:plugin.name: cc-mod-ferro
Vatroslav/mod-ferro:plugin.description: Ferro (a Norwich Terrier) runs across a pixel-art meadow in a band above the prompt while Claude works on a long turn; now and then she stops to poop, and after 3 minutes she falls asleep

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/achievemen.name: achievement
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/achievemen.description: Playful badges unlocked once ever from real events (tool calls, turns, subagents, tests, git); /achievements lists them

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/agent-trac.name: agent-tracker
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/agent-trac.description: A pane listing the subagents launched this session with their status and duration

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/ascii-weat.name: ascii-weather
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/ascii-weat.description: Weather from wttr.in in the status line (refreshed at most once an hour); /weather shows the one-line forecast

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/auto-conte.name: auto-context
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/auto-conte.description: Adds git branch, dirty count, last commit and next TODOS to the session's system prompt

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/branch-gua.name: branch-guard
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/branch-gua.description: Asks the user before Edit/Write/NotebookEdit changes a file of a git repo whose current branch is main or master (once per repo and session)

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/build-gate.name: build-gate
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/build-gate.description: Band above the prompt when a turn changed source code without running a matching build or type-check

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/changed-fi.name: changed-files
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/changed-fi.description: A pane listing the files Claude modified during the session

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/ci-watch.name: ci-watch
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/ci-watch.description: Follows the GitHub Actions runs of a commit after git push: status line while they run, toast with the failed workflows and their link when they end

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/command-hi.name: command-history
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/command-hi.description: A pane listing the Bash commands run this session with exit status and duration

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/commit-lin.name: commit-lint
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/commit-lin.description: Refuses git commit commands whose message subject is not a Conventional Commit (type(scope)!: subject, header within a length limit)

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/commit-siz.name: commit-size-guard
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/commit-siz.description: Asks before a git commit or git add includes large files, big binaries or build/release artifacts (dmg, zip, app, ipa, xcarchive, DerivedData, node_modules, .build, release/)

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/compact-ad.name: compact-advisor
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/compact-ad.description: Toasts once when the context crosses a threshold; /compact-advisor prints a ready-to-paste /compact line with branch, edited files, open tasks and the last goal

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/context-ga.name: context-gauge
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/context-ga.description: A band above the prompt that appears when the context window is at least 70% full

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/cost-meter.name: cost-meter
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/cost-meter.description: Session cost and rate-limit usage in the status line; toasts when the cost crosses a threshold; /cost-meter summary

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/deriveddat.name: deriveddata-janitor
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/deriveddat.description: Finds Xcode DerivedData folders whose workspace is gone (removed worktrees), shows them in a status line and cleans them on an explicit command

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/diff-previ.name: diff-preview
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/diff-previ.description: A pane showing git diff --stat and the untracked file count, refreshed after each turn

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/doc-sync-g.name: doc-sync-guard
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/doc-sync-g.description: Warns above the prompt when a turn did not update COMMANDS.md, or changed code without updating CHANGES.md

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/done-sound.name: done-sound
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/done-sound.description: Plays a short chime when a long main-agent turn completes; /done-sound off|on|test

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/edit-undo.name: edit-undo
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/edit-undo.description: Snapshots each file before Claude's Edit/Write/NotebookEdit and lets you undo the last change per file from a pane or /undo <path>, with a two-step confirm

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/env-protec.name: env-protect
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/env-protec.description: Asks the user before Claude reads secret files (.env, private keys, .netrc, .npmrc, .aws/credentials, keychains…) with Read, Grep, Glob or Bash

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/flaky-dete.name: flaky-detector
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/flaky-dete.description: Spots test commands that failed then passed with no code edit in between, toasts once per command and lists them in a pane

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/focus-mode.name: focus-mode
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/focus-mode.description: A pomodoro: /focus [minutes] starts it, a band above the prompt counts down, a toast ends it

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/french-gua.name: french-guard
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/french-gua.description: Toasts when the last answer looks English or is French written without accents; /french-guard off|on|status

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/haiku-comm.name: haiku-commit
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/haiku-comm.description: After each successful git commit, toasts a 5-7-5 haiku about it (written by a small model, or from templates when the model is unavailable); /haiku-commit re-shows the last one

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/je-coupe.name: je-coupe
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/je-coupe.description: End-of-session ritual: typing 'je coupe' asks Claude to update the doc files and shows a band of the ones still untouched

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/lint-watch.name: lint-watch
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/lint-watch.description: Lints the files Claude just edited (SwiftLint, ESLint, Ruff, ShellCheck when available) in the background, with a status line count and a pane of issues

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/main-guard.name: main-guard
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/main-guard.description: Refuses git pushes to main/master, force pushes, tag creation and GitHub releases unless the person allows them

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/mood-band.name: mood-band
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/mood-band.description: A one-line mascot band above the prompt whose mood reflects the last turn (off by default: /mood on|off)

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/network-lo.name: network-log
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/network-lo.description: A pane listing the network activity of the session: web fetches, searches, MCP calls and network Bash commands

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/no-coautho.name: no-coauthor
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/no-coautho.description: Strips Co-Authored-By: Claude/Anthropic trailers from git commit messages before the commit runs

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/notary-wat.name: notary-watch
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/notary-wat.description: Follows Apple notarization submissions made with xcrun notarytool submit, directly or from a release script: status line while in progress, toast when accepted or invalid

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/path-fence.name: path-fence
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/path-fence.description: Asks the user before Edit, Write, NotebookEdit or simple Bash redirections/mv/cp/rm touch a path outside the session folder

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/port-pane.name: port-pane
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/port-pane.description: A pane listing the local TCP ports your processes listen on, marking those opened during the session, with two-step Stop and Force stop buttons

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/pr-status.name: pr-status
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/pr-status.description: A status line for the current branch's pull request: checks, review decision and merge state, refreshed after pushes and PR commands

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/probe-chec.name: probe-check
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/probe-chec.description: Toasts when a Bash verification probe is misleading: $? read after a pipeline, grep used as proof of absence, git grep ignoring untracked files

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/prompt-sni.name: prompt-snippets
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/prompt-sni.description: Reusable prompt fragments kept across sessions: /snip add|rm|list|show, and ;;name expands in prompts

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/release-ch.name: release-checklist
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/release-ch.description: A pane running pre-release checks for a macOS project and a post-release verification reminder

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/resume-bri.name: resume-brief
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/resume-bri.description: Adds a short 'where we left off' brief (last journal entries, memory state, in-progress plan phase) to the session's system prompt

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/rm-guard.name: rm-guard
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/rm-guard.description: Asks the user before destructive Bash commands run: rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean -f, discarding all changes, SQL DROP/TRUNCATE, find -delete, mkfs, dd onto a device

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/rtk-gain.name: rtk-gain
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/rtk-gain.description: A status line entry with the tokens RTK saved, refreshed at session start and at most every 5 minutes

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/secret-shi.name: secret-shield
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/secret-shi.description: Refuses Write, Edit and Bash calls that contain secret-looking values (API keys, tokens, private keys)

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/session-jo.name: session-journal
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/session-jo.description: A cross-session journal of turns per project, shown with /journal

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/session-re.name: session-recap
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/session-re.description: /recap: a pane (or copyable Markdown) summarising the session: duration, cost, files changed, commits, PRs and test/build runs

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/simulator-.name: simulator-pane
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/simulator-.description: A pane listing the booted iOS/watchOS/tvOS/visionOS simulators with two-step Shut down buttons, and an optional status line counting them

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/sparkle-gu.name: sparkle-guard
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/sparkle-gu.description: Protects the Sparkle EdDSA signing key: denies deleting it from the keychain, asks before generate_keys may create or import a key and before an edit changes an existing SUPublicEDKey

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/streak.name: streak
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/streak.description: Consecutive days with a completed turn, in the status line; toasts at 7, 30, 100 and 365 days; /streak summary

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/subagent-b.name: subagent-budget
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/subagent-b.description: Counts subagent spawns per turn and toasts once when a turn goes over budget; /subagent-budget shows the count, today's peak and the budget

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/todo-pane.name: todo-pane
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/todo-pane.description: A pane listing the checkboxes of the folder's TODOS.md, toggled with a press

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/tool-heatm.name: tool-heatmap
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/tool-heatm.description: A pane counting tool calls and failures per tool, main conversation and subagents together

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/turn-timer.name: turn-timer
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/turn-timer.description: A band above the prompt with the last turn's duration and tool calls; toasts on slow turns

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/typing-sta.name: typing-stats
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/typing-sta.description: Counts your prompts per local day (count, characters, hour of day, never the text) and shows today, the last 7 days and an hour histogram with /typing-stats

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/verify-bef.name: verify-before-claim
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/verify-bef.description: Warns when a turn changed code and claimed success without running a build, test or lint

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/worktree-p.name: worktree-pane
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/worktree-p.description: A pane listing the git worktrees of the session folder with branch, dirty count and DerivedData size, and removing a worktree together with its DerivedData

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/xcode-buil.name: xcode-build-watch
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/xcode-buil.description: Builds the Xcode project or Swift package in the background after a turn edits Swift files, and shows the result in the status line

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/xcodegen-s.name: xcodegen-sync
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/xcodegen-s.description: A band reminding to run xcodegen generate after project.yml changes or Swift files are added, removed or moved, with a button that runs it

vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/xcstrings-.name: xcstrings-check
vincentlauriat/ModsTools:mods/xcstrings-.description: Checks Xcode String Catalogs (.xcstrings) after Claude edits them or Swift files beside them: missing translations, new or needs-review states and stale entries per language

sameeeeeeep/ask-notch:..name: ask-notch
sameeeeeeep/ask-notch:..description: Claude's questions drop from your Mac's notch as a card. Click an option, pick with 1-4, type your own answer, or press esc to answer in Claude Code as usual.

davekiss/md:..name: md
davekiss/md:..description: Read, write and review markdown with Claude in a pane inside Claude Code: drafts stream in, comments stay on their words, and Claude suggests edits you accept or reject.

potto007/ottomation:plugins/live-vibe.name: live-vibe
potto007/ottomation:plugins/live-vibe.description: /live: full-duplex voice (Kyutai streaming STT with semantic end of turn, or Silero and Whisper; Kokoro TTS) through a sidecar; /vibe: director mode that delegates all work to subagents; /livevibe: talk with a fast voice front that hands the work to Claude as director.

yuyongyan29-dev/claude-pet:clawd-pet.name: clawd-pet
yuyongyan29-dev/claude-pet:clawd-pet.description: Clawd strolls above your prompt using the official clawd-quest pixel animations; reacts to what Claude is doing. /pet help for tricks.

RyanEmslie/prompt-posse:..name: prompt-posse
RyanEmslie/prompt-posse:..description: The boss and a posse of subagent creatures walk back and forth above the prompt while Claude Code works

oaustegard/claude-code-mods:tripwire.name: tripwire
oaustegard/claude-code-mods:tripwire.description: Catches recurring agent failures from past transcripts: whole-disk find, foreground poll loops, errors masked by | tail, forgotten background shells

oaustegard/claude-code-mods:usage-dollar.name: usage-dollars
oaustegard/claude-code-mods:usage-dollar.description: Shows spend in dollars for today and the month so far against a monthly budget, in the status line and /spend

benjaminr/nowplaying:..name: now-playing
benjaminr/nowplaying:..description: Shows the track playing in Apple Music or Spotify above the prompt, with cover art, play/pause, skip, volume, shuffle and repeat controls, a share-link copy and an Up next pane.

cephalofoil/kitt:pr-watch.name: pr-watch
cephalofoil/kitt:pr-watch.description: Above the prompt: the branch PR with its checks and failing log lines, uncommitted work with a commit-and-push key, and how far the branch is behind the default branch with a rebase key. The branch name sits in the hint line.

NovusEdge/a2a-mod:..name: a2a-mod
NovusEdge/a2a-mod:..description: A2A protocol client for Claude Code: Claude hands tasks to non-Claude worker agents over Agent2Agent and picks up their results.

lperezmo/session-relaunch:plugins/sessio.name: session-relaunch
lperezmo/session-relaunch:plugins/sessio.description: /relaunch restarts this Claude Code session in a new terminal tab with --resume <id>, so MCP servers added since it started are loaded.

starlabs007/claude-mod-usage-tracker:..name: usage-tracker
starlabs007/claude-mod-usage-tracker:..description: Shows 5-hour and weekly plan usage and the context window above the prompt

cbruyndoncx/claude-tasknotes-renderer-mo.name: tasknotes-preview
cbruyndoncx/claude-tasknotes-renderer-mo.description: Show Obsidian TaskNotes tasks from a .base view as a board, list, agenda or dependency graph in a Claude Desktop side pane

aholbreich/claude-mods:plugins/tl.name: tl
aholbreich/claude-mods:plugins/tl.description: Native TaskLedger summary and interactive task board for Claude Code.

facumarcet/archpane:plugins/archpane.name: archpane
facumarcet/archpane:plugins/archpane.description: Live architecture diagram in a side pane that Claude draws and edits while you talk

ahl-gram/IssueDial:..name: issue-dial
ahl-gram/IssueDial:..description: A picker-wheel pane for a GitHub repo's issues: the last three closed above, the issue in hand in the middle, the suggested next ones below.

angusmaul/claude-code-vikunja-tasks:..name: vikunja-tasks
angusmaul/claude-code-vikunja-tasks:..description: A live Vikunja pane for Claude Code: the Doing, Blocked and To-Do lanes, the task the session is working on, and a button to start a session on a task in its folder

thickiran/claude-live-scores:plugins/liv.name: live-scores
thickiran/claude-live-scores:plugins/liv.description: Live football scores in Claude Code: the top 5 European leagues and national teams in a dark scores pane, goal and red-card animations, and Claude mascots in team kits playing the live match above your prompt.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/bench.name: bench
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/bench.description: Measures a command: warmup and timed runs, median/p95/stddev and outliers, two commands compared or a saved baseline per project, and a pane with a block distribution plot. Bounded, one at a time, never during Claude's turn unless Claude asked.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/best-o.name: best-of-n
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/best-o.description: Runs 2-4 attempts at a task in parallel git worktrees, each with a different approach; compare their diffs and adopt the best.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/bisect.name: bisect
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/bisect.description: Finds the commit that broke something: git bisect with your test command in a temporary worktree (your working tree is never touched), live progress in a pane, the culprit with its diff stat handed to Claude.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/canvas.name: canvas
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/canvas.description: Gives Claude a screen to draw on: SVG diagrams and Markdown reports in a Canvas pane with history.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/counci.name: council
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/counci.description: More than one mind: ask several models at once and get a synthesis, critique the last answer, and let Claude consult another model.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/data-p.name: data-peek
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/data-p.description: Look into CSV, TSV, JSON and JSON Lines files without dumping them into context: schema, stats, rows, filters, group counts and single-row lookups, exact and compact, streamed with caps; a /peek pane with column sparklines.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/gh-inb.name: gh-inbox
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/gh-inb.description: GitHub issues and pull requests in a pane — one press to have Claude work on an issue or review a PR — plus the current branch's PR checks in the readout.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/http-l.name: http-lab
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/http-l.description: An HTTP tool for API work: status, timing, trimmed headers and a body shaped to fit; localhost runs freely, other hosts ask once a session; an /http pane of the session's requests with replay and copy-as-curl.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/plan-b.name: plan-board
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/plan-b.description: A live plan Claude posts and keeps current: progress above the prompt, the full checklist and its history in a pane.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/recall.name: recall
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/recall.description: Search this project's past sessions: /recall for you (attach an old exchange to your next prompt), a tool for Claude to look up earlier decisions.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/repo-m.name: repo-map
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/repo-m.description: A compact, cached map of the repository for Claude: files by folder with sizes and each source file's symbols with line numbers, sized to a token budget, instead of reading files to get its bearings.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/slim.name: slim
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/slim.description: Shrinks the context without losing the conversation: bulky old tool results become one-line stubs, every message stays word for word.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/spec-r.name: spec-runner
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/spec-r.description: Works through a Markdown checklist item by item: one prompt per item, an optional check command, the box ticked when it passes.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/swarm.name: swarm
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/swarm.description: Splits a task into independent parts, runs them as parallel subagents you launch and watch live, then hands their results back for integration.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/watchd.name: watchdog
mako-code/gobworks:mods/abilities/watchd.description: Runs your dev server or watcher for the session, flags its errors above the prompt, and lets Claude read its output.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/auto-ret.name: auto-retry
mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/auto-ret.description: Keeps long sessions going through API errors and rate limits: resubmits after a backoff when idle, waits out rate limits with a countdown, never loops, and stops the moment you type.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/ci-autop.name: ci-autopilot
mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/ci-autop.description: CI that fixes itself with your say-so: watches the branch's workflow run after a push, puts a failure with its error-dense log on the band with Fix it, surfaces new review comments, and can pre-review PRs you are asked to review.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/daily-br.name: daily-brief
mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/daily-br.description: The first session of your day starts with a briefing: what changed since you left, what waits on you, your work in flight, a first step and a standup draft.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/dep-sent.name: dep-sentinel
mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/dep-sent.description: Audits the project's dependencies once a day in the background (npm, pnpm, yarn, pip-audit, cargo audit) and flags high-severity vulnerabilities above the prompt, with details and a one-press safe upgrade by Claude.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/env-doct.name: env-doctor
mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/env-doct.description: Catches a broken dev environment before Claude trips on it: wrong Node/Python/Go versions, missing node_modules, .env gaps, merges or rebases in progress.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/follow-u.name: follow-ups
mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/follow-u.description: The things Claude told you to do yourself, never lost: captured from answers, kept per project, mirrored to .claude/follow-ups.md, one press to finish, snooze or hand back to Claude.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/fresh-st.name: fresh-start
mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/fresh-st.description: Notices when a session is getting heavy (full context, repeated compactions, slow turns, tool errors), prepares a handoff in the background, and offers a one-press fresh start that continues from it.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/idle-com.name: idle-compact
mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/idle-com.description: Compacts the conversation while you are away, a few idle minutes in and before the prompt cache goes cold, instead of in the middle of your work.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/lesson-l.name: lesson-learner
mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/lesson-l.description: Claude gets better at your project without you writing rules: your corrections and the command errors Claude fixes become one-press lessons for CLAUDE.md.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/night-sh.name: night-shift
mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/night-sh.description: Works your backlog while you are away: when idle, one worker at a time implements the next .claude/backlog.md task in its own git worktree under a strict tool policy and budget; in the morning you review, adopt or discard each branch.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/pair-wat.name: pair-watcher
mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/pair-wat.description: Claude knows what you changed between turns: files edited outside Claude are named (with small diffs) beside your next prompt, and an optional cheap review flags slips in your own edits.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/test-rad.name: test-radar
mako-code/gobworks:mods/ambient/test-rad.description: Runs the tests related to each change (Claude's edits and yours) in the background; a failure caused by Claude's edit reaches Claude mid-turn, and the band offers Show and Fix it.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/auto-c.name: auto-context
mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/auto-c.description: Say "this error", "the tests", "this file", "what you just did" or "the plan" and what it points at goes along with your prompt: the failing output, the test failures, the file, the diff, the plan. No model calls, size-capped, never twice, and Remove takes it back.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/auto-c.name: auto-continue
mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/auto-c.description: Keeps work flowing: when Claude stops mid-task ("Next I'll…") or asks an obvious yes ("Shall I continue?"), a 5-second countdown you can stop sends a short continue. Never for choices, missing info or risky steps.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/auto-p.name: auto-polish
mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/auto-p.description: Every prompt you type gets a quiet second read: without changing your words, a hidden note gives Claude the goal in one line, the likely scope, the project's checks to keep green, and what done means. Haiku only for vague prompts; See, Undo and Off in the band.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/auto-r.name: auto-review
mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/auto-r.description: A quick second pair of eyes after edits: reviews the turn's diff in the background and offers to fix what it finds.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/lint-f.name: lint-feedback
mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/lint-f.description: Runs your linter on every file Claude edits and hands the errors back with the edit's result, so Claude fixes them right away.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/loop-b.name: loop-breaker
mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/loop-b.description: Notices when Claude is stuck repeating itself (same failing call, same output, edit flip-flops, failure streaks) and tells it to change approach.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/queue.name: queue
mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/queue.description: A prompt queue that runs itself: line up prompts with /queue and they run one after another, pausing when Claude asks you something or a turn fails.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/reboun.name: rebound
mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/reboun.description: Sharper retries after a failed turn: when checks still fail, Claude gives up, errors loop, or you say "that didn't work", haiku drafts a retry with the lesson, a different approach and the exact failing output. One click sends it.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/stub-d.name: stub-detector
mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/stub-d.description: No lazy placeholders: flags TODOs, '... rest of code', NotImplemented stubs and empty bodies an edit introduces, nudges Claude to finish them, and lists what is left.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/task-s.name: task-splitter
mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/task-s.description: One prompt, several jobs: when a prompt you type holds independent tasks (a list, numbered steps, "do A, then B, and also C"), offers to run them one by one as their own turns, stopping at the first that fails or asks you something.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/turn-g.name: turn-governor
mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/turn-g.description: Caps runaway turns: asks, stops or warns when one turn passes a step, time or cost limit.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/verify.name: verify-loop
mako-code/gobworks:mods/autopilot/verify.description: Runs your project's checks after Claude edits, shows pass/fail above the prompt, and closes the loop with one-press (or automatic, bounded) fixes.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/core/mod-manager.name: mod-manager
mako-code/gobworks:mods/core/mod-manager.description: The Gobworks manager: browse every mod by category, see what each does and costs, turn mods and presets on or off, and check them. Best standalone in any terminal (gobworks); inside a running Claude Code session too (/mods).

mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/achievements.name: achievements
mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/achievements.description: A little game layer: 32 achievements for how you use Claude Code, with lifetime progress and a /achievements pane.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/arcade.name: arcade
mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/arcade.description: Something to do during long turns: /snake and /2048 in a pane, with high scores and a nudge when Claude is done.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/gob-pet.name: gob-pet
mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/gob-pet.description: Gob as a Tamagotchi-style companion who lives off your work: finished turns, green tests and commits grow him, and /pet lets you feed, play with, pet, nap and dress him. Free, and he never punishes you.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/narrator.name: narrator
mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/narrator.description: Opt-in: after a long turn, hear one spoken sentence about what Claude did.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/notify.name: notify
mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/notify.description: A chime, a toast and an optional webhook when Claude finishes a long turn or needs your permission.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/spinner-them.name: spinner-themes
mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/spinner-them.description: Themed words for the waiting line (pirate, space, kitchen, ...) plus live output speed and step count.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/timestamps.name: timestamps
mako-code/gobworks:mods/fun/timestamps.description: Shows when you sent each prompt ([14:32]) and when each turn finished.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev.name: jev
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev.description: Jev (TypeSafe's System One model) as Claude's instant co-processor: bulk filter/classify/rank/semantic-grep tools, risk notes under permission dialogs, a check on unverified 'it passes' claims, and optional per-prompt effort.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-autoperm.name: jev-autopermit
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-autoperm.description: Opt-in instant approval for clearly harmless shell commands: a strict pre-filter, then Jev classifies the command; only read-only inspection at ≥ 97% with no network risk skips the permission dialog. Every approval is logged.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-comments.name: jev-comments
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-comments.description: No narrating comments: every comment an edit adds is judged by Jev in a few hundred ms; 'Added X as requested' and friends go back to Claude.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-conventi.name: jev-conventions
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-conventi.description: Instant repo-convention checks on every edit: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, style guides and config facts compiled into atomic rules, each edit judged against all of them by Jev in a few hundred ms.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-docdrift.name: jev-docdrift
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-docdrift.description: Docs that went stale because of this turn's changes: changed names, flags, env vars and config keys are looked up in the docs, and Jev reads each section against the new code.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-express.name: jev-express
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-express.description: Reflexes: short read-only requests (git status, diff stat, recent commits, cost, context) answered locally in an Express pane, no model turn.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-judge.name: jev-judge
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-judge.description: A definition of done Jev checks after every turn: per-criterion probabilities that demand evidence, a band above the prompt, optional auto-continue.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-mood.name: jev-mood
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-mood.description: Claude adapts to how you are doing: Jev reads each prompt's tone in a blink and, when the signal is strong, hands Claude one hidden line of guidance. Silent by default.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-ping.name: jev-ping
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-ping.description: Notifications only when you are actually needed: after each turn Jev reads whether Claude asks you something, is stuck, or finished a long task; permission prompts ping too. Toast, chime, optional webhook.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-precommi.name: jev-precommit
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-precommi.description: A commit gate that reads the staged diff in a blink: Jev flags debug output, commented-out code, TODOs, machine paths, secrets and off-message changes before Claude's git commit runs.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-reuse.name: jev-reuse
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-reuse.description: "This helper already exists": new functions are compared against a git-grep symbol index, Jev judges the look-alikes in a few hundred ms, and Claude hears about duplicates.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-scope.name: jev-scope
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-scope.description: Keeps changes on task: every edit is judged by Jev against your last request (and Claude's plan) in a few hundred ms; drive-by changes go back to Claude.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-scout.name: jev-scout
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-scout.description: Jev ranks every file in the repo against each prompt in ~0.5 s and hands Claude the likely relevant ones (System-1 file triage).

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-seclint.name: jev-seclint
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-seclint.description: An instant security reviewer on every code edit: ~20 yes/no checks per edit answered by Jev in a few hundred ms, fed back to Claude.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-test-gua.name: jev-test-guard
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-test-gua.description: Catches tests being weakened to make them pass: every test-file edit is judged by Jev in a few hundred ms against what you asked for.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-topic.name: jev-topic
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-topic.description: Jev notices when a prompt starts an unrelated task and offers a fresh conversation for it, saving context and prompt cache.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-triage.name: jev-triage
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-triage.description: Every failed Bash/PowerShell command gets an instant Jev diagnosis (15 failure classes) and a playbook in this project's terms, as a note Claude reads.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-trim.name: jev-trim
mako-code/gobworks:mods/jev/jev-trim.description: Huge Bash/PowerShell outputs cut to the lines that matter: Jev scores every 12-line chunk against your request, the full log is saved for Claude to open.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/memory/compact-k.name: compact-keeper
mako-code/gobworks:mods/memory/compact-k.description: Compaction without amnesia: archives the full transcript before each compaction and tells the summarizer to keep paths, decisions, preferences, TODOs and working commands.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/memory/file-rada.name: file-radar
mako-code/gobworks:mods/memory/file-rada.description: What Claude touched this session: reads, edits (+/− lines), searches per file, main vs subagent, with flags for blind edits and repeated reads.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/memory/git-panel.name: git-panel
mako-code/gobworks:mods/memory/git-panel.description: Git at a glance and in reach: a branch/changes readout, a /git pane to diff, stage, revert and commit, and Conventional Commit messages written by haiku.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/memory/handoff.name: handoff
mako-code/gobworks:mods/memory/handoff.description: /handoff writes a structured handoff (goal, state, decisions, files, next steps, gotchas, how to verify) to .claude/handoffs/; /handoff load hands it to a later session.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/memory/journal.name: journal
mako-code/gobworks:mods/memory/journal.description: Project memory across sessions: every few turns haiku writes what was done, decided and left open to .claude/journal.md, and new conversations start with the latest entries.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/memory/snapshots.name: snapshots
mako-code/gobworks:mods/memory/snapshots.description: Whole-tree time travel: a git snapshot of every non-ignored file before each turn, with diff, restore and /undo, never touching HEAD, the index or the stash.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/clarif.name: clarifier
mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/clarif.description: Ask before guessing: when a prompt looks ambiguous, Claude asks up to three clarifying questions first. Off until /clarify on.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/contex.name: context-macros
mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/contex.description: Inline #tokens that attach live context to a prompt: #diff, #staged, #log:20, #tree, #todo, #errors, #file:path:10-40, #url:https://...

mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/effort.name: effort-prefix
mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/effort.description: Set the effort for one prompt with a caret prefix: ^max, ^xhigh, ^high, ^med, ^low (^^ = max, ^ = high).

mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/modes.name: modes
mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/modes.description: Switchable working styles (teach, terse, pair, review, tdd, explore, ship, or your own) applied to every prompt you send.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/next-s.name: next-steps
mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/next-s.description: One-tap follow-ups: after each answer, three short next prompts above the prompt, on keys 1-3.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/pins.name: pins
mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/pins.description: Standing context you control: pin notes and files once, and every prompt you send carries them.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/projec.name: project-primer
mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/projec.description: Starts every conversation oriented: one context block with the repo, branch, layout, stack and its build/test/lint/run commands, README summary and recent commits.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/prompt.name: prompt-history
mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/prompt.description: Every prompt you write, kept across sessions and projects: /history searches them and puts one back in the prompt box.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/prompt.name: prompt-polish
mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/prompt.description: Rough idea in, precise prompt out: /polish or a trailing ?? rewrites your prompt into the input box for you to edit and send.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/prompt.name: prompt-stash
mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/prompt.description: Park a half-written prompt, ask something else, and pop it back into the box later.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/snippe.name: snippets
mako-code/gobworks:mods/prompting/snippe.description: Text expansion in the prompt box: type ;plan and a space, get the full instruction.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/bash-guar.name: bash-guard
mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/bash-guar.description: Blocks catastrophic shell commands (rm -rf ~, curl | sh, force-push to main, DROP DATABASE, format C:) and asks before risky ones (git reset --hard, rm -rf, terraform apply), in Bash and PowerShell.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/branch-gu.name: branch-guard
mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/branch-gu.description: Keeps work off protected branches: no commit, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, am or push on main/master/release/* (or an explicit push to one), with an optional auto-branch for commits.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/clobber-g.name: clobber-guard
mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/clobber-g.description: Stops accidental truncation of real code: no "// ... rest of the code" placeholders over real code, and a question before a Write or Edit throws away most of a file.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/package-s.name: package-scout
mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/package-s.description: Supply-chain check before installs: npm/pnpm/yarn/bun/npx, pip/uv/poetry/pipx, cargo and gem packages are looked up first; nonexistent names are refused, brand-new, unpopular, deprecated or lookalike ones need your yes.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/path-guar.name: path-guard
mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/path-guar.description: Protected files and a project boundary: Claude can't edit .env, keys or .git, asks before touching lockfiles and migrations, and asks before writing outside the project.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/permissio.name: permission-coach
mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/permissio.description: Notices the commands you keep approving by hand and offers a one-click standing allow rule (never for risky or interpreter-wide commands).

mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/readonly-.name: readonly-mode
mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/readonly-.description: "Look, don't touch": /readonly on blocks edits and every command that is not provably read-only, and tells Claude to investigate and explain instead.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/secret-sh.name: secret-shield
mako-code/gobworks:mods/safety/secret-sh.description: Keeps credentials out of your code, your shell commands and Claude's context: blocks hard-coded secrets in edits, asks before commands with literal keys, redacts secrets from tool results and flags them in prompts.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tandem/commit-cr.name: commit-craft
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tandem/commit-cr.description: Commit messages in your repository's own style (learned from its last 30 subjects) and pull request descriptions from the branch, drafted by haiku; nothing is committed or pushed without a press.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tandem/haiku-fir.name: haiku-first
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tandem/haiku-fir.description: Opt-in: questions about the codebase (where is, what does, how does, which file, find) go to a read-only haiku scout subagent first; its answer comes with Ask Claude anyway and Good enough, and the tokens saved.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tandem/live-tick.name: live-ticker
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tandem/live-tick.description: During long turns, haiku writes one line above the prompt every ~30 s on what Claude is doing and what comes next, from a compact log of its tool calls; a one-line recap toast after turns over two minutes.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tandem/side-chat.name: side-chat
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tandem/side-chat.description: A side conversation with haiku or sonnet in a pane, kept out of Claude's context: attach Claude's last answer, the diff, the plan or a file on demand, then send the answer or a summary to the prompt box.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tandem/test-draf.name: test-drafter
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tandem/test-draf.description: Opt-in: after a turn that adds or changes functions, sonnet (or haiku) drafts focused unit tests in the background, in the repo's framework and style; Review, Add & run (only that file), or Dismiss; never writes without a press; daily budget cap.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/cache-.name: cache-lens
mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/cache-.description: Prompt-cache hit rate, a live warm/cold countdown, cache-bust alerts with likely causes, savings, and optional keep-warm pings.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/contex.name: context-gauge
mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/contex.description: Context-window gauge: a fill bar in the readout, toasts as it fills, a /ctx breakdown pane with Compact now, and optional auto-compaction between turns.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/cost-m.name: cost-meter
mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/cost-m.description: Spend tracking across sessions: session and today's cost in the readout, daily and weekly budgets with toasts and an optional hard stop, and a /spend pane.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/explai.name: explain-command
mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/explai.description: Plain English under every permission prompt: what the command does and how risky it is.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/hud.name: hud
mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/hud.description: One compact status line: model, context fill, cache hit and warm countdown, session cost, the fullest rate limit, and git branch with changed files.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/rate-r.name: rate-radar
mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/rate-r.description: Subscription rate limits at a glance: each window and its reset in the readout, toasts at 75% and 90% and when your pace beats the reset, and a /limits pane.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/subage.name: subagent-monitor
mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/subage.description: Every subagent, live: a /subagents pane with status, model, elapsed time, steps, tokens, last tool and answer, plus a band while any run.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/tldr.name: tldr
mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/tldr.description: A one-line TL;DR under long answers, written by haiku.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/tool-s.name: tool-stopwatch
mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/tool-s.description: Tool latency: times every tool call, shows a live timer for slow ones, and a /stopwatch pane with per-tool averages, p95, max and the slowest calls.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/turn-r.name: turn-receipt
mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/turn-r.description: A receipt for every turn: tools, tokens, cache hits, estimated cost and lines changed, on the turn's closing line (or in the transcript), with a /receipts pane.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/usage-.name: usage-dashboard
mako-code/gobworks:mods/telemetry/usage-.description: A /dashboard pane charting this session's turns (prompt tokens by cache kind, hit rate, cost) and your last 14 days of spend.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/agent-rou.name: agent-router
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/agent-rou.description: Picks the model for each subagent by its type (Explore on Haiku by default) and can cap how many run at once.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/attributi.name: attribution
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/attributi.description: Your commit and pull request credit line, your way: Claude Code's default, none, or your own template with {model}.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/autotune.name: autotune
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/autotune.description: Per-prompt effort autopilot: classifies each prompt (Jev, Claude Haiku, or heuristics) and sets that turn's effort, and optionally its model, only when the switch beats the prompt-cache rewrite it causes.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/cache-gua.name: cache-guard
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/cache-gua.description: Asks before /model, /output-style, /fast, /effort, MCP or plugin changes and /config rows that would throw away a warm prompt cache, with the cost of rewriting it; names the rebuilds it could not prevent.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/context-f.name: context-forecast
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/context-f.description: Forecasts how many turns remain until auto-compaction from smoothed per-turn context growth (tool output vs conversation), and at natural breaks offers Compact now with a focus Haiku drafts.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/delta-rea.name: delta-reads
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/delta-rea.description: When Claude re-reads a file that changed since it last read it, it gets only the changed hunks (current line numbers, a few context lines) instead of the whole file.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/output-tr.name: output-trimmer
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/output-tr.description: Huge Bash/PowerShell outputs without the context bill: Claude gets the head and tail, the full text goes to a file it can open.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/paste-shr.name: paste-shrinker
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/paste-shr.description: Asks before sending a huge pasted log, stack trace, JSON or CSV: shrink it to a digest (head, tail, error lines) and save the full text under .claude/pastes, or send it as is.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/prompt-in.name: prompt-inspector
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/prompt-in.description: See the system prompt section by section with sizes, and switch sections off for a project.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/read-cach.name: read-cache
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/read-cach.description: Stops Claude from re-reading a file it already read in full and that has not changed since; counts the tokens saved.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/reminder-.name: reminder-filter
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/reminder-.description: See the reminders and notices Claude Code injects for the model, by type and size, and mute the ones you do not want.

mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/tool-diet.name: tool-diet
mako-code/gobworks:mods/tuning/tool-diet.description: See which tools fill the prompt, grouped by MCP server, and move them behind ToolSearch (or pin them in) per project.

PickleBoxer/peek:..name: peek
PickleBoxer/peek:..description: Thumbnails above the prompt for every image you paste

myUdav4iik/claude-mods:context-bar.name: context-bar
myUdav4iik/claude-mods:context-bar.description: A context-window breakdown bar above the prompt, toggled with /context-bar

myUdav4iik/claude-mods:done-sound.name: done-sound
myUdav4iik/claude-mods:done-sound.description: Plays a macOS system sound when Claude finishes a turn

Triyambak-CA/claude-mods:plugins/pace-me.name: pace-meter
Triyambak-CA/claude-mods:plugins/pace-me.description: A band above the prompt: a pace bar and a forecast for the 5-hour and weekly plan limits.

Hangghost/learning-hacker-claude-mod:plu.name: dispatch-board
Hangghost/learning-hacker-claude-mod:plu.description: 多個 Claude Code session 分工時的派工看板：讀你寫的 mission 檔，顯示誰完成、誰在跑、誰在等你，狀態轉換時跳 toast

Hangghost/learning-hacker-claude-mod:plu.name: handoff-runner
Hangghost/learning-hacker-claude-mod:plu.description: bg session 在 worktree 做完的分支，由你在面板按一顆按鈕快轉進 main：交接單只帶參數，步驟由 mod 推導，執行前檢查、執行後驗證

Hangghost/learning-hacker-claude-mod:plu.name: working-memory
Hangghost/learning-hacker-claude-mod:plu.description: 把 context window 畫成一顆腦：工具呼叫點亮對應腦區，用量越滿越擁擠，compact 時睡眠整理

polus-1/buddy-mod:..name: buddy
polus-1/buddy-mod:..description: Buddy is back: the retired /buddy terminal companion as a Claude Code mod, with new sprites and Haiku writing its lines.

cglremrcn/pixlings:plugins/pixlings.name: pixlings
cglremrcn/pixlings:plugins/pixlings.description: A tiny pixel creature that lives above your Claude Code prompt. It counts down your prompt cache and guards it on model switches, wakes Claude when your usage limit resets, brings a helper for every subagent, makes sound on Windows and Linux, yelps before risky commands, rolls its eyes at "You're absolutely right", and brings back your old /buddy.

alamine42/claude-mods:plugins/ci-pipelin.name: ci-pipeline
alamine42/claude-mods:plugins/ci-pipelin.description: A pane that shows where the current branch is in the CI/CD pipeline, from local dev to prod smoke tests

alamine42/claude-mods:plugins/my-actions.name: my-actions
alamine42/claude-mods:plugins/my-actions.description: A band above the prompt that lists the actions and questions the agent left for you

Grandullon/diariovida-mods:plugins/en-cr.name: en-cristiano
Grandullon/diariovida-mods:plugins/en-cr.description: Debajo de cada acción de Claude, una línea en español normal que explica qué está haciendo (leer, crear, mover, borrar, buscar...). Para entender a Claude sin saber informática.

Grandullon/diariovida-mods:plugins/mejor.name: mejora-prompts
Grandullon/diariovida-mods:plugins/mejor.description: /mejora y una frase: Claude te hace 3-5 preguntas, escribe un prompt con contexto (sin rol), lo puntúa y lo corrige hasta el 9/10, con bucle o sin bucle. Método de diariovida.com.

Grandullon/diariovida-mods:plugins/mis-r.name: mis-reglas
Grandullon/diariovida-mods:plugins/mis-r.description: Tu Claude se ve distinto: una franja encima del cuadro de texto con tus reglas activas y el «pensando» en español castizo.

Grandullon/diariovida-mods:plugins/modo-.name: modo-grabacion
Grandullon/diariovida-mods:plugins/modo-.description: Modo grabación: /grabar oculta en pantalla correos, rutas de usuario, IPs, claves y los nombres que tú elijas, para grabar sin enseñar datos

Grandullon/diariovida-mods:plugins/papel.name: papelera
Grandullon/diariovida-mods:plugins/papel.description: Cuando Claude va a borrar algo, en vez de borrarlo lo manda a una papelera (~/.papelera-claude) para que puedas recuperarlo. /papelera te enseña qué hay dentro.

andras-gyarmati/claude-quota-band:..name: quota-band
andras-gyarmati/claude-quota-band:..description: Your Claude plan's 5h and weekly usage, the context window and the prompt cache's time left, as one line of bars above the prompt

ofeklevy11/claude-code-hud:session-hud.name: session-hud
ofeklevy11/claude-code-hud:session-hud.description: Session Tracker above the prompt box: context window with a /compact recommendation, 5-hour plan limit, prompt clocks and session cost.

cbruyndoncx/claude-diagrams-renderer-mod.name: diagram-preview
cbruyndoncx/claude-diagrams-renderer-mod.description: Show Obsidian vault diagrams (.canvas, Excalidraw, draw.io, BPMN) as SVG in Claude Desktop side panes, with landscape/portrait and zoom

DustinVerzal/magic-router:..name: magic-router
DustinVerzal/magic-router:..description: Routes each session to Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5 and each prompt to an effort level, using a local GLiNER2.5 classifier

buildwithpulkit/plug-into-claude:plugins.name: tangents
buildwithpulkit/plug-into-claude:plugins.description: Go off on a tangent about any paragraph of Claude's replies, kept out of the main context until you promote it

diegocamara89/claude-mods:mods/lixeira.name: lixeira
diegocamara89/claude-mods:mods/lixeira.description: Troca o apagar de vez pela lixeira do sistema e barra comandos sem volta (git reset --hard, push --force, formatar) até o sim do usuário

diegocamara89/claude-mods:mods/painel-vi.name: painel-vivo
diegocamara89/claude-mods:mods/painel-vi.description: Painel com o que está rodando: saída ao vivo, porcentagem, subagentes, contexto e cota, registro da sessão, explicação para leigo e glossário

diegocamara89/claude-mods:mods/proximos-.name: proximos-passos
diegocamara89/claude-mods:mods/proximos-.description: Depois de cada resposta, o Haiku propõe três próximos pedidos em botões acima da caixa de mensagem (teclas 1-3)

diegocamara89/claude-mods:mods/revisor-c.name: revisor-com-prova
diegocamara89/claude-mods:mods/revisor-c.description: Quando volta o resultado de um revisor (Codex, agy, council), lembra o Claude de que achado sem prova não conta e de reproduzir antes de corrigir

diegocamara89/claude-mods:mods/sonnet-po.name: sonnet-por-padrao
diegocamara89/claude-mods:mods/sonnet-po.description: Subagente e agente de script (Workflow) criados sem modelo escrito rodam no Sonnet em vez de herdar o Opus; Opus só quando pedido de propósito

diegocamara89/claude-mods:mods/varredura.name: varredura-push
diegocamara89/claude-mods:mods/varredura.description: Antes de git push ou publicação pelo gh, procura chave, token e senha nos commits que vão subir (gitleaks, com regras de reserva) e barra o envio se achar

GrzeskoByte/claude-work-visualized:..name: work-visualized
GrzeskoByte/claude-work-visualized:..description: Claude Work Visualized: a live, animated map of the project showing where Claude reads, edits, creates and deletes files

griches/claude-xcode-mod:..name: xcpane
griches/claude-xcode-mod:..description: Turns xcodebuild and swift build output into a live pane of errors grouped by file, and hands Claude the diagnostics instead of the raw log.

griches/xcpane:..name: xcpane
griches/xcpane:..description: Turns xcodebuild and swift build output into a live pane of errors grouped by file, and hands Claude the diagnostics instead of the raw log.

yedidyakfir/heavens-feel:..name: heavens-feel
yedidyakfir/heavens-feel:..description: Heaven's Feel cast for your agents: Sakura watches over the main session, Servants answer every subagent

Land-o-Clusters/sleight:plugins/sleight.name: sleight
Land-o-Clusters/sleight:plugins/sleight.description: Unofficial: lets Claude drive macOS apps in the background through the computer-use engine bundled with the ChatGPT desktop app, without taking over your cursor.

tylergraydev/cc-mods:arcade.name: arcade
tylergraydev/cc-mods:arcade.description: Tic-tac-toe, sudoku, tetris, video poker, blackjack and UNO in a side pane, playable by keyboard, mouse or an Xbox controller

tylergraydev/cc-mods:booster-pane.name: booster-pane
tylergraydev/cc-mods:booster-pane.description: Open pretend Pokémon TCG booster packs by set in a side pane: card art in the terminal, a collection and pull stats

tylergraydev/cc-mods:dev-doctor.name: dev-doctor
tylergraydev/cc-mods:dev-doctor.description: Read-only environment checks on session start (bash on PATH, .NET SDK/runtime, ports, git locks, worktrees, Docker, AUTH_SECRET, Node, Worker) with a status line, toast and pane

tylergraydev/cc-mods:gb-pane.name: gb-pane
tylergraydev/cc-mods:gb-pane.description: Play Game Boy and Game Boy Color games in a side pane with /gb; they pause when Claude finishes or needs you.

tylergraydev/cc-mods:gba-pane.name: gba-pane
tylergraydev/cc-mods:gba-pane.description: Play Game Boy Advance games in a side pane with /gba; they pause when Claude finishes or needs you.

tylergraydev/cc-mods:guardrail.name: guardrail
tylergraydev/cc-mods:guardrail.description: Blocks hook-skipping git commands and live data operations that have no successful dry run first; you can allow one at a time

tylergraydev/cc-mods:inbox.name: inbox
tylergraydev/cc-mods:inbox.description: A task inbox kept as markdown files in .inbox/: create tasks, deploy subagents on them one by one or as a drain, watch their progress, a watchdog for idle workers and cross-session locks

tylergraydev/cc-mods:mod-menu.name: mod-menu
tylergraydev/cc-mods:mod-menu.description: Manage mods, plugins, skills, hooks and MCP servers: tag them, switch profiles, sync your loadout via gh

tylergraydev/cc-mods:nes-pane.name: nes-pane
tylergraydev/cc-mods:nes-pane.description: Play NES games in a side pane with /nes; they pause when Claude finishes or needs you.

tylergraydev/cc-mods:sound-board.name: sound-board
tylergraydev/cc-mods:sound-board.description: Plays a distinct sound for subagent spawn/finish/failure, permission asks, auto-mode denials, finished turns and more; pick, preview and mute per cue

tylergraydev/cc-mods:workbench.name: workbench
tylergraydev/cc-mods:workbench.description: Hosts other mods' panes in one docked pane split into left and right columns; drag a tab across the divider to move a mod

alexknowshtml/claude-auto-handoff:..name: auto-handoff
alexknowshtml/claude-auto-handoff:..description: Hands a Claude Code session off to a fresh one before the context fills: a Haiku-written brief, /clear, and a seed that points the new session at the brief.

tjwds/better-spellcheck:..name: better-spellcheck
tjwds/better-spellcheck:..description: Underlines misspelled words in the prompt as you type, with aspell suggestions in a band above the prompt

sirkitree/pinboard:..name: pinboard
sirkitree/pinboard:..description: Keeps open decisions, the task list and links Claude creates in a sidebar pane, updated through its own tool

IvanPavlak/NeonMeter:..name: neonmeter
IvanPavlak/NeonMeter:..description: Neon rate-limit and context meter for Claude Code, drawn above the prompt

juulsverne/claude-code-mods:cost-git.name: cost-git
juulsverne/claude-code-mods:cost-git.description: A band above the prompt: session and last-message cost, plus git branch, status, CI, pull and push (push commits any uncommitted changes first, with a generated message)

Nooralwachi/context-bar:..name: context-bar
Nooralwachi/context-bar:..description: Draws the context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, one color per /context category. Toggle with /context-bar.

dukechain2333/cc-status-band:..name: status-band
dukechain2333/cc-status-band:..description: A designed status band under the prompt: model and effort, directory, git, a context gauge, the 5-hour and weekly quota you have left, and cost.

builtbyjia/claude-code-mods:ding-dong.name: ding-dong
builtbyjia/claude-code-mods:ding-dong.description: 回合跑超過一分鐘才結束時，發一則可愛的 macOS 通知叫你回來；/ding 可以預覽

builtbyjia/claude-code-mods:pii-mask.name: pii-mask
builtbyjia/claude-code-mods:pii-mask.description: 個資去識別化：把手機、身分證、Email、地址等換成代號再送給模型，對照表只留在本機；/pii 開關與查看

builtbyjia/claude-code-mods:secret-guard.name: secret-guard
builtbyjia/claude-code-mods:secret-guard.description: 金鑰守門：遮蔽 prompt 和工具輸出裡的 API key，並擋下讀寫 .env、私鑰這類檔案；/guard 看狀態

builtbyjia/claude-code-mods:ship-it.name: ship-it
builtbyjia/claude-code-mods:ship-it.description: 用 /ship 依序跑專案的階段（檢查、測試、打包、部署），並在 pane 裡用橘色吉祥物顯示跑到哪一步

neonelemental/claude-code-board-mods:boa.name: board
neonelemental/claude-code-board-mods:boa.description: A pane of GitHub project boards (Projects v2), one or all of them, by Status column, read over REST through gh

neonelemental/claude-code-board-mods:fle.name: fleet
neonelemental/claude-code-board-mods:fle.description: A pane of this session's agents grouped by the epics and tickets of GitHub project boards: ticket status, epic completion, each ticket's agents with their sub-agents folded

Iliesseu28/claude-autocommit:..name: autocommit
Iliesseu28/claude-autocommit:..description: Turns every turn Claude takes into a clean git commit: only the files that turn changed, a Conventional Commits message written by Haiku, a secret scan before every commit, undo and squash. Plus a band above the prompt with model, effort, context and commits.

Paradox07127/claude-utopia:plugins/dashb.name: dashboard
Paradox07127/claude-utopia:plugins/dashb.description: Unified workbench: a status band for subagents and mmrun reviews, plus a seven-page pane (Overview / Agents / Reviews / GPU / Timeline / Usage / Progress; Reviews, GPU and Progress show once they have data); the Progress page lists the per-project progress board, recorded after each typed turn that changed files or made a commit

Paradox07127/claude-utopia:plugins/harne.name: harness
Paradox07127/claude-utopia:plugins/harne.description: Skills and guard hooks: ai-code-cleanup, interrogate, shape-task, verify-change, setup, a shared-worktree git guard, and a guard against reading API-key config files

Paradox07127/claude-utopia:plugins/mm.name: mm
Paradox07127/claude-utopia:plugins/mm.description: Cross-model review and delegation: /mm:review and /mm:run, built on mmrun

Paradox07127/claude-utopia:plugins/progr.name: progress
Paradox07127/claude-utopia:plugins/progr.description: A per-project progress board: after each typed turn that edited files or made a commit, the plugin records its work as nodes through a Sonnet completion, kept under ~/.claude/progress/ or committed with the project; the plugin mirrors it to an optional Artifact canvas

nrzz/claude-code-glow:hud.name: glowbar
nrzz/claude-code-glow:hud.description: A themed bar above the prompt: live context meter, plan limits, session cost, a token-saving tip, and one-key Compact and Theme buttons, plus a /glow theme picker. Uses Claude Code's early-access function hooks (2.1.286 or newer).

koslowskyj/tdd-mod:..name: tdd-mod
koslowskyj/tdd-mod:..description: Blocks file writes that break Red-Green-Refactor on coding tasks (port of probity's enforceTdd).

0xR4vens/clawd-mods:..name: clawd-mods
0xR4vens/clawd-mods:..description: Clawd in pixel art under the spinner while Claude works, with a twinkling progress backdrop

kevinbadi/creatoros-claude-plugin:creato.name: creatoros
kevinbadi/creatoros-claude-plugin:creato.description: Run your socials from Claude Code: the Creator OS connector, skills, and a live pane for accounts, scheduled posts and your inbox.

MarkMerk/markmerk-mods:plugins/runner-av.name: runner-avatar
MarkMerk/markmerk-mods:plugins/runner-av.description: A small Claude avatar that runs back and forth above the prompt

treestar84/vibemud:claude-marketplace/pl.name: vibemud
treestar84/vibemud:claude-marketplace/pl.description: Claude Code에서 /mud 명령으로 로컬 VibeMUD RPG를 조작하는 한국어 중심 플러그인입니다.

netgfx/claude-session-dashboard-mod:..name: session-dashboard
netgfx/claude-session-dashboard-mod:..description: A side pane for the current session: prompt cache hot/cold, tool calls and errors, background commands with restart and stop, the approved plan, task list, subagents and swarm agents, and token usage for the main agent and subagents

gabedeluna/claude-mods:plugins/ledger.name: ledger
gabedeluna/claude-mods:plugins/ledger.description: A per-session ledger of topics, decisions, open questions, to-dos and board state, kept by Claude through a tool and shown in a pane.

gabedeluna/claude-mods:plugins/sidechat.name: sidechat
gabedeluna/claude-mods:plugins/sidechat.description: A side panel for questions about the current session: it reads the conversation from cache, looks things up read-only, recaps, says what the main thread is doing, draws diagrams as artifacts and sends a note to main.

natsume-777/claude-mods:plugins/cache-ti.name: cache-timer
natsume-777/claude-mods:plugins/cache-ti.description: Shows how long the prompt cache has left, next to the model name in the footer

natsume-777/claude-mods:plugins/token-le.name: token-ledger
natsume-777/claude-mods:plugins/token-le.description: Shows where the session's tokens go and when a fresh session would be cheaper

natsume-777/claude-mods:plugins/ui-sampl.name: ui-sampler
natsume-777/claude-mods:plugins/ui-sampl.description: A labelled catalog of every place a mod can draw, every API it can call and every value it can read

natsume-777/claude-mods:plugins/usage-ba.name: usage-band
natsume-777/claude-mods:plugins/usage-ba.description: Shows context, 5-hour and weekly limit usage in the band above the prompt

afterever/claude-mods:ctx.name: ctx
afterever/claude-mods:ctx.description: Context window details like the Desktop app's panel: /ctx opens a pane that docks beside the transcript, and a 📊 button above the prompt toggles it.

shengyy/ccoverhead:plugin.name: ccoverhead
shengyy/ccoverhead:plugin.description: ccOverhead: the context window, each turn's growth, the 5-hour and weekly quota and prompt-cache warmth, in one band above the Claude Code prompt on one safe-to-warning colour scale.

njp-coder/meanwhile:..name: meanwhile
njp-coder/meanwhile:..description: A small card above the prompt teaches you one thing while Claude works, and turns your day into something worth sharing

sverma24/claude-code-mods:checkpoint.name: checkpoint
sverma24/claude-code-mods:checkpoint.description: Commits files Claude edited as a git checkpoint after each turn, and adds /rollback to undo the last one.

sverma24/claude-code-mods:secret-guard.name: secret-guard
sverma24/claude-code-mods:secret-guard.description: Blocks reads of .env files and printing of API keys, with a red warning above the prompt.

sverma24/claude-code-mods:touched.name: touched
sverma24/claude-code-mods:touched.description: /touched opens a pane listing every file Claude read or edited this session, with counts

moaazhomaid/claude-plugins:plugins/token.name: tokenscope
moaazhomaid/claude-plugins:plugins/token.description: Live token & USD observatory for Claude Code: per agent, subagent, workflow, task, skill and model, with prompt-cache countdowns, a model lock while the cache is warm, and subscription leverage

shihchengwei-lab/cc-mod-shouldnt-you-kno.name: shouldnt-you-know
shihchengwei-lab/cc-mod-shouldnt-you-kno.description: After Claude edits code, a side look at the task and the change shows one plain-language structural note above the prompt; it never enters Claude's context.

deepskyblue86/claude-markdown-mod:..name: md-render
deepskyblue86/claude-markdown-mod:..description: Redraws assistant messages as styled markdown.

KeygripGit/claude-mods:plugins/workorder.name: workorder-pane
KeygripGit/claude-mods:plugins/workorder.description: Keygrip work orders in a pane: /workorders lists your project's deploy queue; pick one to read its fields, edits, schema and verify steps, and see the page before and after the edits — a page that is not live yet is shown on a template page of your site. Paste your project's client key once.

YanZiBin/knowledge-card:plugins/knowledg.name: knowledge-card
YanZiBin/knowledge-card:plugins/knowledg.description: While the AI works, a plain-language knowledge card above the prompt explains a concept from the current task. Click 我知道啦 for the next one.

karimdjaafar/jc-hud-mod:..name: jc-hud-mod
karimdjaafar/jc-hud-mod:..description: JC HUD — mod Claude Code : barre d'instruments Jasmine Conseil (contexte, forfait, modèle, horloges)

kirishimarisano-rgb/Mods-Claude-code-0-p.name: context-gauge
kirishimarisano-rgb/Mods-Claude-code-0-p.description: Context, 5h/7d limits, cost, thinking time, tool timeline and a Stop button above the prompt; a foldable side pane; opt-in auto wrap-up near the limit

kirishimarisano-rgb/Mods-Claude-code-0-p.name: widget-bridge
kirishimarisano-rgb/Mods-Claude-code-0-p.description: Sends each local session's status (what Claude is doing, task progress, context and usage) to the Claude Widget desktop app on this computer, and takes its Stop button

nison/claude-invaders:invaders.name: invaders
nison/claude-invaders:invaders.description: A tiny Space Invaders to play above the prompt while Claude works; pauses when Claude finishes and keeps your level.

0xBADC0FFEE/claude-code-mods:context-tok.name: context-tokens
0xBADC0FFEE/claude-code-mods:context-tok.description: Shows the context tokens in use beside the prompt footer of the desktop app, green under 100k, yellow to 150k, red beyond. Needs function hooks (early access).

carlvellotti/mods-starter:mods/dashboard.name: dashboard
carlvellotti/mods-starter:mods/dashboard.description: A /dashboard pane that fetches a JSON URL every minute and shows a few numbers from it

carlvellotti/mods-starter:mods/guard.name: guard
carlvellotti/mods-starter:mods/guard.description: Pauses risky shell commands (rm -rf, force push, DROP TABLE) and asks you Proceed or Cancel first

carlvellotti/mods-starter:mods/panel-wit.name: panel-with-buttons
carlvellotti/mods-starter:mods/panel-wit.description: A /edits command that opens a pane listing the files Claude changed this session, with Clear and Close buttons

carlvellotti/mods-starter:mods/slash-com.name: slash-command
carlvellotti/mods-starter:mods/slash-com.description: A /plain-recap command that summarizes the session so far in plain English for a non-engineer

carlvellotti/mods-starter:mods/status-ba.name: status-band
carlvellotti/mods-starter:mods/status-ba.description: A line above the prompt that says, in plain English, what Claude is doing right now and for how long

petershk/explain-permission:..name: explain-permission
