petershk/explain-permission:..description: Explains each Claude Code permission request in plain English (WHAT, WHY, RISK) in a side pane

nemokoala/claude-mods:plugins/git-graph.name: git-graph
nemokoala/claude-mods:plugins/git-graph.description: 접었다 펼 수 있는 깃 커밋 그래프 패널 (/git-graph)

Conte777/claude-mermaid:mermaid-inline.name: mermaid-inline
Conte777/claude-mermaid:mermaid-inline.description: Mermaid diagrams in Claude Code: every ```mermaid block Claude writes is drawn as a picture right where the fence was in the transcript, with an open-SVG button, and as box art where the terminal cannot show pictures. Fork of galElmalah/claude-mods claude-mermaid. Needs function hooks (early access), node and resvg.

muxia23/ricky-pixel-mod:..name: ricky-pixel-mod
muxia23/ricky-pixel-mod:..description: Ricky, a pixel-art cat companion for Claude Code: an animated night-sky pane with a task / subagent / activity / files board, a cat in the band above the prompt, and a purple-gold spinner

craigmcampbell/claude-plugins:plugins/us.name: usage-bars
craigmcampbell/claude-plugins:plugins/us.description: Shows 5-hour and weekly plan usage as bars above the prompt, with a pace marker and reset countdown

jimmyeao/claude-code-bars:plugins/contex.name: context-bar
jimmyeao/claude-code-bars:plugins/contex.description: Draws the context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, one colour per /context category. Toggle with /context-bar.

jimmyeao/claude-code-bars:plugins/usage-.name: usage-bar
jimmyeao/claude-code-bars:plugins/usage-.description: Draws your plan usage limits as bars above the prompt, one colour per window, flagging when you are using a window faster than its clock. Toggle with /usage-bar.

cmyanar-max/claude-code-kedi-modu:..name: kedi-modu
cmyanar-max/claude-code-kedi-modu:..description: Cat mode: an ASCII cat above the prompt that reacts to what Claude is doing, plus status line and toasts.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:factory/con.name: factory-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:factory/con.description: The Widget Factory floor: each work order with its station and holder, what has shipped and what was turned back

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/204.name: 2048-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/204.description: The 2048 sliding-tile puzzle; it plays itself until you take the keys.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/8ba.name: 8ball-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/8ba.description: Ask a yes or no question and get an answer of doubtful reliability.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/act.name: activity-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/act.description: The most recent tool calls with how long each took and whether it failed.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/aim.name: aim-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/aim.description: Where a command lands outside this folder: the kube context, cloud profile, Terraform workspace or database it is aimed at, named in the permission dialog

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/ame.name: amendments-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/ame.description: What changed in the system prompt and the built-in tool descriptions Claude Code gives Claude since the version you last ran, with the before and after one command away

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/aqu.name: aquarium-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/aqu.description: An aquarium with a fish for every running tool call and agent.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/asi.name: aside-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/asi.description: Ask a side question about the conversation, even mid-turn, and get the answer on a card without adding a turn to the transcript

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/att.name: attic-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/att.description: Counts which tools Claude calls in this project, puts the unused ones behind ToolSearch, lists the daily ones up front, and reports how many schema tokens each request no longer carries

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/bad.name: badges-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/bad.description: Achievements earned across sessions, such as twenty tool calls in a row without a failure.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/boa.name: board-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/boa.description: A status board Claude keeps itself: its current goal, key findings and open questions, pinned through a tool the plugin registers.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/bos.name: boss-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/bos.description: A boss fight against the context window: its health drops as context fills, and compaction defeats it.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/bre.name: breakout-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/bre.description: A brick breaker that plays itself; every tool call adds a row of bricks.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/cam.name: campfire-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/cam.description: A campfire that burns higher the busier the session is and dies down to embers when idle.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/cha.name: changes-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/cha.description: The files edited this session, with how many edits each took.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/che.name: checks-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/che.description: The latest test, lint and build runs: whether each passed, how long it took and how long ago.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/clo.name: clocks-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/clo.description: Your local time beside the time zones you pick.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/cof.name: coffee-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/cof.description: A coffee cup that empties as you work and nudges you to take a break when it runs dry.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/col.name: collision-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/col.description: Stops an edit to a file another Claude Code session on this machine changed since this one last read it, and has Claude read it again first

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/com.name: commits-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/com.description: The commits made since the session started.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/con.name: constellation-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/con.description: A night sky that gains a star each turn and joins them into a named constellation.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/con.name: context-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/con.description: The context window as a stacked bar, one colour per /context category, with six view modes.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/cou.name: countdown-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/cou.description: A countdown to a deadline you set, with a toast when it arrives.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/cri.name: critic-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/cri.description: A second pair of eyes: a separate model reads the uncommitted diff and lists only real defects, which you can hand to Claude

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/cus.name: customs-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/cus.description: Looks up every package Claude installs on npm or PyPI before the command runs, and holds the install for a yes when the name is missing or under 30 days old

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/dif.name: diff-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/dif.description: The last edit as a syntax-highlighted diff.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/don.name: done-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/don.description: A definition of done you write once: Claude ticks each item with evidence through its tick tool, and is pulled up when it says done with items open

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/don.name: donut-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/don.description: The spinning 3D donut, drawn in pixels; it spins faster while tool calls are running.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/ear.name: earpiece-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/ear.description: Every running subagent with the tool it is on and its last sentence, and /whisper slips one of them a note without stopping the turn

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/ear.name: earshot-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/ear.description: Whether Claude has got the message you typed while it was working: how late a request first carried it, and what Claude changed before it heard you

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/equ.name: equalizer-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/equ.description: Level meters that jump with every tool call and fall back to rest.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/fil.name: file-tree-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/fil.description: A file tree of the project directory with expandable folders.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/fir.name: fireworks-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/fir.description: A night sky that sets off fireworks when a test, lint or build run passes.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/foo.name: footnotes-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/foo.description: Checks every file path, cited line and code symbol in Claude's last reply against the working tree, with no model call, and flags the ones that are not there

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/for.name: forecast-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/for.description: Context growth per turn as a chart, with a prediction of how many turns are left before compaction.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/for.name: fortune-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/for.description: A one-line fortune for the turn, drawn fresh each time you send a prompt.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/gar.name: garden-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/gar.description: A plant that grows a leaf per tool call, flowers when checks pass and wilts when a call fails.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/git.name: git-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/git.description: The current branch, how far it is ahead or behind, what is staged or changed, and the last commit.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/gre.name: green-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/gre.description: What changed in the working tree since each test, lint or build command last passed, measured against a hidden git snapshot taken at that moment and handed to Claude on request

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/gua.name: guard-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/gua.description: A tally of this session's permission checks: what was allowed, what you were asked about and what was denied.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/inv.name: invaders-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/inv.description: Every failing check sends in an invader; every passing check shoots one down.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/lan.name: landmarks-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/lan.description: A numbered table of contents for the session, built as it happens from prompts, first edits, checks turning red or green, commits and questions; press a line to scroll the transcript to it

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/led.name: ledger-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/led.description: What a project has cost across every session, from any folder or worktree in it: measured as each turn ends, and read back from the sessions Claude Code saved

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/lif.name: life-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/lif.description: Conway's Game of Life; every tool call drops a glider.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/lou.name: loupe-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/lou.description: Select a hash, path, name, timestamp or colour in the transcript with the mouse and the card says what it is, with no model call

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/map.name: map-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/map.description: A pixel map of the repository: every tracked file a block, lit blue where Claude has read and green where it has edited.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/mar.name: margin-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/mar.description: Mark passages of Claude's reply with the mouse, write a remark against each, and send them back as one quoted prompt

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/mar.name: marquee-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/mar.description: An LED ticker that scrolls session events across the card: turns, tool calls and failures.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/maz.name: maze-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/maz.description: A first-person walk through a maze seeded by the project folder, drawn with a raycaster.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/min.name: minesweeper-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/min.description: Minesweeper, played with the mouse in the fullscreen layout.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/moo.name: moon-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/moo.description: The real moon right now, drawn for your hemisphere, with a countdown to the next full moon and what it means for your deploy

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/mos.name: mosaic-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/mos.description: A mosaic that gains one tile per tool call, coloured by tool, until the session is a picture.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/not.name: notebook-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/not.description: Gives Claude a jot tool for writing down what its future self should know about this project, and reads the notes back next session

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/not.name: notes-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/not.description: Pinned notes that stay on screen and survive restarts; add one with /note.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/orb.name: orbit-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/orb.description: A small solar system whose planets speed up while tool calls are running.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/out.name: outage-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/out.description: When a push or install fails on the network, checks the provider's status page and says whether GitHub, npm, PyPI or crates.io reports an incident

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/pen.name: pen-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/pen.description: The file, edit or command Claude is writing right now, drawn line by line as the tool call's arguments stream in, before the tool runs

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/pet.name: pet-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/pet.description: Clawd, a pixel crab whose mood follows the session.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/pip.name: pipes-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/pip.description: The pipes screensaver: coloured pipes grow across the card while the session is idle.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/pom.name: pomodoro-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/pom.description: A focus timer: 25 minutes of work, a 5 minute break, and a count of the sessions finished.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/pre.name: premise-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/pre.description: Quotes thinking-summary sentences that name a gap and a choice made anyway, unless the reply flags it, and starts your correction; no model call; needs "showThinkingSummaries": true in settings.json

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/pro.name: provenance-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/pro.description: The conversation behind a line of code: for lines Claude is about to edit, or a path:line you ask about, the prompt you typed before they were written and the command that resumes that session

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/que.name: quest-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/que.description: The session as a dungeon crawl: every turn is a room, tool calls are monsters, failures wound you and passing checks drop loot. Your hero carries over between sessions.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/que.name: queue-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/que.description: A queue of prompts that run back to back while you are away, a gate command each must pass before the next starts, and a report of how each one ended

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/rac.name: race-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/rac.description: A race track for parallel subagents: each advances one stride per tool call, with a podium as they finish.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/rai.name: rain-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/rai.description: Falling code rain that speeds up while tool calls are running.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/red.name: redact-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/red.description: Replaces API keys, tokens, private keys and passwords in command output and file reads before Claude sees them

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/reh.name: rehearsal-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/reh.description: Which of the commands and edits Claude has made in this project would stop for permission or be refused right now, asked of the engine's own permission check without running anything

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/see.name: seen-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/see.description: The pictures Claude looked at this session, image files it read and screenshots that came back from tools, drawn as Claude received them and opened full size with one command

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/ses.name: sessions-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/ses.description: The other Claude Code sessions open on this machine: folder, branch, and whether each is busy.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sie.name: sieve-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sie.description: A compaction that keeps every word you and Claude said and folds only the old tool traffic, with no summary and no tokens spent

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sig.name: sigil-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sig.description: A unique pixel emblem generated from each session's activity, kept in a gallery across sessions.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/ski.name: skimmed-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/ski.description: The caveats in Claude's replies that left your screen while Claude was still writing and have not been back, quoted in full; it never claims that what was on screen was read

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sky.name: sky-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sky.description: The sky at your local time of day: sun by day, moon and stars by night, more stars the longer the session.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sky.name: skyline-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sky.description: A pixel skyline: one building per turn, one floor per tool call.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sna.name: snake-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sna.description: Snake that plays itself until you take the keys.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sor.name: sorting-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sor.description: A bar chart that sorts itself one swap per tool call, then reshuffles.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sou.name: sound-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sou.description: The session as music: a note per tool call, a chord when checks pass and a buzz on failure, with a piano roll. Playback currently works on macOS only.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/squ.name: squiggle-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/squ.description: Underlines file names that do not exist, as you type them in the prompt box, and paints the ones that do green

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sta.name: stakes-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/sta.description: What a yes would lose, measured from git and written under the permission dialog for a destructive command

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/str.name: strays-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/str.description: Servers this session started that still hold a port, with age and turn, one verb to stop one, and the survivors shown when the next session opens

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/str.name: stream-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/str.description: A live gauge of how fast Claude is writing, in tokens per second, with a sparkline.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tap.name: tap-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tap.description: One line per tool of your connected MCP servers, called by the widget on a clock with no model: pull requests, errors, the next meeting

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tas.name: tasks-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tas.description: The session's task list with a progress bar.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tet.name: tetris-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tet.description: Tetris; it plays itself until you take the keys.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tim.name: timeline-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tim.description: A chart of the turn: one bar per tool call on a time axis, parallel calls stacked, coloured by tool.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tim.name: timer-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tim.description: How long the current turn has run, with the last, average and longest turn and a sparkline.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tod.name: todos-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tod.description: The TODO, FIXME, HACK and XXX comments in the repository, counted and listed.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tra.name: train-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tra.description: A locomotive that crosses the card pulling one wagon per tool call this turn.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tri.name: trial-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/tri.description: A fair test of another widget: sessions alternate with it on and off, and the card compares how many turns end clean

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/typ.name: typer-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/typ.description: A typing game for long turns: words fall, taken from your own file names; type them before they land.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/usa.name: usage-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/usa.description: A bar per rate-limit window with time to reset and session cost.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/wat.name: watch-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/wat.description: Reruns a command after every edit and shows a pass or fail light with the first failing lines.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/wea.name: weather-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/wea.description: Context usage drawn as weather, from clear skies to a storm near compaction.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/wid.name: widgets
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/wid.description: Layout for the widget cards: below the prompt, above it, or docked beside the transcript. Required by every widget.

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/wit.name: witness-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/wit.description: Every line of hidden context the other widgets add to your prompts, word for word, with a running size

oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/wor.name: world-widget
oMaN-Rod/claude-code-widgets:plugins/wor.description: One diorama for the whole session: the sky follows the clock, the weather follows context, a tower rises per turn, a train carries the tool calls and a crab walks through it.

ninondev/claude-sama:plugin.name: claudesama
ninondev/claude-sama:plugin.description: My unofficial fan mod that makes Claude Code cute. Claude-sama, a small kami of words, reads along above your prompt, keeps an offering box for your context window and draws you one omen a day. Terminal and desktop. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

Parais4/parais-mods:plugins/zsemle.name: zsemle
Parais4/parais-mods:plugins/zsemle.description: Zsemle, a pixel-art companion above the prompt (golden retriever, cat, slime, paperclip): watches every usage limit (50/75/90% warnings, pace forecast, resets, API errors, automatic model switch and compaction, cost), stops work at 95%, guards file writes and cheers long turns. English and Hungarian, terminal and desktop.

EricJamie/claude-code-mods:plugins/cache.name: cache-timer
EricJamie/claude-code-mods:plugins/cache.description: A countdown to when the conversation's prompt cache expires, in the prompt footer before the model name

EricJamie/claude-code-mods:plugins/conte.name: context-band
EricJamie/claude-code-mods:plugins/conte.description: A band above the prompt with rate limits, tokens, speed, cache, cost and context fill, in light and dark themes

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/adv.name: advanced-rust-cli
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/adv.description: Rustで実装された基礎的なコマンドの改善版のみを常に使用するように挙動を変更するMod

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/aut.name: auto-compact
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/aut.description: ターン終了時のコンテキスト使用率やプロンプトキャッシュの失効を見て自動で Compaction し、要約をテキストに保存する

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/cha.name: change-review
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/cha.description: 実装後の差分を、実装者とは別の読み取り専用レビュアー SubAgent に点検させるMod。指摘の形式検証、再レビュー回数の上限、未実施・未解決の明示を行う。任意で、ローカルLLMによる差分の一次点検 (参考データ) も提供する

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/cod.name: code-finder
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/cod.description: fd と ripgrep でファイル名・コード内容を検索するツール (find_files / search_code) をモデルに提供するMod

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/ctx.name: ctxpack-fetch
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/ctx.description: WebFetch を禁じ、代わりに ctxpack で Web ページをノイズ除去した Markdown として取得するツール (fetch_page) をモデルに提供するMod。ローカルLLMによる出典付きの関連段落抽出も選べる

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/exe.name: execution-budget
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/exe.description: ゴール単位で SubAgent の起動数・同時実行数・再試行回数・経過時間に上限を設け、到達したら新しい起動を止めて進捗と残作業を保存する。使用量と診断ログも記録する

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/goa.name: goal-orchestrator
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/goa.description: /goal の内容をタスク分解・TODO化・実行順序付けし、各タスクを SubAgent に委譲させる

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/har.name: harness-profile
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/har.description: 開発ハーネス用の推奨プロファイル (minimal / standard / full / local-llm) を示し、/harness で必要な CLI・Notion 設定・ローカルLLM設定・ollama 接続の不足を診断するMod

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/not.name: notion-knowledge
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/not.description: Notion データベースをナレッジベースにし、ollama の tev1:4b に判断させて、プロンプトに関係する知識の取得と、新しい知識の自動記録を行うMod

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/sou.name: source-citation
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/sou.description: 情報収集した内容を回答やファイルに書くとき、出典 (URL) の併記を必須にするMod

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/sta.name: stack-pr
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/sta.description: 変更範囲の大きい Issue の実装を、gh stack の Stack PR に分割して自律的に進めさせる

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/sub.name: subagent-router
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/sub.description: SubAgent の起動時に、タスクに合う model と effort を ollama の決定モデル (tev1:4b、不調なら nimble) に判断させて振り分ける

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/tas.name: task-checkpoint
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/tas.description: ゴールとタスクの状態をローカルに保存し、Compaction や再開のあとに実際のファイルと照合して復元する

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/tru.name: trust-boundary
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/tru.description: Web・Notion など外部由来の内容を参考データとして扱い、取得後の設定変更・外部送信・公開系の操作を要確認にし、送信先 allowlist と秘密検査で外部へ送る内容を制限するMod

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/ver.name: verification-gate
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/ver.description: リポジトリごとの検証コマンドと受け入れ条件を登録し、実行結果と変更状態の記録に基づいて完了を判定させるMod

UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/wor.name: workspace-isolation
UtakataKyosui/utakata-cc-mod:plugins/wor.description: 書き込みを行う並列タスクに専用 git worktree を割り当て、ベース・担当範囲・成果差分を追跡し、競合と範囲外変更を検出してから安全に統合するMod

jack21/claude-mod-usage:..name: mod-usage
jack21/claude-mod-usage:..description: Shows Claude context, 5-hour and 7-day usage as gradient progress bars above the prompt (Claude Code Desktop / VS Code / mobile). 12 languages.

shoujiki-panman/claude-code-mods:limit-m.name: limit-meter
shoujiki-panman/claude-code-mods:limit-m.description: 利用上限（5時間枠と週の枠）の使った割合とリセットの時刻を入力欄の上に出し、上限が近づいたら知らせる

shoujiki-panman/claude-code-mods:secret-.name: secret-mask
shoujiki-panman/claude-code-mods:secret-.description: コマンドの結果や読んだファイルに混じったAPIキー・パスワードを、Claudeが読む前に伏せる

charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/brand-theme.name: brand-theme
charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/brand-theme.description: Dresses Claude Code in your brand: a branded spinner, tool rows and question dialog, plus a band above the prompt with your name, open loops and context used. Colours live in one block you can swap

charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/done-ping.name: done-ping
charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/done-ping.description: A desktop notification with a sound when Claude finishes a long answer or may need your OK

charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/mission-con.name: mission-control
charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/mission-con.description: A live panel above your prompt: the plan as a stage bar, what Claude is doing in plain English, your asks ticked off, and a sound when it is done

charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/mod-maker.name: mod-maker
charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/mod-maker.description: Find what you ask Claude again and again, then build a mod that does it for you: /mod-audit, /mod-build, /mod-check and a habit spotter

charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/open-loops.name: open-loops
charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/open-loops.description: Live pane of every ask you make in a session, ticked only with proof. Ask-splitter: right after you send a prompt, a band shows "I heard 3 asks" and numbers each one

charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/outbox.name: outbox
charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/outbox.description: Holds every message Claude tries to send (WhatsApp, email, Slack) until you read it, see who it goes to, and press Send

charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/plain-reply.name: plain-reply
charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/plain-reply.description: Grades every reply for length, long sentences and jargon, and offers a one-click 'Say it simpler' draft when it goes over your bar

charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/pre-build-c.name: pre-build-check
charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/pre-build-c.description: Before Claude builds anything, it re-reads your own CLAUDE.md rules and keeps a reference's structure without copying its look

charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/safe-delete.name: safe-delete
charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/safe-delete.description: Claude never deletes a file for good: rm, find -delete and git clean move files to the Bin, with a receipt and /undo-delete

charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/secrets-gua.name: secrets-guard
charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/secrets-gua.description: Stops Claude reading .env and key files, masks API keys in command output, and lets you hand Claude a key through a pane without it ever seeing the value

charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/sessions-ba.name: sessions-band
charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/sessions-ba.description: A band above the prompt listing your other open Claude Code sessions, what each one is for, and an Ask button

charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/show-it.name: show-it
charlie947/mod-maker:plugins/show-it.description: Opens the newest page, image or video Claude made at the end of each turn, without stealing focus

CtrlAltFocus/claude-mods:plugins/lava-la.name: lava-lamp
CtrlAltFocus/claude-mods:plugins/lava-la.description: An animated metaball lava lamp in a side pane, in wax-in-liquid colours: /lava-lamp toggles it; /lava-lamp [veryslow|slow|normal|fast] [orange|yellow|green|purple|blue|pink|rotate] [<wax>-<liquid>, e.g. orange-clear, turquoise-black, white-violet] [few|medium|many bubbles] [lamp|nolamp] [off] sets it; wax is any of orange, yellow, green, purple, blue, pink, red, turquoise, white, black, violet and the liquid is any of those or clear (a clear liquid lets the terminal background show); a colour word means that colour's classic pair (e.g. orange = orange wax in violet), rotate cycles slowly through eight pairs, and rotate-clear rotates the wax over a clear liquid

hicrandn/claude-mods:plugins/usage-torch.name: usage-torch
hicrandn/claude-mods:plugins/usage-torch.description: Your Claude usage limit, as a tiny torchbearer whose flame fades as you use it.

mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/activ.name: activity
mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/activ.description: Live panel of what Claude is doing: running tools with real commands and timers, what is waiting for your approval, subagents, and its current todo plan.

mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/chang.name: changes
mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/chang.description: Every file Claude created or edited this session, with +/- line counts from git and one-click 'why?', summary and self-review.

mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/comma.name: command-hub
mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/comma.description: Discover slash commands: essentials explained in plain language, searchable list of everything installed, a form to create your own, and tips when a command fits what you just typed.

mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/conte.name: context-keeper
mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/conte.description: Live context-window panel: what fills it, checkpoints before you compact or clear, and nudges before you hit the wall.

mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/guard.name: guardrails
mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/guard.description: Clickable safety rules with presets: block rm -rf, force-push, destructive git, secret files, sudo, installs, network; lock Claude to the project folder or read-only; add your own block patterns.

mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/loop-.name: loop-breaker
mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/loop-.description: Notices when Claude is going in circles (the same command failing again and again, the same code rewritten over and over) and tells Claude to step back and rethink, and tells you too.

mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/mod-m.name: mod-manager
mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/mod-m.description: Pick which claude-mods you want: install, turn on or off, update, or remove each mod from one panel (/mods), with presets. No need to install everything.

mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/notif.name: notify
mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/notif.description: Notification inbox + native OS notifications when a long turn ends, a subagent or background task finishes, or Claude is stuck waiting for your approval.

mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/promp.name: prompt-coach
mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/promp.description: Before a vague prompt is sent, suggests a sharper rewrite; you choose: send improved, send yours, or edit the suggestion. Never rewrites silently.

mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/quick.name: quickbar
mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/quick.description: A one-line launcher above the prompt: live context %, and one-click buttons for every claude-mods panel you have installed.

mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/toolb.name: toolbox
mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/toolb.description: Every tool Claude can use (built-in and MCP) in plain language, how often each was used, and suggestions tailored to the project you are in.

mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/usage.name: usage-meter
mishgoldenberg/claude-mods:plugins/usage.description: Plan-limit bars with burn rate and time-to-empty, session cost, cache hit ratio and tokens-per-turn sparkline.

Huuuuung/think-meter:..name: think-meter
Huuuuung/think-meter:..description: Brings the terminal's turn timer to the desktop app: how long each answer took, split into wait, thinking, writing and tools, with tok/s, a live thinking timer and /think-stats

chandan84/cache-time-pending-usage-limit.name: usage-hud
chandan84/cache-time-pending-usage-limit.description: Three-box HUD above the prompt: tokens and API-equivalent cost across all sessions (daily and per-session breakdown), context-window meter with a soft limit, and prompt-cache warmth countdown with last-turn tokens and cost.

ashafizullah/cmdc-worker:..name: cmdc-worker
ashafizullah/cmdc-worker:..description: Claude orchestrates, Command Code (cmdc) implements: a tool that hands a task to cmdc and returns its diff for review, with a live pane of the run.

manuel-will/cc-source-control:source-con.name: source-control
manuel-will/cc-source-control:source-con.description: Source Control for Claude Code: Git status above the chat box, a panel with changes, commit, a history graph, branches and worktrees, plus fetch, pull, push and sync in one click. English and German.

tsurutanmen/session-dash:..name: session-dash
tsurutanmen/session-dash:..description: Usage limits above the prompt, a pane with background work and the file each open Claude Code session is on

tsurutanmen/homedot-panel:..name: homedot-panel
tsurutanmen/homedot-panel:..description: Shows your homedot agents in Claude Code's status line (running, resting, stopped), with the 5-hour limit and minutes until it resets, plus a /dots pane.

karanb192/claude-code-redact:plugins/red.name: redact
karanb192/claude-code-redact:plugins/red.description: Redacts secrets and PII from every row Claude Code stores, before the model reads it and before the transcript keeps it. Reach L0: no network, no processes, no files.

asitha-w/pace:..name: pace
asitha-w/pace:..description: Shows when a session gets heavy or its prompt cache is about to go cold, and parks a session so the next one can resume it

y-hirakaw/claude-code-mods:touch-map.name: touch-map
y-hirakaw/claude-code-mods:touch-map.description: See which files Claude has listed, read, partially read, edited, created or deleted, as a tree and an activity map in a pane.

gmorubio/claude-mods:pet.name: pet
gmorubio/claude-mods:pet.description: A pixel art pet above the prompt in the Claude Code desktop app: a cat, a dog or an otter that sleeps while Claude is idle and plays while it works

gmorubio/claude-mods:turn-usage.name: turn-usage
gmorubio/claude-mods:turn-usage.description: A dim line under each Claude reply with how much of your current session's usage limit is used and how much that turn spent, or the cost on pay as you go

tsurutanmen/session-bridge:..name: session-bridge
tsurutanmen/session-bridge:..description: Talk to your Claude Code sessions from other sessions, your voice, or any local program. Meetings between two sessions, and a talk button that reads replies aloud.

roy651/cc-bearings:plugins/bearings.name: bearings
roy651/cc-bearings:plugins/bearings.description: Keeps a glossary of the conversation's terms and a map of where the work stands, in panes opened from a band above the prompt, with a btw input for side questions.

roy651/cc-plugins:plugins/bearings.name: bearings
roy651/cc-plugins:plugins/bearings.description: Keeps a glossary of the conversation's terms and a map of where the work stands, in panes opened from a band above the prompt, with a btw input for side questions.

wellbrained/status-deck:..name: status-deck
wellbrained/status-deck:..description: A status deck above the prompt: plan limits, context window, git branch, prompt cache and more, in six styles, each part switchable. Options: /status-deck-options

wellbrained/usage-meter-mod:..name: status-deck
wellbrained/usage-meter-mod:..description: A status deck above the prompt: plan limits, context window, git branch, prompt cache and more, in six styles, each part switchable. Options: /status-deck-options

AndreasOA/claude-code-mods:plugins/agent.name: agent-watch
AndreasOA/claude-code-mods:plugins/agent.description: Docks a narrow pane beside the transcript that follows each running subagent live

AndreasOA/claude-code-mods:plugins/usage.name: usage-bars
AndreasOA/claude-code-mods:plugins/usage.description: Sparklines of context-window fill and tokens added per turn under the prompt

Egor062020/claude-code-pult:..name: pult
Egor062020/claude-code-pult:..description: A control panel for Claude Code: quick-reply chips and a status band above the prompt, and a scrolling pane of cards for context, limits, prompt cache, deadlines from your notes, work areas and an SSH server. English and Russian.

muratkaragozgil/claude-code-usage-bar:..name: usage-bar
muratkaragozgil/claude-code-usage-bar:..description: A one-line usage bar above the prompt: 5-hour, weekly and per-model plan limits with reset countdowns, plus the session's tokens and cost.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/ans.name: answer-pane
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/ans.description: Explanations as visual pages in a pane beside the chat: diagrams drawn in place, the full page one click away. No model calls.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/bud.name: budget-guard
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/bud.description: Holds a prompt back once your 5-hour or weekly usage is at or over a limit you set (90% by default); sending it again goes through. No tokens spent.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/cac.name: cache-clock
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/cac.description: Shows how long the prompt cache stays warm, and when it expires, exactly how many tokens your next message will re-send uncached. No tokens spent.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/col.name: collision-guard
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/col.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another chat on this machine changed in the last 30 minutes. Each chat keeps its own small ledger; no model calls, no network.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/con.name: context-xray
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/con.description: A pane with the exact breakdown of what fills Claude's context: system prompt, tools, memory files, skills, messages, and which tools load on every request.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/kit.name: kit-updates
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/kit.description: Tells you when a newer version of an installed claude-pro-kit mod is out, and /kit-update installs it. One small download per session, no tokens spent.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/out.name: output-diet
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/out.description: Trims long shell output before Claude reads it: keeps the head, the tail and every error line, saves the full output to a file Claude can open.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/pro.name: pro-hud
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/pro.description: Desktop heads-up display for the Pro plan: exact 5h/7d usage gauges, context gauge, turn receipts, usage in the spinner and compact tool cards. No estimates, no tokens spent.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/rea.name: read-cap
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/rea.description: Stops Claude reading a file over 1,000 lines whole and gives it an outline tool (definitions with line numbers) so it reads only the range it needs. A retry still reads it whole.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/rer.name: reread-guard
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/rer.description: Stops Claude re-reading a file it already read in this conversation when the file has not changed since; a deliberate second attempt still goes through.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/ses.name: session-receipt
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/ses.description: /receipt opens a pane with the exact tokens every turn of the session spent (uncached, cached, output, subagents) and the costliest turns. No tokens spent.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/too.name: tool-diet
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/too.description: Moves tools you have not used lately behind ToolSearch, so their descriptions stop riding along on every request; core tools and anything you used in your last five sessions stay loaded.

VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/tur.name: turn-budget
VedantAndhale/claude-pro-kit:plugins/tur.description: Asks before a single turn uses more than +5 session points or 500,000 uncached input tokens, and stops it cleanly if you say so. Checks between requests, never mid-command.

yashverma2110/maxlearn:..name: maxlearn
yashverma2110/maxlearn:..description: Study companion: lessons and flashcards from your chats and interests, scheduled with FSRS or SM-2 spaced repetition

Amorfx/claude-paste-view:..name: paste-view
Amorfx/claude-paste-view:..description: See what you paste into Claude Code: image thumbnails and long-text previews above the prompt instead of bare [Image #1] and [Pasted text #2] tags

scodge-24/workface:..name: workface
scodge-24/workface:..description: Keeps a long-running agent's working notes through every compaction: briefs the summarizer, re-attaches the notes after the summary, and shows them in a panel you can steer.

Oualid0/claude-mods:plugins/session-boar.name: session-board
Oualid0/claude-mods:plugins/session-boar.description: Shows the running Claude sessions on this machine above the prompt

Oualid0/claude-mods:plugins/usage-ring.name: usage-ring
Oualid0/claude-mods:plugins/usage-ring.description: Rings above the prompt for limits, context, todos, tokens, cost and the prompt cache

tzafrir/human-in-the-loop:..name: human-in-the-loop
tzafrir/human-in-the-loop:..description: Claude assigns you the tasks only you can do. They wait in a My tasks pane, counted under the prompt, until you answer or reject them, so nothing Claude needs from you gets lost in the chat.

homieyangg/claude-code-mods:leftovers.name: leftovers
homieyangg/claude-code-mods:leftovers.description: Keeps a ledger of what Claude left running or lying around on your machine and servers

homieyangg/claude-code-mods:plan-bar.name: plan-bar
homieyangg/claude-code-mods:plan-bar.description: Live progress bars above the prompt for multi-step work: one row per plan, with stages, percent, waiting and failed colors, and sounds

homieyangg/claude-code-mods:secret-mask.name: secret-mask
homieyangg/claude-code-mods:secret-mask.description: Mask token-like strings in tool output before they reach the conversation

ugglr/claude-token-monster:..name: token-monster
ugglr/claude-token-monster:..description: A pixel-art monster in a side pane that eats tokens and shows context, limits and activity at a glance

theishandubey/claude-mods:plugins/agent-.name: agent-graph
theishandubey/claude-mods:plugins/agent-.description: Desktop-only pane drawing the session's running subagents as a left-to-right graph

theishandubey/claude-mods:plugins/auto-h.name: auto-handoff
theishandubey/claude-mods:plugins/auto-h.description: Hands the conversation off once the context passes a threshold (40% of windows over 200k tokens, 50% of smaller ones): a dedicated turn writes the handoff and the durable knowledge it names into an OKF bundle at .auto-handoff/, then the context is cleared and the work continues from the handoff

theishandubey/claude-mods:plugins/meter.name: meter
theishandubey/claude-mods:plugins/meter.description: Session meters above the prompt; /meter opens detailed metrics

Gharib89/claude-mods:plugins/gh-pane.name: gh-pane
Gharib89/claude-mods:plugins/gh-pane.description: A docked pane of the session repo's issues and PRs in run order, with buttons that fill the next command.

Gharib89/claude-mods:plugins/smart-compa.name: smart-compact
Gharib89/claude-mods:plugins/smart-compa.description: Lets Claude compact its own context at a step boundary it picks, with its own instructions, then resume the work.

dgokcin/claude-pokemon-mod:..name: pokemon
dgokcin/claude-pokemon-mod:..description: A pixel Pokémon that lives at the right edge of the band above the prompt

borabiricik/claude-mods:plugins/typing-s.name: typing-speed
borabiricik/claude-mods:plugins/typing-s.description: A live typing speedometer above the prompt, offline spell check in your system language, a result card after each prompt (WPM, CPM, accuracy, typos, personal bests) and a /typing stats pane

ccckfg/claude-crush:crush-style.name: crush-style
ccckfg/claude-crush:crush-style.description: Crush CLI look for Claude Code: Charm palette, bordered tool rows, gradient spinner, session sidebar

shijieli708-ship-it/claude-mods:plugins/.name: inline-next-steps
shijieli708-ship-it/claude-mods:plugins/.description: The main model lists next steps at the end of its final answer; they show as checkboxes above the prompt, with no extra model calls

richardcsuwandi/claude-mods:plugins/cont.name: context-bar
richardcsuwandi/claude-mods:plugins/cont.description: Stacked context-window bar above the prompt, colored like /context; toggle with /context-bar

richardcsuwandi/claude-mods:plugins/dead.name: deadlines
richardcsuwandi/claude-mods:plugins/dead.description: Live deadline countdowns in the Claude Code status line. /ddl to list, add, remove.

richardcsuwandi/claude-mods:plugins/moni.name: monitor
richardcsuwandi/claude-mods:plugins/moni.description: A control room above the prompt: background agents and shells (running, done, failed), blocked tool calls and context usage. /monitor pins it.

richardcsuwandi/claude-mods:plugins/usag.name: usage-bar
richardcsuwandi/claude-mods:plugins/usag.description: Usage bars (context, 5h, 7d, cost) above the prompt plus an auto-compact nudge; toggle with /usage-bar

adamholter/claude-minecraft:..name: minecraft
adamholter/claude-minecraft:..description: Playable first-person voxel sandbox inside Claude Code. Mine, build, explore, and save your world.

Akagamisora/session-memo:..name: session-memo
Akagamisora/session-memo:..description: セッションごとのメモ帳。/memo でペインを開き、Claude に送らずにメモを書ける

claudemodz/mods:plugins/ci-pane.name: ci-pane
claudemodz/mods:plugins/ci-pane.description: Live pull request checks beside the transcript: pass/fail per check, re-run failed jobs, open the PR. A status line appears only while something is failing. Uses the GitHub CLI.

claudemodz/mods:plugins/model-router.name: model-router
claudemodz/mods:plugins/model-router.description: Runs chosen subagent types on cheaper models (Explore on Haiku by default) and adds /router to switch the main session between fast, smart and unchanged. Shows the active model beside the spinner.

claudemodz/mods:plugins/no-attribution.name: no-attribution
claudemodz/mods:plugins/no-attribution.description: Removes the Co-Authored-By commit trailer and the "Generated with Claude Code" PR footer, or replaces them with your own text. Deterministic — no CLAUDE.md rule needed.

claudemodz/mods:plugins/standup.name: standup
claudemodz/mods:plugins/standup.description: Keeps a short log of what you asked Claude to do and which files changed, across sessions, and writes your standup update with /standup.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:anchor.name: anchor
pourya7/claude-code-mods:anchor.description: Pin a session to its git worktree: every Bash call runs from the anchor, and the primary checkout is guarded against stray edits and git writes.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:anti-cheat.name: anti-cheat
pourya7/claude-code-mods:anti-cheat.description: No claims without evidence: flags "tests pass", "CI green" and "verified" claims that nothing in the turn backs up.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:co-op.name: co-op
pourya7/claude-code-mods:co-op.description: A second player reviews before the PR: gh pr create waits for a second-model review of the branch diff, and a failing review with a high finding blocks it.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:dock.name: dock
pourya7/claude-code-mods:dock.description: Container stacks per worktree: a pixel-art pane of every compose stack with its memory and worktree, orphans whose worktree is gone, and a guard that asks before booting another stack when memory headroom is low.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:honest-exit.name: honest-exit
pourya7/claude-code-mods:honest-exit.description: Make silent shell failures loud: a glob that matched nothing, a command missing from the agent's shell, or a pipe that hid a failing exit status gets a note the model reads and a peach pixel-art toast.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:mender.name: mender
pourya7/claude-code-mods:mender.description: Fix the arguments, not the model: repairs malformed MCP tool arguments ("true" for true, numbers as strings, unknown keys) against the tool's schema before the call, tells the model what it fixed, and flags servers that are down. A pixel-art patch log.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:party.name: party
pourya7/claude-code-mods:party.description: A raid frame for every live session on the machine: who is working, who is waiting on you and for how long, per-PR locks so two sessions never act on one PR, and /broadcast to the rest of the party.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:prove-it.name: prove-it
pourya7/claude-code-mods:prove-it.description: The fix must make a test fail first: reverts your source changes, runs the changed tests and requires a failure, restores (verified by hash) and requires a pass. Optional gate on git push and gh pr create.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:quicksave.name: quicksave
pourya7/claude-code-mods:quicksave.description: A save point before compaction: the task's goal, step, branch, links, decisions, rules and next step are saved before /compact and handed back to the model after it, with a pixel-art SAVE POINT band when it is safe to compact.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:radar.name: radar
pourya7/claude-code-mods:radar.description: Memory at the moment it matters: when a tool call touches what one of your memory files is about, radar attaches that memory's description and rules for the model to read. A lavender pixel-art radar pings each match.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:respawn.name: respawn
pourya7/claude-code-mods:respawn.description: Auto-continue after a turn dies on a network or API error: a pixel-art CONTINUE? countdown with backoff and 3 lives per hour.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:sentry.name: sentry
pourya7/claude-code-mods:sentry.description: Watch PRs outside the model: polls CI, reviews and threads with gh, wakes the session only when something actionable happens, and denies sleep-poll loops while it watches.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:stance.name: stance
pourya7/claude-code-mods:stance.description: Session modes that are enforced, not requested: investigate, draft, build, ship. Denies the tool calls a stance rules out, auto-switches on phrases like "no code", and shows a pixel-art class badge above the prompt.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:tracer.name: tracer
pourya7/claude-code-mods:tracer.description: Merged is not deployed: follow a merged PR or commit through its workflow runs, deployments and an optional live URL with gh, on a pixel-art level map, and wake the session once when it is live or a stage fails.

pourya7/claude-code-mods:tripwire.name: tripwire
pourya7/claude-code-mods:tripwire.description: Rules that are enforced, not remembered: deny, ask, rewrite or note on any tool call, subagents included. A pixel-art trap for every mistake you already wrote down.

harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/blas.name: blast-radius
harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/blas.description: Catches risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, ...) before they run, forces a permission prompt, and shows what they would touch in a side pane.

harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/chan.name: changed-files
harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/chan.description: A live sidebar of every file Claude touched this session, with +/- line counts.

harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/code.name: codebase-atlas
harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/code.description: Understand a codebase visually: a live architecture map that lights up as Claude reads and edits, a call graph explorer, the session's changes by layer with their impact, a decision timeline, and side-question explanations that never enter your conversation. /atlas

harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/crew.name: crew
harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/crew.description: Agents side pane: every subagent as a little pixel crew member with its model, effort, context, tokens, cost and time; running, completed and planned tasks with their dependencies. /crew

harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/diff.name: diff-minimap
harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/diff.description: A thin minimap strip beside each Edit and Write in the transcript: green, red and yellow ticks show where in the file the change sits, like VS Code's scrollbar.

harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/fork.name: fork-explorer
harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/fork.description: Ask "what if..." in a side pane: a side question over the current session returns 2-3 alternative approaches side by side, without adding anything to your conversation.

harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/miss.name: mission-control
harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/miss.description: Live view of what Claude is executing: every tool call with its input, output and status, subagents in their own lanes, and a network-tab style timeline of durations. Observe-only.

harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/repl.name: replay-theater
harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/repl.description: Records every file edit Claude makes in a turn; /replay steps through the diffs one at a time in a docked pane.

harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/sess.name: session-meter
harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/sess.description: Status line meter: elapsed time, tool calls and files edited this session, plus a toast when a long turn finishes.

harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/usag.name: usage-forecast
harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/usag.description: A band above the prompt with your plan's 5-hour and weekly limits (how much is used, when each resets, and whether you are on pace to run out) plus a forecast for the context window. /forecast

harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/work.name: workbench
harshitmywork17/claude-mods:plugins/work.description: One workspace for watching and understanding Claude's work: a one-line band above the prompt and a pane with Now, Changes (file diffstat, changed functions, highlighted diffs, replay), live Preview, Artifacts, Code Map and Usage. /wb

nvergez/claude-code-mods:voice-summary.name: voice-summary
nvergez/claude-code-mods:voice-summary.description: Speaks a one-sentence summary of each long turn when it ends.

agentic-workbench/agent-quick-menu:..name: agent-quick-menu
agentic-workbench/agent-quick-menu:..description: A pane and prompt band for plugin commands declared in quick-menu.json, plus plugin and Claude Code settings exposed through /config.

ravipatel7/claude-mods:mods/usage-bar.name: usage-bar
ravipatel7/claude-mods:mods/usage-bar.description: 5h/7d rate limits with pace markers, session tokens and cost: above the prompt, or in a /usage pane

andrewstephenson-v1/mod-claude-tasks:..name: human-tasks
andrewstephenson-v1/mod-claude-tasks:..description: A persistent pane of actions Claude needs you to run: tick them off, pick an outcome, or reply, and Claude is told

mkpvishnu/claude-mods:codecraft.name: codecraft
mkpvishnu/claude-mods:codecraft.description: A Minecraft-inspired HUD for Claude Code: hearts for context, armor for safety nets, XP for verified work, and 60 advancements that persist across sessions

IAmAStealer/Claudou:plugin.name: claudou
IAmAStealer/Claudou:plugin.description: A Claude Code buddy: a pixel-art pet above your prompt that grows while you work and teaches you Claude Code

patheonsceo/claudinator:..name: claudinator
patheonsceo/claudinator:..description: Give Claude Code a glow-up: six switchable looks and nine mixable ingredients for tool calls, the working line and turn receipts, plus panes to navigate long sessions. Draws locally, makes no network requests.

MichaelP17/claude-mods:cache-watch.name: cache-watch
MichaelP17/claude-mods:cache-watch.description: Shows how long the prompt cache stays warm and suggests compacting a large context at the right moment

MichaelP17/claude-mods:compact-shaper.name: compact-shaper
MichaelP17/claude-mods:compact-shaper.description: Summarizes compactions as a handoff, and cuts re-readable tool output instead on /compact prune

MichaelP17/claude-mods:concurrency-guard.name: concurrency-guard
MichaelP17/claude-mods:concurrency-guard.description: Caps parallel subagents and monitors; more need a stated reason and the user's approval

MichaelP17/claude-mods:config-snapshots.name: config-snapshots
MichaelP17/claude-mods:config-snapshots.description: Snapshot and roll back the Claude Code configuration through claude-config

MichaelP17/claude-mods:machine-guard.name: machine-guard
MichaelP17/claude-mods:machine-guard.description: Puts every command that changes the machine in front of the user before it runs

MichaelP17/claude-mods:service-radar.name: service-radar
MichaelP17/claude-mods:service-radar.description: Keeps track of detached services Claude starts and stops them on request

MichaelP17/claude-mods:status-band.name: status-band
MichaelP17/claude-mods:status-band.description: Shows context fill and usage limits in the footer under the prompt in the desktop app, where no status line exists

oshnilia/claude-plugins:plugins/session-.name: session-board
oshnilia/claude-plugins:plugins/session-.description: Desktop mod for people who run many sessions: a task brief with criteria and authority at the start, Claude works alone and calls you only for blockers, an acceptance screen and an HTML report at the end. A free mode for brainstorming and prototypes keeps the ideas and ends with a summary. The task folder keeps the ledger, so compaction loses nothing.

itsArnavPrasad/call-it:..name: call-it
itsArnavPrasad/call-it:..description: Talk to your Claude Code sessions from your phone: voice notes out, voice replies back, over Telegram.

YuvalSarel1/claude-plugins:plugins/fleet.name: fleet
YuvalSarel1/claude-plugins:plugins/fleet.description: Your claude agents list in a side pane, with optional cones columns

ABDUAZIZX/script-gate:..name: script-gate
ABDUAZIZX/script-gate:..description: Claude Code mod: blocks running scripts straight from the internet (download-and-execute pipes, encoded PowerShell, LOLBin downloads)

RanaRauff/claude-dev-dashboard:plugins/d.name: dev-dash
RanaRauff/claude-dev-dashboard:plugins/d.description: Developer dashboard pane: what needs you, every Claude session and subagent, usage limits, git and PRs

xuanji86/claude-mdview:..name: mdview
xuanji86/claude-mdview:..description: Click a .md path in the Claude Code conversation to read it rendered as markdown beside the session, pictures included, and point at any block to have Claude edit it.

dcglanton-stack/claude-clubhouse:clubhou.name: clubhouse
dcglanton-stack/claude-clubhouse:clubhou.description: Claude Clubhouse: a toolbar above the prompt, rooms for usage, agents, commands, tool rules and colors, and whole-window themes on macOS

sreshtalluri/claude-mods:archive/side-be.name: side-bet
sreshtalluri/claude-mods:archive/side-be.description: A play-money prediction market on your own Claude session: bet on tests, files touched and permission asks each turn.

sreshtalluri/claude-mods:plugins/daily-g.name: daily-grind
sreshtalluri/claude-mods:plugins/daily-g.description: Daily puzzles to play while Claude works, in two shelves: Developer (word guess, grouping) and Everyone (logic grid).

sreshtalluri/claude-mods:plugins/session.name: session-receipt
sreshtalluri/claude-mods:plugins/session.description: Prints a shareable receipt of your Claude Code session: tokens, cost, tools, files, and a few silly stats.

mlab-sh/mlab-claude-mod:..name: cve-hover
mlab-sh/mlab-claude-mod:..description: Highlight CVE IDs in Claude's replies; hover one to see vuln.mlab.sh data

rightlabs/claude-open-points:..name: open-points
rightlabs/claude-open-points:..description: A live view of your project's open points or TODO markdown file: a side pane grouped by status and a one-line count above the prompt.

trytofly94/handoff-compact:..name: handoff-compact
trytofly94/handoff-compact:..description: Replaces Claude Code's compaction with a structured handoff: a fork of the session writes it from the prompt cache, and the conversation continues from exactly that handoff.

2bo/pr-inbox:..name: pr-inbox
2bo/pr-inbox:..description: An inbox for review requests and your own PRs: AI summary and risk, an AI review that can approve, a reader for the description and diff, merging (gh stack too) and CI fixes with Claude

ABDUAZIZX/env-guard:..name: env-guard
ABDUAZIZX/env-guard:..description: Claude Code mod: blocks Claude from reading .env secret files and counts blocked attempts in the status line

Gorossy/task-planner:..name: task-planner
Gorossy/task-planner:..description: Recomienda modelo, effort y subagentes al empezar una tarea nueva y aplica la eleccion en silencio.

ktripathi2281/LoopDetector:loop-detector.name: loop-detector
ktripathi2281/LoopDetector:loop-detector.description: Warns when Claude Code seems stuck repeating the same edits, commands or failures

JetsonChan/CC-Usage-Band:usage-band.name: usage-band
JetsonChan/CC-Usage-Band:usage-band.description: A band above the prompt showing your 5-hour and 7-day limits, context window and prompt-cache hit rate, styled for the terminal and the desktop app

JetsonChan/claude-code-mods:usage-band.name: usage-band
JetsonChan/claude-code-mods:usage-band.description: A band above the prompt showing your 5-hour and 7-day limits, context window and prompt-cache hit rate, styled for the terminal and the desktop app

mareksulik/appshot:..name: appshot
mareksulik/appshot:..description: Press both ⌘ keys to give Claude the window you're looking at: a screenshot plus its text, including text scrolled offscreen (macOS)

DarioFontanel/claude-code-mods:cache-met.name: cache-meter
DarioFontanel/claude-code-mods:cache-met.description: Barra sopra il prompt che si svuota col tempo: quanto resta dell'ora di prompt cache dall'ultima richiesta

DarioFontanel/claude-code-mods:next-step.name: next-steps
DarioFontanel/claude-code-mods:next-step.description: Tre bottoni sopra il prompt a fine turno: i due prossimi passi naturali della conversazione e Replay

DarioFontanel/claude-code-mods:quick-but.name: quick-buttons
DarioFontanel/claude-code-mods:quick-but.description: Pannello di bottoni rapidi: al primo avvio scegli quali skill e comandi diventano bottoni, poi li lanci con un click

DarioFontanel/claude-code-mods:replay-th.name: replay-theater
DarioFontanel/claude-code-mods:replay-th.description: Replay Theater: step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time.

CocoSgt/yujie-mod:..name: yujie
CocoSgt/yujie-mod:..description: 雨姐陪你写代码：像素工位面板、状态栏、提示条，报错会黑脸，rm -rf 会被拦下，还能开东北话唠嗑模式

desuqcafe/cc-mascot:mascot.name: mascot
desuqcafe/cc-mascot:mascot.description: A desktop mascot overlay that reacts to turns, tool calls and subagents

MaeharaTakumi/claude-usage-band:plugins/.name: usage-band
MaeharaTakumi/claude-usage-band:plugins/.description: Always-visible usage rings and time until reset above the prompt

NeelAPatel/Claude-Mod-ConversationAtlas:.name: conversation-atlas
NeelAPatel/Claude-Mod-ConversationAtlas:.description: A live side pane that maps a long Claude Code session: goal, current path, possible detours, decisions, open questions, checkpoints, working files and what to resume next. It observes on its own and asks before changing your intent.

yuk7392/prompt-coach:..name: prompt-coach
yuk7392/prompt-coach:..description: Buttons above the prompt box that ask what your draft is missing and refine it

shissncg/claude-mods:mods/turn-timestamp.name: turn-timestamp

vgnshiyer/nowloading:..name: nowloading
vgnshiyer/nowloading:..description: The line that animates while Claude works, redrawn as something from before: tape decks, departure boards, an hourglass, a floppy drive, a dot-matrix printer, an arcade rally, a filmstrip, and a pixel campfire.

dixonSolutions/ClaudeKeys:..name: claudekeys

JinHang02/claude-code-pokemon:plugin.description: Your Pokémon party journeys through a pixel world above the Claude Code prompt: it runs while Claude works, cheers when tests pass, faints when they fail, levels up and evolves.

skysf/skylu-mods:plugins/context-bar.description: Your context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, one color per /context category. Click a category to see what fills it; /context-bar toggles the bar.

xuanji86/claude-statuspane:..name: statuspane
xuanji86/claude-statuspane:..description: A floating status card above the Claude Code prompt — model, effort, context, 5h/week limits, cost, directory and branch, GitHub CI and deploys — with clickable settings and a progress-row API any script or mod can feed.

TheMizeGuy/clawdagotchi:plugins/mize-cow.name: mize-coworker
TheMizeGuy/clawdagotchi:plugins/mize-cow.description: Claude as a small coworker in the terminal: an orange pixel-art Claude, two rows tall, in 132 frames. While a turn runs he sits beside the spinner in a scene for every spinner word (a thought bubble, a pen on a notepad, a book, a magnifying glass over text or over a globe, a laptop, a terminal, his own small helpers, a gear, a scroll for a skill, a plug for an MCP call); idle on the status row he breathes, blinks, strolls, yawns and sips a coffee, sweats near a full context and sleeps frosted once the prompt cache goes cold. While the main session rests and agents or workflows work in the background he minds them with a skit every few seconds: a rocket as they start, a paddle with how many are at work, a radar, a headset, a helper bringing a finished agent's report, juggling, bubble gum, popcorn, a paper plane, a plant that grows with the wait. The spinner word says what is happening (Reading register.ts, Running npm), and /coworker demo plays every animation once. Draws only; nothing reaches the model.

jewdev/claude-spotify-mod:spotify.name: spotify
jewdev/claude-spotify-mod:spotify.description: Spotify inside Claude Code: player pane with album art and a visualizer, synced lyrics, a Claude DJ that learns your taste, a chime when Claude finishes or needs you, a focus timer, your library, a session recap, and a settings page.

railyai/claude-code-mods:plugins/raily-m.description: Raily is a personal AI agent that finds people worth meeting for you (friends, dates, business contacts) and handles the first contact. This mod shows your Raily inbox above the Claude Code prompt: new matches with name, city and score, contact requests, unread chats and questions from your agent, with a toast for each new event. Read-only. Needs a Raily account (18+) and the Raily MCP server connected.

LorcanChinnock/claude-desk-neighbours:pl.description: 🔔 Closes the PR loop: watches a PR until CI and agent reviews are green, and weighs review comments before acting on them.

LorcanChinnock/claude-desk-neighbours:pl.name: grudge
LorcanChinnock/claude-desk-neighbours:pl.description: 😤 Remembers your corrections: offers to hold a lasting preference, reminds Claude of it every session, and fixes commands it can swap safely.

LorcanChinnock/claude-desk-neighbours:pl.name: previously-on

threesil/claude-mods:plugins/claw-heartb.description: Claw mod: wakes Claw up on a schedule inside a running Claude Code session. Daily briefing at a set time, periodic checks for overdue tasks, quiet hours, and an optional auto-run mode that makes Claude do the heartbeat by itself.

threesil/claude-mods:plugins/claw-hud.name: claw-hud
threesil/claude-mods:plugins/claw-hud.description: Claw mod: a task band above the prompt and a /hud pane to add and tick off tasks, reading the same TASKS.md as the Claw skill.

rb17080/trek-band:plugins/trek-band.name: trek-band
rb17080/trek-band:plugins/trek-band.description: A lilac band above the Claude Code prompt: live 5-hour and weekly usage, and Clawd acting out iconic Star Trek scenes.

cprussin/claude-code-mods:packages/prote.name: protect-env-files

Certicore/ClaudeMOD:progress.name: progress

Claude reports its own progress through the report_progress tool it registers; a chime plays when a step completes and an arpeggio when a plan finishes. Below the plans, what is left of the 5-hour and 7-day plan windows, with a limit you drag into place that pauses the work when it is reached. Each project folder keeps its own band.

xiaolai/claude-rich-terminal:..name: rich-terminal
xiaolai/claude-rich-terminal:..description: Mermaid diagrams drawn inside Claude Code replies, and a truecolor status line under the prompt with a Token Weather forecast of the context window.

tak-kam/claude-mods:file-explorer.name: file-explorer
tak-kam/claude-mods:file-explorer.description: A VS Code-style file explorer pane: tree, git decorations, preview and @-mention

reporails/arcade:doom.name: doom

reporails/arcade:minefield.name: minefield
reporails/arcade:minefield.description: The classic mine-clearing puzzle in a Claude Code pane: click or use the keys to clear the board while Claude works. A timer, a best time, and a face that watches the board and glances over at Claude's work.

briangtn/claude-gfm-render:..name: gfm-render

AhmedNazihX/claude-mods:turn-timeline.name: turn-timeline
AhmedNazihX/claude-mods:turn-timeline.description: A tool timeline card above each reply: every tool call with a bar showing when it ran and for how long, and why any call was denied or failed

eel-brah/burn-baby-burn:..name: burn-baby-burn
eel-brah/burn-baby-burn:..description: Nags you, with fire, when much of your weekly usage limit is still unspent close to the reset

gonzalonicolasr/claude-code-nerv:..name: nerv

Ariiima/claude-code-persian-to-english-v.name: persian-voice

choas/claude-mods:cwd-status.name: cwd-status

ccdwyer/fault-lacquer:..name: fault-lacquer

0xGondarxyz/claude-code-mods:slopless.name: slopless
0xGondarxyz/claude-code-mods:slopless.description: Blocks AI sounding text in social media writing (X replies, X posts, LinkedIn posts) and injects the writing rules.

0xGondarxyz/claude-code-mods:snap.name: snap
0xGondarxyz/claude-code-mods:snap.description: /snap: drag a box on screen with Spectacle and the screenshot goes into your next message.

0xGondarxyz/claude-code-mods:spiral-stop.name: spiral-stop

0xGondarxyz/claude-code-mods:usage-meter.name: usage-meter
0xGondarxyz/claude-code-mods:usage-meter.description: Shows your Claude 5 hour and weekly rate limits in the status line and warns at 80% and 90%.
