barmoshe/bar-mods:rtl-kit.description: Right-to-left for Claude Code mods: one file to copy into a mod that orders Hebrew and Arabic right on every surface, aligns wrapped text right, draws markdown, cards, tabs, tables and SVG headers, and reorders text for the terminal

barmoshe/bar-mods:surface-probe.name: surface-probe
barmoshe/bar-mods:surface-probe.description: A pane that shows what this surface does before you design for it: its width and placement, which elements it draws, right-to-left text, SVG, and whether a button can send Claude a message

barmoshe/bar-mods:turn-meter.name: turn-meter
barmoshe/bar-mods:turn-meter.description: A band above the prompt: the tool running now during a turn, and a one-line summary of the last turn after it

ChristianBuzzetti/ClaudeMods:mods/bobert.name: boberto
ChristianBuzzetti/ClaudeMods:mods/bobert.description: Boberto, a bat-winged mascot drawn at run time by its own Canvas engine: a pane with a wardrobe and idle gestures, and an animated reaction under each assistant reply

ChristianBuzzetti/ClaudeMods:mods/usage-.name: usage-meters
ChristianBuzzetti/ClaudeMods:mods/usage-.description: Animated usage strip above the prompt plus a Details pane: context window, 5-hour and weekly caps, cache hits, token flow and per-subagent spend

schreibse/claude-code-mods:coderabbit-ba.name: coderabbit-band
schreibse/claude-code-mods:coderabbit-ba.description: A band above the prompt with the open CodeRabbit threads and nitpicks of the branch's MR

schreibse/claude-code-mods:handover.name: handover
schreibse/claude-code-mods:handover.description: The handover sentence for a cold session: a band above the prompt, /handover-copy to copy it, and after /clear the sentence waits in the prompt as a suggestion

schreibse/claude-code-mods:mem-guard.name: mem-guard
schreibse/claude-code-mods:mem-guard.description: Bash memory rules: Node commands run in claude-cmd.slice, and runs that would starve the machine are refused

schreibse/claude-code-mods:mr-banner.name: mr-banner
schreibse/claude-code-mods:mr-banner.description: A colored card with a link under each MR/PR created, merged, approved or reviewed

schreibse/claude-code-mods:quiet-bash.name: quiet-bash
schreibse/claude-code-mods:quiet-bash.description: One-line tool rows, tool output hidden, inline PNG thumbnails; /quiet shows everything, /thumb shows a PNG

schreibse/claude-code-mods:quiet-spinner.name: quiet-spinner
schreibse/claude-code-mods:quiet-spinner.description: Plain words for the turn spinner and the turn-duration line

schreibse/claude-code-mods:redact.name: redact
schreibse/claude-code-mods:redact.description: Secrets found by betterleaks reach the model as ‹secret:…› tokens; Write/Edit restore them, other tools refuse them

schreibse/claude-code-mods:reminder-log.name: reminder-log
schreibse/claude-code-mods:reminder-log.description: Tallies the reminders Claude Code injects for the model, per session; drops the token counter and repeated attribution blocks; /reminders prints the last 30 days

schreibse/claude-code-mods:usage-percent.name: usage-percent
schreibse/claude-code-mods:usage-percent.description: A row under the prompt: context, 5-hour and weekly usage; in Nx repos also memory, the session's nx serve projects and the branch's pipeline

Gooner44/ClaudeMods:plugins/staff-board.name: staff-board
Gooner44/ClaudeMods:plugins/staff-board.description: A compact band of your sessions (Claude, Aesop, named desktop sessions and what they spawn): Clawds coloured by model, glowing by effort, each with its current work

Gooner44/ClaudeMods:plugins/usage-bar.name: usage-bar
Gooner44/ClaudeMods:plugins/usage-bar.description: Band above the prompt showing Session, Weekly and Fable 5.1 usage

mtmtian/cc-mods:mods/cache-timer/plugins.name: cache-timer
mtmtian/cc-mods:mods/cache-timer/plugins.description: Counts down, in the prompt footer beside the model, the time left before the main thread's prompt cache lapses, so you know when the next message will pay to re-write it

mtmtian/cc-mods:mods/md-prompt/plugins/m.name: md-prompt
mtmtian/cc-mods:mods/md-prompt/plugins/m.description: Paints Markdown onto Claude Code's prompt box as you type: fenced code becomes a syntax-highlighted card (even before you close the fence), and inline code, bold, italic, lists, task lists, quotes, tables, links and headings are styled. Paint only, your text is never changed.

mtmtian/cc-mods:mods/plan-progress/plugi.name: plan-progress
mtmtian/cc-mods:mods/plan-progress/plugi.description: Live plan progress bars above the Claude Code prompt: stages, steps, a pixel fill and soft sounds for decision, error and done

Para-FR/claude-code-mods-fr:cockpit.name: cockpit
Para-FR/claude-code-mods-fr:cockpit.description: Panneau live des statistiques de la session : tours, outils, tokens, durées et fichiers modifiés. Ouvert par /cockpit.

Para-FR/claude-code-mods-fr:garde-du-cor.name: garde-du-corps
Para-FR/claude-code-mods-fr:garde-du-cor.description: Bloque l'accès aux fichiers .env et les commandes Bash destructrices, avec toast et compteur dans la status line.

nateherkai/claude-code-mods:cache-keeper.name: cache-keeper
nateherkai/claude-code-mods:cache-keeper.description: Keeps a big chat's prompt cache warm, warns before an expensive cold restart, shows every local chat on one board (/board), and hands a chat off to a fresh one (/handoff)

nateherkai/claude-code-mods:collision-gu.name: collision-guard
nateherkai/claude-code-mods:collision-gu.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another open chat changed in the last 30 minutes: Proceed, Move to a worktree, or Cancel (/guard)

nateherkai/claude-code-mods:goal-meter.name: goal-meter
nateherkai/claude-code-mods:goal-meter.description: A progress bar for /goal built from Claude's own task plan: tasks done out of the plan, elapsed time, an ETA at the goal's own pace, and every chat's goal in /goals

nateherkai/claude-code-mods:recording-mo.name: recording-mode
nateherkai/claude-code-mods:recording-mo.description: /rec before you record: masks keys, personal details, and business figures on screen and keeps private files closed (/rec strict, /rec off, /rec config)

leopiney/wolfbud-claude-mod:mods/wolfbud.name: wolfbud
leopiney/wolfbud-claude-mod:mods/wolfbud.description: WolfBud: a voice coworker (ElevenLabs agent + 3D wolf) that watches the session and can send prompts to Claude

0xGondarxyz/spiral-stop:..name: spiral-stop
0xGondarxyz/spiral-stop:..description: Stops fix loops: when the same error returns after 3 fix attempts, tells you and Claude to stop and rethink

JustinPerea/notch-crab:mod.name: notch-crab
JustinPerea/notch-crab:mod.description: A pixel crab above your Claude Code prompt that acts out every hook (33 reactions). Thin bars beside him track the context window and your 5-hour and weekly limits. Works on its own. If the notch-crab Mac app (not released yet) is running, the mod also sends it each hook event's name, session id, tool name and ids, notification type and working directory, plus how many tools a batch ran, so the crab in your MacBook's notch reacts too. That goes over a local Unix socket and never includes prompts, tool inputs or outputs. The full list is in mod/hooks/wire.mjs.

0xGondarxyz/secret-guard:..name: secret-guard
0xGondarxyz/secret-guard:..description: Masks API keys and tokens in tool results before Claude reads them, and blocks a git push that would leak secrets or home paths to a public repo.

ozlar34/claude-code-mods:burn-guard.name: burn-guard
ozlar34/claude-code-mods:burn-guard.description: Guards the 5h usage window: caps expensive-tier spawns per turn, keeps Fable spawns manual-only, draws a colour-coded usage gauge above the prompt (5h bar, reset time, turn burn, cache warmth, context size), and offers handoff + clear past a context size.

ozlar34/claude-code-mods:needs-you.name: needs-you
ozlar34/claude-code-mods:needs-you.description: CC Alerts: pings you (macOS banner + sound) when a session finishes a long turn or sits blocked on a dialog, only as loudly as needed given whether you're already looking. /ping controls quiet modes.

ozlar34/claude-code-mods:outward-gate.name: outward-gate
ozlar34/claude-code-mods:outward-gate.description: Confirm dialog before outward-facing sends and out-of-vault deletes; off switch for unattended runs; always-on audit log.

achiurizo/dreeft:..name: dreeft
achiurizo/dreeft:..description: Band above the prompt showing what the session's thinking is doing: focus, a turn timeline, and turn cost

richard-parayno/ccsidebar:..name: ccsidebar
richard-parayno/ccsidebar:..description: Toggle-able right sidebar for Claude Code: usage limits, context window, prompt-cache countdown, activity and touched files

arthur-fontaine/cc-mod-auto-effort:..name: auto-effort
arthur-fontaine/cc-mod-auto-effort:..description: Picks Claude's effort level for each prompt with a System One decision model

ozansozuozgit/clawd-mods:plugins/clawd-g.name: clawd-ghost
ozansozuozgit/clawd-mods:plugins/clawd-g.description: Unofficial fan-made mod: before Claude edits a file, a ghost Clawd shows what happened to that file before (your past decisions, git history, your own past words) so settled choices don't quietly swing back. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

samgutentag-deepgram/claude-code-voice-m.name: deepgram-voice
samgutentag-deepgram/claude-code-voice-m.description: Deepgram as Claude Code's voice: TTS readback of replies, overriding the system synthesizer

elijah-rou/agent-kit:claude/mods/trial-t.name: trial-tools
elijah-rou/agent-kit:claude/mods/trial-t.description: Clipboard commands, read-only Git changes, and turn-level token throughput.

talbarina/claude-editor-context:plugins/.name: editor-context
talbarina/claude-editor-context:plugins/.description: Shows the file and lines you have selected in Cursor or VS Code above the Claude Code prompt in the desktop app, and quietly tells Claude what you're looking at with each message

retrocodes12/context-relay:..name: context-relay
retrocodes12/context-relay:..description: Hands the work to a fresh session before a long context degrades the model, and carries on there.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/bumper.name: bumper-sticker
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/bumper.description: Your own words on the busy line while Claude works, in place of Baking, Brewing and the rest.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/clip.name: clip
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/clip.description: Put text on your clipboard from the prompt, cleaned of terminal clutter.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/dashbo.name: rostech-dashboard
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/dashbo.description: A Dashboard button above the prompt that opens a panel you fill yourself: effort, helper model, launch buttons and a status row. Fully customisable: just ask your Claude to put what you want in it.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/gas-ga.name: gas-gauge
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/gas-ga.description: A fuel gauge above the prompt: how much of your Claude plan is left, and when it refills.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/gloveb.name: rostech-glovebox
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/gloveb.description: Keeps the notes that matter in the glovebox, and hands them back to Claude after it compacts its memory. Text notes only: never video, never the screen, never your location. Sends nothing anywhere.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/hands-.name: hands-off
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/hands-.description: Files you mark as yours: Claude cannot edit them until you hand them back.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/horn.name: horn
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/horn.description: One chord to send now: /horn sets Ctrl+X Ctrl+X to send a waiting message right away, like a tap on the horn, and the hint under the prompt says so.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/logo.name: logo
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/logo.description: Your own logo on the dash above the prompt, between your other bands.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/odomet.name: odometer
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/odomet.description: An odometer above the prompt: how long this session has run and what it has cost.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/oil.name: oil
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/oil.description: An oil gauge above the prompt: this week's Fable use, beside Gas Gauge.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/pin.name: pin
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/pin.description: A short to-do list pinned above the prompt, ticked off with one click.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/pop.name: pop
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/pop.description: Open a link or a file in its own window, straight from the prompt.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/radio.name: radio
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/radio.description: A chime when Claude finishes a long turn, so you can look away.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/shot.name: shot
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/shot.description: Hand Claude the picture on your clipboard in one command.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/speedo.name: speedometer
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/speedo.description: A speedometer above the prompt: how full the context window is, from 0 to MAX.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/steeri.name: steering-wheel
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/steeri.description: Steer Claude mid-turn with one chord. /steering-wheel sets Ctrl+X Ctrl+X to send a waiting message right away, and the hint under the prompt says so.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/sticky.name: sticky-note
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/sticky.description: A note above the prompt that stays until you clear it.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/tach.name: tach
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/tach.description: A tachometer above the prompt: how fast you are burning tokens, over a window you choose.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/valet-.name: valet-mode
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:plugins/valet-.description: A look-only mode for someone else at your PC: Claude can read and answer, but cannot change anything until you unlock it.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/check-en.name: check-engine
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/check-en.description: His name, 2 Oct 2026. What it does is not decided yet.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/clip.name: clip
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/clip.description: Puts a value on your clipboard, cleaned of terminal decoration.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/clock.name: clock
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/clock.description: The real time on the dash, read at the moment you look.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/control-.name: control-panel
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/control-.description: A pane of every setting you use, with the word that changes each one.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/dashcam.name: dashcam
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/dashcam.description: Records what Claude did while you were away, to play back later.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/drop-fol.name: drop-folder
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/drop-fol.description: A band when files are waiting in a folder you name, like a phone drop.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/gps.name: gps
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/gps.description: A progress map for long jobs: where you are and how much is left. Not location tracking. It never reads where you or your computer are.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/horn.name: horn
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/horn.description: For emergencies only: a loud alarm when something has gone badly wrong. Radio is the everyday chime.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/house-st.name: house-style
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/house-st.description: Your reply rules, sent to Claude every turn, with one switch to turn them off.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/human-si.name: human-signoff
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/human-si.description: Refuses a release step until a person marks it played.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/leak-gua.name: leak-guard
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/leak-gua.description: Refuses a git commit that carries a value you listed as private.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/memory-t.name: memory-trim
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/memory-t.description: Keeps your memory index under the length Claude reads in full.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/needs-yo.name: needs-you-chime
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/needs-yo.description: Plays a sound when Claude finishes or needs an answer from you.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/on-camer.name: on-camera
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/on-camer.description: Streaming mode. Hides names, paths and keys you list from tool output before they reach the screen.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/open-it.name: open-it
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/open-it.description: Opens a result in your browser, with markdown rendered first.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/page-pil.name: page-pile
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/page-pil.description: Keeps a dated local copy of every artifact page Claude publishes. Only ever adds.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/perm-aud.name: perm-audit
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/perm-aud.description: A pane of what this machine lets Claude do, read from settings.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/pin.name: pin
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/pin.description: A pinned to-do band above the prompt.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/read-alo.name: read-aloud
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/read-alo.description: Reads the last answer out loud.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/rearview.name: rearview
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/rearview.description: His name, 2 Oct 2026. What it does is not decided yet.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/record.name: record
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/record.description: Writes every exchange to a dated file you keep.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/run-by-n.name: run-by-name
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/run-by-n.description: Runs a repo script by its bare name.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/seatbelt.name: seatbelt
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/seatbelt.description: A backup taken automatically before anything risky. A working idea; he may pick something else.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/skins.name: skins
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/skins.description: Claude Code wearing a colour skin of your choice.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/tool-gap.name: tool-gaps
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/tool-gap.description: Finds the commands you keep typing by hand that should be tools.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/turn-met.name: turn-meter
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/turn-met.description: How long and how many tool calls each turn took, charted.

DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/wipers.name: wipers
DJPalefaceSD/rostech-mods:stubs/wipers.description: Hides the bands above the prompt for a clear screen. Nothing is deleted; one more press brings them back.

amigoer/ccprogress:plugins/ccprogress.name: ccprogress
amigoer/ccprogress:plugins/ccprogress.description: A progress bar of the current task above the spinner, in the terminal and the Desktop app

chrishan17/claude-mod-context-window:plu.name: context-window
chrishan17/claude-mod-context-window:plu.description: A pane listing everything that entered the context window since the session started, by turn and by category

zherring/basepaint-claude-mod:basepaint.name: basepaint
zherring/basepaint-claude-mod:basepaint.description: Live BasePaint canvas and activity feed while Claude works

ThomasTartrau/charts:..name: charts
ThomasTartrau/charts:..description: Dessine les blocs vega-lite des réponses et des aperçus AskUserQuestion en vraies images (PNG dans Ghostty, SVG sur le desktop).

Interesting-Systems/under-management-cla.name: under-management
Interesting-Systems/under-management-cla.description: Play Under Management while Claude works on a long turn. After 20 s of work, press 1: the game opens in a 960 x 600 window of its own and pauses itself when Claude finishes.

yibudak/cc-prompt-enhance-mod:..name: cc-prompt-enhance-mod
yibudak/cc-prompt-enhance-mod:..description: Enhance button above the prompt: Sonnet sharpens your draft using the recent conversation

hellosverre/claude-skins:..name: skins
hellosverre/claude-skins:..description: Skins for Claude Code's transcript: themed tool rows, reply gutters and spinner words. /skin swaps them live.

promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.name: auto-handoff
promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.description: Writes a cold-start handoff to handoff/ before the context fills up or compacts, and offers to resume from it in the next session.

promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.name: changes-receipt
promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.description: A plain-English receipt after every turn: files created, changed and deleted, by tool or via shell, with failed attempts listed apart.

promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.name: context-meter
promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.description: Context window and session cost meter, drawn above the prompt.

promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.name: coral-skin
promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.description: Coral, ink and cream reskin of Claude Code with risk-coded tool rows. Toggle with /skin.

promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.name: flight-recorder
promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.description: See inside a turn: a live Gantt timeline of model requests, tool calls and subagents, with tokens and cost per lane.

promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.name: model-router
promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.description: Route supported subagent work to Sonnet or Haiku while keeping the main conversation on its model. /router for controls.

promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.name: output-tray
promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.description: A side panel of the files this session created, with Open, Reveal in Finder and Copy path.

promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.name: repo-heatmap
promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.description: Watch where Claude looks: a live treemap of the repo that lights up as files are read, searched and edited.

promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.name: session-bookmarks
promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.description: Explicit bookmarks for Claude Code sessions you want to come back to. /bm saves one, /bm open lists them with a copyable resume command.

promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.name: terminal-pet
promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:p.description: A pixel-art crab above the prompt that reacts live to what Claude is doing. /pet for commands.

promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:t.name: read-counter-example
promptadvisers/claude-mods-starter-kit:t.description: Teaching example: count successful Read events.

estruyf/claude-agent-watch-mod:plugins/a.name: agent-watch
estruyf/claude-agent-watch-mod:plugins/a.description: Keeps the number of running Claude Code sessions under a limit and shows the ones waiting on you or sitting idle.

powerofjinbo/claude-code-spell-bar:plugi.name: spell-bar
powerofjinbo/claude-code-spell-bar:plugi.description: An animated effort bar for Claude Code: Clawd casts Avada Kedavra at six ranks, one per effort level from low to ultracode, with Voldemort looming behind.

AlexandreMartinezOlmos/claude-code-leaks.name: leakstop
AlexandreMartinezOlmos/claude-code-leaks.description: Stops secrets from leaking before they are written, printed or committed to git.

nokiy/claude-code-mods:plugins/agent-mon.name: agent-monitor
nokiy/claude-code-mods:plugins/agent-mon.description: Subagent monitor: a live band above the prompt for running agents, and /sub: this session's subagent history with alerts (file conflicts, stalls, tier mismatches, denied calls), a detail page per agent (select a row, Enter), a cost estimate, and an in-panel settings page (/sub set), in a band above the prompt or a side pane.

nokiy/claude-code-mods:plugins/paste-pee.name: paste-peek
nokiy/claude-code-mods:plugins/paste-pee.description: See the images you paste into the prompt, in real pixels, right above it: switch between them with ⌥←/⌥→, zoom one with ⌥↑, open it in a side pane with ⌥↓. macOS, foreground Ghostty or kitty.

nokiy/claude-code-mods:plugins/pr-hint.name: pr-hint
nokiy/claude-code-mods:plugins/pr-hint.description: Shows the current branch's PR on the prompt hint row (title and its state: Draft, Ready or Merged); hover the hint row to preview a card of the spec, integration branch, CI and every ticket's progress, click the ▸ before the PR number to keep it open.

benredmond/idle-compact:idle-compact.name: idle-compact
benredmond/idle-compact:idle-compact.description: Compacts an idle session just before its prompt cache expires, so returning does not re-write the full context

hamza-siddiq/claude-eta:eta.name: eta

scoobynko/claude-code-mods:plugins/md-vi.name: md-view

AltamimiYasser/claude-code-bar:plugins/b.name: bar

abhibansal60/claude-mods:on-me.name: on-me

abhibansal60/claude-mods:ship-state.name: ship-state
abhibansal60/claude-mods:ship-state.description: Pane: uncommitted, unpushed, CI and deploy state of each repo this session touched

abhibansal60/claude-mods:twin-meter.name: twin-meter
abhibansal60/claude-mods:twin-meter.description: 5h and 7d limits of both cswap accounts in the band above the prompt

aksh1618/claude-mods:chameleon.name: chameleon
aksh1618/claude-mods:chameleon.description: Gives a session a random /color when it gets a new identity: the first /rename, unless the mod has already coloured it or seen you run /color, and every /branch.

aksh1618/claude-mods:skill-session-mods.name: skill-session-mods
aksh1618/claude-mods:skill-session-mods.description: Names and colours a session from metadata in the SKILL.md of a skill typed as /<skill>.

scasella/claude-flightdeck:..name: flightdeck

KhadeerBasha1232/claude-usage-mod:plugin.name: usage-band

jerrywang33/openmod:dist/plugins/flight-.name: flight-recorder
jerrywang33/openmod:dist/plugins/flight-.description: Observe tool timing and outcomes without retaining arguments or output.

jerrywang33/openmod:dist/plugins/tool-co.description: Count tool calls alongside the Claude Code spinner.

wickedhardflip/claude-code-mods:first-mo.name: first-mod
wickedhardflip/claude-code-mods:first-mo.description: Starter mod: toast on start, status line counts tool calls

wickedhardflip/claude-code-mods:run-brea.name: run-breakdown
wickedhardflip/claude-code-mods:run-brea.description: Band above the prompt: after a long run, which model and effort the main session, each subagent, Gemini and Ollama used

wickedhardflip/claude-code-mods:session-.name: session-recap
wickedhardflip/claude-code-mods:session-.description: Band above the prompt: open questions Claude asked you plus bullets of what the last prompt did

wickedhardflip/claude-code-mods:subagent.name: subagent-models
wickedhardflip/claude-code-mods:subagent.description: Status line shows which model each running subagent is using

ishuagrawal/clawdhouse:plugin.name: clawdhouse
ishuagrawal/clawdhouse:plugin.description: A pixel Clawd in a side pane that reacts to what Claude is doing

cbruyndoncx/claude-skills-manager-mod:..name: skills-manager
cbruyndoncx/claude-skills-manager-mod:..description: Manage AI agent skills (SKILL.md), playbooks and value chains: list, toggle, categorise, install from GitHub/monorepo/ZIP/local/marketplace, update, freeze, scan, export, index; run and organise playbooks; map skills and playbooks to value chains. Port of the Obsidian Skills Manager plugin plus BOB playbooks.

ShahriarBijoy/claude-mods:stack.name: stack
ShahriarBijoy/claude-mods:stack.description: Stacked progress band above the prompt: tasks, subagents, rate limits and monthly cost

udaaff/claude-code-session-monitor:..name: session-monitor
udaaff/claude-code-session-monitor:..description: A side panel of all your open Claude Code sessions: what each one is doing, live, with a pixel creature per session.

udaaff/claude-code-session-notes:..name: session-notes
udaaff/claude-code-session-notes:..description: Project notes in .claude/notes.md: live dev servers, recent artifacts and pinned links, in a side panel and with /notes.

nickdemari/ember:..name: ember
nickdemari/ember:..description: Follows what you and Claude are doing: says the step in the spinner line, whose move it is above the prompt, and chimes when it's yours.

bixxter/adlib-lyrics:..name: adlib-lyrics
bixxter/adlib-lyrics:..description: Synced lyrics of what's playing in Music or Spotify, word by word, above the prompt

PickleBoxer/burn:..name: burn
PickleBoxer/burn:..description: Rate limits, usage credits and spend above the prompt, with a /burn pane for the last 7 days

Zaho92/claude-arcade:plugin.name: arcade
Zaho92/claude-arcade:plugin.description: Retro games in a Claude Code pane that run while Claude works and freeze the moment it needs you.

sofanaja44/slash:..name: slash
sofanaja44/slash:..description: Memilih model dan effort Claude secara otomatis sesuai tingkat kesulitan tugas, tanpa membuang prompt cache, dengan statistik biaya di status line.

zhanbodev/clawd-spinner:..name: clawd-buddy
zhanbodev/clawd-spinner:..description: Clawd, Claude Code's pixel mascot, lives above your prompt in the terminal and the desktop app: it acts out what Claude is doing, chats with you, dances to your music, plays a runner game, and in the desktop app idles in a little pixel San Francisco

SaGgaSsa/claude-mods:sudoku.name: sudoku
SaGgaSsa/claude-mods:sudoku.description: A sudoku in a Claude Code pane, saved per workspace folder

SaGgaSsa/claude-mods:trivia.name: trivia
SaGgaSsa/claude-mods:trivia.description: A quiz-show question ladder in the band above the prompt, played by clicking

kguidonimartins/claude-mods:plugins/gril.name: grill-answer
kguidonimartins/claude-mods:plugins/gril.description: A pane for answering the question rounds of the grilling / grill-me skill

FayequeP/sidebar:..name: sidebar
FayequeP/sidebar:..description: Shows the model's real output speed, token and prompt-cache stats in a docked sidebar beside the transcript.

0xGondarxyz/output-ladder:..name: output-ladder
0xGondarxyz/output-ladder:..description: Re-explain the last answer as ASD-STE100 text, a diagram, an HTML page or an explainer video, and score answers for STE style.

LeanZo/lean-switchboard:plugins/lean-swi.name: lean-switchboard
LeanZo/lean-switchboard:plugins/lean-swi.description: Lean Switchboard: one list of every plugin, connector and skill in Claude Code, each with an on/off switch for new sessions

philm123/claude-code-receipts:..name: receipts
philm123/claude-code-receipts:..description: Receipts for consultants: a scope creep siren for change orders, and undo receipts that turn rm into a move to trash with a Restore button.

therahul-yo/clawdman:..name: clawdman

none-ascetic/claude-mods:house-rules.name: house-rules
none-ascetic/claude-mods:house-rules.description: Quietly enforces Paddy's writing rules: no em dashes in chat, files or outbound messages, and a nudge when replies run long.

none-ascetic/claude-mods:identity-guard.name: identity-guard
none-ascetic/claude-mods:identity-guard.description: Stops commits and pushes under the wrong git identity (the work email) before they reach GitHub, and says exactly how to fix it.

thefotes/pane-arcade:..name: arcade
thefotes/pane-arcade:..description: Play Snake, Minesweeper, 2048, chess (vs Stockfish) and CHIP-8 ROMs in a pane while Claude works.

stanvx/flow-stack:..name: flow
stanvx/flow-stack:..description: Tracks a task through Matt Pocock's idea-to-ship flow, shows the next step above the prompt, and holds a build until its checks prove it.

DominickGiordano/claude-mods:auth-guard.name: auth-guard
DominickGiordano/claude-mods:auth-guard.description: Spots an expired CLI login in tool output and offers a Login button that signs in and retries.

DominickGiordano/claude-mods:fleet.name: fleet
DominickGiordano/claude-mods:fleet.description: /fleet shows every live Claude Code session on this machine, and /send messages one.

DominickGiordano/claude-mods:pr-watch.name: pr-watch
DominickGiordano/claude-mods:pr-watch.description: Watches the PRs Claude opens: a band row with CI and merge state, merge buttons, and a nudge when one merges.

DominickGiordano/claude-mods:quick.name: quick
DominickGiordano/claude-mods:quick.description: Instant commands that run without a Claude turn: /k, /links, /yank, /now.

davekiss/env:..name: env
davekiss/env:..description: Edit .env files in a pane inside Claude Code. Claude manages keys and asks you for values without ever seeing them.

adamholter/claude-subway-surfers:..name: subway-video
adamholter/claude-subway-surfers:..description: Loop Subway Surfers gameplay in a Claude side pane while Claude works.

sonata39-star/claude-mod:auto-check.name: auto-check
sonata39-star/claude-mod:auto-check.description: Runs the project's linter after each edit and its type-checker before Claude stops, handing failures back to Claude

sonata39-star/claude-mod:dev-dashboard.name: dev-dashboard

sonata39-star/claude-mod:dev-guard.description: Blocks catastrophic commands, asks before risky ones, and stops secrets from being written into files

sonata39-star/claude-mod:dev-status.name: dev-status
sonata39-star/claude-mod:dev-status.description: Status line: git branch, context window, rate limits with reset times, session cost and RTK savings

sonata39-star/claude-mod:team-flow.name: team-flow

selmakcby/clawd-madenci:plugin.name: clawd-madenci

Turbo-Thorschten/shell-highlight:..name: shell-highlight

ruthannbravo/explain-it:..name: explain-it

michaeldavodovski/claude-code-blackjack:.name: blackjack

0xGondarxyz/usage-meter:..name: usage-meter

gwbtc/claude-mods:chorus.name: chorus
gwbtc/claude-mods:chorus.description: Browse a ship's chorus cabinet with /cabinet and sync trusted slips into project memory.

Rocha101/claude-code-quickswitch:..name: quickswitch

Rocha101/claude-code-glance:..name: glance

0x5421/plan-progress:plugins/plan-progre.name: plan-progress

sameeeeeeep/switchboard-notch:..name: switchboard-notch

Syrul/claudagotchi:..name: claudagotchi

hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/agent-rad.name: agent-radar

hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/blast-rad.name: blast-radius
hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/blast-rad.description: Holds risky Bash commands and shows what they would change before they run.

hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/context-b.name: context-bar
hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/context-b.description: Your context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, a color per category, with token counts and the compaction point. /context-bar shows or hides it.

hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/glance.name: glance
hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/glance.description: One line above the prompt with what needs you: next meeting, PRs, Linear issues and Slack DMs. /glance lists them all.

hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/now-playi.name: now-playing
hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/now-playi.description: What Spotify is playing, one line above the prompt: track, progress and the lyric being sung, with ⏮ ⏸ ⏭ buttons. /music controls it too. macOS.

hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/prayer-ti.name: prayer-times
hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/prayer-ti.description: The current prayer and how long is left, the next prayer, and zawal, above the prompt. Computed on your computer from your location; nothing is sent anywhere.

hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/reels.name: reels
hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/reels.description: YouTube Shorts in a terminal pane: plays while Claude works, pauses when Claude is done.

hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/replay-th.name: replay-theater

hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/token-wea.description: A live forecast of the context window, with a prompt-cache countdown, drawn above the prompt.

hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/usage-met.name: usage-meter
hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/usage-met.description: Your plan's 5-hour and 7-day usage as small bars above the prompt, with the reset countdown and the session's cost.

hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/where-am-.name: where-am-i
hamzafer/claude-code-mods:mods/where-am-.description: A live recap above the prompt: goal, doing now, waiting on you, next. /where for a longer one.

fixter-dev/session-pings:plugins/session.name: session-pings
fixter-dev/session-pings:plugins/session.description: Mac notifications titled with the session name, saying what Claude needs from you: done, a question, or a permission. Works out of the box; install terminal-notifier (brew install terminal-notifier) to make notifications clickable, which brings you back to the app you were using.

cjavdev/mods:cache-saver.name: cache-saver
cjavdev/mods:cache-saver.description: When an idle session's prompt cache is about to expire, summarizes it while the cache is still warm; when you come back, pick A (keep the full session, pay the cache write) or B (continue from the summary).

cjavdev/mods:cache-shot-clock.name: cache-shot-clock
cjavdev/mods:cache-shot-clock.description: A shot clock for the prompt cache's TTL: a small countdown in the bar under the prompt, and a big LED clock above it for the last seconds before the next turn pays a full cache write.

cjavdev/mods:context-meter.name: context-meter
cjavdev/mods:context-meter.description: A tiny meter in the bar under the prompt showing how full the context window is: five cells, the percent and the token counts.

cjavdev/mods:link-bar.name: link-bar
cjavdev/mods:link-bar.description: Links in the bar under the prompt to the artifacts and pull requests mentioned most recently in the conversation.

panyuti-ai/ship-check-mods:plugins/ship-.name: ship-check
panyuti-ai/ship-check-mods:plugins/ship-.description: A development verification board: shows which tests, builds and type checks really ran, how they ended, and whether the result still matches your code.

0xGondarxyz/slopless:..name: slopless
0xGondarxyz/slopless:..description: Blocks AI sounding text in social media writing (X replies, X posts, LinkedIn posts) and injects the writing rules.

raresmun/claude-mods:plugins/clawd.name: clawd
raresmun/claude-mods:plugins/clawd.description: Clawd, the Claude mascot, thinks, types, runs and celebrates beside the thinking line, a little differently each turn

sevq1993-cyber/claude-code-kids:..name: kids
sevq1993-cyber/claude-code-kids:..description: A pane with the tree of child chats spawned from this chat: what each is doing, which branch it sits on, and what is still not merged. Read-only, no model calls.

rudrasecure/claude-mods:review-pane.name: review-pane
rudrasecure/claude-mods:review-pane.description: Side pane showing the files changed in this conversation as diffs; mark lines, comment, and send the comments back to Claude

teatimedev/doomscroll:..name: doomscroll
teatimedev/doomscroll:..description: A TikTok-style video feed in a pane beside Claude Code. It plays while Claude works, scrolls with your mouse wheel, and pauses when Claude is done.

ruanss4/prompt-jump:..name: prompt-jump
ruanss4/prompt-jump:..description: A bar above the prompt input with a tick for every prompt of the session; hover to read one, click to jump to it

salatmaster/claude-gamba:..name: gamba
salatmaster/claude-gamba:..description: A slot machine you spin while your agent works. Chips come only from the tokens it burns. No real money: satire.

HydrowZer/claude-mods:usage-band.name: usage-band
HydrowZer/claude-mods:usage-band.description: Bandeau au-dessus du prompt : coût de la session et utilisation restante

KytioisaCat/playpen:..name: playpen
KytioisaCat/playpen:..description: The sessions you are working in right now as small cards above the prompt: a status lamp, a short label, what just happened, and one press to answer or jump there.

stillgbx/still-mods:..name: still-mods
stillgbx/still-mods:..description: Personal mods above the prompt: plan progress bars and context, 5-hour and weekly usage meters

Iskandeur/session-board:..name: session-board
Iskandeur/session-board:..description: A ticket board for all your Claude Code sessions and agents, terminal and claude.ai/code cloud: what waits on you, what is in progress, what to do next. Live updates, dependencies, priorities, who-talks-to-whom history and a feedback inbox. Tickets come from hooks, from Claude (MCP tools) and from you.

nuromirzak/nibbl:plugin.name: nibbl
nuromirzak/nibbl:plugin.description: Nibbl: a tiny pixel pet above your prompt that nibbles your bugs

Toshkee/clawd-usage:..name: clawd-usage
Toshkee/clawd-usage:..description: Clawd waves his ultracode wand and does his banner tricks above the prompt beside live meters of context, rate limits and cost

ilkayGkbdk/cctop:..name: cctop
ilkayGkbdk/cctop:..description: htop for Claude Code: context, rate limits, speed, cost and subagents, live.

ItsRohith-A/holdtime:..name: holdtime
ItsRohith-A/holdtime:..description: Learn while Claude works: short facts and yes/no questions in the band above the prompt, picked from what Claude is doing, paused whenever Claude needs you.

theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/chan.name: change-journal
theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/chan.description: A live HTML page that shows every change Claude makes, with diffs, the reason for each edit, checks, and before/after behavior flows.

theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/deci.name: decision-lens
theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/deci.description: See the decisions Claude made in each turn, why it made them, and steer future turns with keep and avoid rules.

theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/gril.name: grill
theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/gril.description: While Claude works on your task, a sharp partner asks the questions that change the result. Answers reach Claude mid-turn. Brainstorm and side chat modes too.

theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/litt.name: little-harvest
theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/litt.description: Every file that changes becomes a crop: Claude's edits and yours grow a farm in its own pane, tests bring sun or storms, and passing turns fill the barn.

theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/look.name: looks
theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/look.description: Make Claude Code look the way you like: four themes (Retro CRT, Punk, Synthwave, Zen paper) switched with /theme, tidier tool calls, and optional one-line tool rows and replies centered at a reading width.

theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/nigh.name: night-feast
theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/nigh.description: A vampire feeds on every tool call Claude finishes while the moon tracks how full the context window is. Between meals it stalks, swoops, and lies in wait. Dawn means it is time to compact.

theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/pock.name: pocket-familiar
theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/pock.description: A fox spirit that lives on your work: passing tests feed it, finished turns cheer it, it plays while you are quiet, and it grows up to nine tails.

theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/samu.name: samurai-dojo
theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/samu.description: A Claude samurai cuts down a Codex, Gemini, or ChatGPT foe for every tool call, and meditates, trains, and duels between them through four seasons.

theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/scop.name: scope-guard
theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/scop.description: Notices when Claude drifts outside your request. Clear drift waits for your answer in a question dialog; milder drift is flagged above the prompt with a pull-back key.

theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/slay.name: slayer-corps
theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/slay.description: Tanjiro, Nezuko, Zenitsu, and Inosuke take turns against demons up to Muzan as you and Claude work, and spar between strikes. The story continues every session.

theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/unsl.name: unslop
theonly1me/claude-code-mods:plugins/unsl.description: Finds AI slop in Claude's changes (dashes, comment blocks, comments that repeat the code, tests that assert nothing, filler phrases) and tells Claude to remove it. Shows what was unslopped.

davidurco/cc-tamagotchi:..name: cc-tamagotchi
davidurco/cc-tamagotchi:..description: A Tamagotchi that lives in Claude Code: it hatches, eats the work Claude does, leaves bugs behind, gets sick, throws tantrums and grows into one of eight adults. An animated pixel LCD in the terminal, an egg-shaped device in the desktop app. Zero tokens.

huydepzai121/claude-acp-ui:plugin.name: acp-ui
huydepzai121/claude-acp-ui:plugin.description: Restyles the Claude Code terminal like an ACP chat: prompt and tool cards, inline diffs, a status band, footer stats, a /dash pane and a done toast

viik2k/clawdify:..name: clawdify
viik2k/clawdify:..description: Restyle Claude Code from /clawdify: spinner, turn footer, prompt hint, banner, status line, transcript rows and presets, or just describe what you want.

s-hiraoku/claude-mods:plugins/status-met.name: status-meter
s-hiraoku/claude-mods:plugins/status-met.description: Shows context, 5-hour and 7-day limit usage as SVG meters above the prompt in the Desktop app

hamza-siddiq/token-showers:token-weather.name: token-weather
hamza-siddiq/token-showers:token-weather.description: A live forecast of the context window, in the band above the prompt. /token-weather turns it on or off.

skanehira/claude-recap-plus:..name: recap-plus
skanehira/claude-recap-plus:..description: Keeps a recap-plus summary of the session above the prompt: what it is for and where it stands; /recap-plus adds what was done and decided, what waits on you, and what comes next

skanehira/claude-session-brief:..name: recap-plus
skanehira/claude-session-brief:..description: Keeps a recap-plus summary of the session above the prompt: what it is for and where it stands; /recap-plus adds what was done and decided, what waits on you, and what comes next

lumberroom/lumberroom-claude-code:..name: lumberroom-memory
lumberroom/lumberroom-claude-code:..description: lumberroom as Claude Code's memory: the digest in the system prompt, a periodic search-and-write reminder, optional per-prompt recall, built-in memory off.

shabier/claude-plugins:plugins/ambient.name: ambient
shabier/claude-plugins:plugins/ambient.description: Animated 8-bit wallpapers in the docked side pane: koi pond, mountains, metropolis, neon district.

shabier/claude-plugins:plugins/arcade.name: arcade
shabier/claude-plugins:plugins/arcade.description: Five games in the docked side pane: Rail Runner, Road Hopper, Block Drop, Flap, 2048. Hides below 110 columns.

shabier/claude-plugins:plugins/dashboard.name: dashboard
shabier/claude-plugins:plugins/dashboard.description: Bento dashboard in the docked side pane: clock, context and compaction forecast, todo, git, Hacker News. Widgets on a pure contract.

JAICHANGPARK/html-preview:..name: html-preview
JAICHANGPARK/html-preview:..description: Shows HTML files Claude writes (or /preview <file>) like a browser: terminal-browser when installed, else a built-in Chrome-rendered pane

Luma-Sa/claude-mods:plugins/usage-band.name: usage-band
Luma-Sa/claude-mods:plugins/usage-band.description: Bandeau au-dessus du prompt : limites 5h/7j, coût et tokens de sortie

xzwache/claude-time-machine:..name: time-machine
xzwache/claude-time-machine:..description: Every Claude turn becomes a snapshot: review what changed step by step, undo it, or travel back. Local, zero tokens.

Juyn/claude-focus-pane:..name: focus-pane
Juyn/claude-focus-pane:..description: A permanent pane: the ticket and summary of what Claude works on, its progress, and its todo list

cosmin220304/claude-mods:plugins/prompt-.name: prompt-info
cosmin220304/claude-mods:plugins/prompt-.description: Folder, branch, PR, context and model at the end of the prompt hint line

artemnovichkov/xcode-mods:mods/xcode-mod.name: xcode-mods
artemnovichkov/xcode-mods:mods/xcode-mod.description: Xcode in Claude Code: build, run and tests pane, scheme/destination band, notifications and SwiftUI previews over headless Xcode MCP

govlog/claude-darkroom:..name: darkroom
govlog/claude-darkroom:..description: The images Claude reads, writes or makes, and the ones you paste, as a film strip right in the chat: a grey line to unroll, a viewer to browse, a develop under a red safelight (kitty graphics: Ghostty, kitty).

sneycampos/claude-pomodoro:..name: pomodoro
sneycampos/claude-pomodoro:..description: Button-first Pomodoro timer above the Claude Code prompt: one-click focus blocks, a live countdown band, break reminders and a config pane.

0NE-C0DEMAN/deskbar:..name: deskbar
0NE-C0DEMAN/deskbar:..description: A desk for the Claude Code prompt: context weather, Gmail, calendar, tasks across sessions, notes, a music deck and a billable-hours timer

HaoYan-A/claude-code-mods:plugins/subage.name: subagent-effort
HaoYan-A/claude-code-mods:plugins/subage.description: Run each subagent on any model (gpt-6, grok-4.7, ...) at any reasoning effort, through model and effort parameters on the Agent tool

RomanHotsiy/claude-mods:loc-split.name: loc-split
RomanHotsiy/claude-mods:loc-split.description: Lines changed against main, split into code, comments, tests, docs and generated files, in a row above the prompt that expands into a per-commit table

RomanHotsiy/claude-mods:pr-approvals.name: pr-approvals
RomanHotsiy/claude-mods:pr-approvals.description: Review status of the session's pull requests in a footer chip (approved or not, how many reviews are pending) that opens per-PR details

zaahiral/claude-latex:..name: latex
zaahiral/claude-latex:..description: Render TeX math, TikZ diagrams and LaTeX blocks in Claude Code's desktop app, in any of 10 LaTeX fonts, with every LaTeX compile sandboxed

Yash1927/claude-code-snake:..name: tool-snake
Yash1927/claude-code-snake:..description: Play snake while Claude works. Every tool call Claude makes drops food into the game; the game pauses when Claude is done.

arthurseredaa/clawdgotchi:..name: clawdgotchi
arthurseredaa/clawdgotchi:..description: A pixel Clawd above your prompt that grows with your context window and pops on /compact.

genail/genail-mods:task-progress.name: task-progress
genail/genail-mods:task-progress.description: Live progress bars above the prompt for background shells and subagents

roaringsoul404/cc-mods:turn-receipt.name: turn-receipt
roaringsoul404/cc-mods:turn-receipt.description: At the end of every turn Claude prints a receipt: files touched, commands run, tokens and what the turn cost

roaringsoul404/cc-mods:wasted.name: wasted
roaringsoul404/cc-mods:wasted.description: When a tool call fails, the spinner dies: the line goes grey and WASTED fades in, in hand-drawn pixel lettering

tanuu5/dev-dashboard:plugins/dev-dashboa.name: dev-dashboard
tanuu5/dev-dashboard:plugins/dev-dashboa.description: Pane showing Claude service status, unpushed local repos, recent commits and GitHub pushes

tanuu5/clawd-dance:plugins/clawd-dance.name: clawd-dance
tanuu5/clawd-dance:plugins/clawd-dance.description: 入力欄の上の帯で、作業に合わせて Clawd（二次創作版）が踊り、使用量も表示する

katzboaz/ClaudeAmp:..name: claudeamp
katzboaz/ClaudeAmp:..description: A Winamp-style player for Claude Code: live spectrum visualizer, scrolling marquee, playlist of tool calls and transport controls.

tibzejoker/claude-mods:apercu.name: apercu
tibzejoker/claude-mods:apercu.description: What Claude is building (website, mobile app, desktop client, Unity game…), live in a panel of the client (desktop, mobile in Remote Control, terminal): Claude hooks up the project and the network bridge itself, and drives the same target as you

tibzejoker/claude-mods:clawd.name: clawd
tibzejoker/claude-mods:clawd.description: Clawd's HQ: Clawd lives in a pixel art office, mimes what Claude does, and a game HUD shows the model, context and rate limits

tibzejoker/claude-mods:masque-secrets.name: masque-secrets
tibzejoker/claude-mods:masque-secrets.description: Masks the values from ~/.claude/secrets/*.env in everything the model reads

tibzejoker/claude-mods:recap.name: recap
tibzejoker/claude-mods:recap.description: /recap: a summary of the session (done, in progress, left) in a panel, ready to paste into a log

tibzejoker/claude-mods:terminal-distant.name: terminal-distant
tibzejoker/claude-mods:terminal-distant.description: A terminal in a panel: from the desktop client, VS Code or your phone in Remote Control, run commands on the session's machine and attach the output to your next message

tibzejoker/claude-mods:vignettes.name: vignettes
tibzejoker/claude-mods:vignettes.description: Thumbnails in the terminal of the images Claude reads or shares (Read, SendUserFile, MCP screenshots), and a /gallery view on every screen

Vosssa/claude-usage-band:plugins/usage-b.name: usage-band
Vosssa/claude-usage-band:plugins/usage-b.description: 5h / weekly usage, context fill and prompt-cache warmth above the prompt

xyc/plushie:..name: plushie
xyc/plushie:..description: A plush Clawd above the prompt that reacts to what Claude is doing: works, celebrates, wobbles, blushes, naps, and can be patted and dragged.

falkoro/clawd-cartoons:plugins/clawd-car.name: clawd-cartoons
falkoro/clawd-cartoons:plugins/clawd-car.description: A live cartoon under the spinner: Clawd acts out and narrates each step of the agent's work, drawn by Sonnet and run in a sandboxed scene language

jumoog/claude_mod_usage:usage-meter.name: usage-meter
jumoog/claude_mod_usage:usage-meter.description: Always shows your 5-hour and weekly plan usage above the prompt, with when each window resets.

WilsonKinyua/claude-mods:plugins/house-r.name: house-rules
WilsonKinyua/claude-mods:plugins/house-r.description: Enforces git identity, attribution and branch-naming rules on Bash calls

WilsonKinyua/claude-mods:plugins/lean-co.name: lean-comments
WilsonKinyua/claude-mods:plugins/lean-co.description: Stops Claude adding banner, multi-line, long or narrating code comments

WilsonKinyua/claude-mods:plugins/usage-b.name: usage-band
WilsonKinyua/claude-mods:plugins/usage-b.description: Rate limits, context, cost and git branch in a band above the prompt

gil2abir/claude-compass:..name: compass
gil2abir/claude-compass:..description: A live map of your Claude Code session: a git-style flow chart, a live feed of every tool call, a drag-and-drop task board, async grill questions, agent chat, stats and recap, in a pane you can steer from.

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-ask.name: lemo-ask
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-ask.description: 提问弹窗标题：在提问弹窗顶部显示消息编号和问题数，选项不变 / Question header: shows the message number and question count above the question dialog; options unchanged

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-assistan.name: lemo-assistant
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-assistan.description: 助手：只读子 agent（Haiku），写三行周报 · 点按钮才派；「Claude 可派助手」默认关闭，在「安全」页开启 / Assistant: a read-only subagent (Haiku) that writes a three-line report · sent only when you press its button; "Claude can send the assistant" is off by default, switch on in Safety

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-core.name: lemo-core
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-core.description: 核心：风格、中英文界面、消息编号和 /lemo-mod 面板，以及给其他 lemo mod 用的 $.lemo / Core: styles, zh/en interface, message numbers and the /lemo-mod panel, plus the $.lemo helpers other lemo mods use

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-guard.name: lemo-guard
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-guard.description: 限时：Claude 单轮工作超时自动中止 · 等你确认的时间不计 · 默认关闭，在「安全」页开启 / Time limit: stops Claude when a turn runs over time · time waiting for you does not count · off by default, switch on in Safety

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-journal.name: lemo-journal
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-journal.description: 记录：面板显示每轮统计 · 日志和自动分类默认关闭，在「安全」页开启 / Journal: per-turn stats in the panel · Log and Auto tags are off by default, switch on in Safety

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-lot.name: lemo-lot
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-lot.description: 抽签：给 Claude 增加抽签工具 draw_lot，抽到的签显示为签文卡片 · 默认关闭，在「安全」页开启 / Lots: adds a draw_lot tool for Claude and shows drawn lots as fortune cards · off by default, switch on in Safety

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-meter.name: lemo-meter
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-meter.description: 用量横条：输入框上方显示上下文、5 小时额度、花费和 git 分支；状态栏显示消息编号（已有自己的状态栏时默认关闭）；点「检查」才联网查新版本 / Usage meter: context, 5-hour quota, cost and git branch above the prompt; a status line with the message number (off by default if you have your own); checks for updates online only when you press Check

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-pomodoro.name: lemo-pomodoro
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-pomodoro.description: 番茄钟：专注计时，到点在横条提醒并询问下一步 · 点了才开始 / Focus timer: times your focus, then a reminder on the band and a question about what next · starts only when you press it

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-recap.name: lemo-recap
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-recap.description: 会话小结：把本次会话汇总成三行摘要 · 点了才生成，对话越长用量越多 / Session recap: summarizes this session in three lines · runs only when you press it; longer conversations use more

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-skin.name: lemo-skin
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-skin.description: 换皮：消息加编号 T01、T02，回复标注「回复 T03」，工具行和耗时行使用风格样式 / Skin: messages numbered T01, T02, replies marked "Reply T03", tool rows and turn lines use the style

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-sound.name: lemo-sound
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-sound.description: 音效：调用工具、一轮结束、限时中止时播放提示音 · 默认关闭，在「安全」页开启 / Sounds: plays sounds on tool calls, turn ends and time-limit stops · off by default, switch on in Safety

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-spinner.name: lemo-spinner
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-spinner.description: 加载词：工作时的加载词换成风格词并附上消息编号 · 已自定义转圈文字时默认关闭 / Spinner words: spinner words while Claude works come from the style, with the message number · off by default if you set your own

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-todo.name: lemo-todo
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-todo.description: 笔记：在面板记下笔记 · 压缩后自动摘要（Haiku）默认关闭，在「安全」页开启 / Notes: keep notes in the panel · Auto summary after compaction (Haiku) is off by default, switch on in Safety

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-tone.name: lemo-tone
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-tone.description: 说话方式：简短模式（每次回答不超过三句）、记录口吻（首行说明看了什么，末行给出结论） · 默认关闭，在「安全」页开启 / Tone: Brief mode (three sentences or fewer) and Notebook voice (opens with what it looked at, closes with a conclusion) · off by default, switch on in Safety

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-voice.name: lemo-voice
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-voice.description: 朗读：超过 30 秒的任务完成时，朗读编号和用时 · 默认关闭，在「安全」页开启 / Speech: reads out the message number and time when a task over 30 s finishes · off by default, switch on in Safety

lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-watch.name: lemo-watch
lemomo-ai/lemo-mod:plugins/lemo-watch.description: 定时提醒：N 秒后代你给 Claude 发消息，请它汇报进度 · 点了才开始 / Reminder: sends Claude a message for you after N seconds, asking for a progress update · starts only when you press it

chaoshengsc/focus-band:..name: focus-band
chaoshengsc/focus-band:..description: 输入框上方常驻显示 5h / 7d 额度用量：进度条、百分比、重置时间。

tzafrir/whats-agent-doing:..name: whats-agent-doing

MohammadMD1383/claude-plugins:plugins/pr.description: A progress bar above the prompt that Claude fills in through a tool: an exact percentage, what it is doing now, time elapsed and time left. See how far along a long task is without asking.

Also: long output trimmed, compaction that keeps what the work still needs and saves the rest on disk, safety signals on Bash and fetched content, and the session's numbers above the prompt. Thresholds measured, not guessed.

tungnt1203/cmusic:plugins/cmusic-lyrics.name: cmusic-lyrics

nogu66/md-prompt:plugins/md-prompt.description: Paints Markdown onto Claude Code's prompt box as you type: fenced code becomes a syntax-highlighted card (even before you close the fence), and inline code, bold, italic, lists, task lists, quotes, tables, links and headings are styled. conorbronsdon/eunuch-mode:plugins/eunuch.name: eunuch-mode-court
conorbronsdon/eunuch-mode:plugins/eunuch.description: A Claude Code mod for Eunuch Mode: while the skill is on, the palace adviser stands above the prompt in pixel art, posing for what the agent is doing; the spinner narrates each action in court language; and the status line reads "Court in session". Canned lines by default; opt-in generative mode (fresh lines from Sonnet) and treachery mode (he plots your downfall, cosmetically). /court toggles it all.

radiator-engineering/offcut:mod.name: offcut
radiator-engineering/offcut:mod.description: Cleans up finished git worktrees as soon as a turn or a session ends. When a turn ends (the main session's or a subagent's), it runs `offcut apply --only auto --yes` for the session's repo in the background: a worktree goes only if it is clean, pushed, and its work is merged or eventlog says its agent is done. When the session ends, it runs once more a few seconds later, also clearing unused build caches, so the session's own worktree can go. Every removal is recorded for `offcut restore`. Inert when `offcut` is not installed, outside a git repo, or with OFFCUT=off.

ilya-kozyrev/claude-agent-hub:..name: agent-hub

benjaminmodayil/live-recap:..name: live-recap

mutlumehmet/claude-plugins:plugins/subta.name: subtask-icons

lmuehleisen/xo:.claude/mods/firstmate-ca.name: fm

vmallela0/cc-buddy:..name: cc-buddy
vmallela0/cc-buddy:..description: Brings back /buddy: the small creature that watched you code, above the prompt again. Restores the companion in ~/.claude.json exactly (same species, rarity, hat and stats), hatches an egg for new accounts, levels up from commits and passing tests, unlocks a 49-buddy roster as you ship, reacts to Claude's work for free, answers in a Haiku-written line when you say its name, and shows in a pane on desktop and mobile.
