davidar/claude-idle-compact:..name: idle-compact
davidar/claude-idle-compact:..description: Compacts an idle interactive session shortly before its prompt cache expires, so coming back later doesn't re-read the whole context uncached.

drewpayment/jev-route:..name: jev-route
drewpayment/jev-route:..description: Routes each turn to the cheapest capable Claude model using Jev, TypeSafe's decision model. Toggle with /route.

xyjk0511/idle-compact:plugins/idle-compa.name: idle-compact
xyjk0511/idle-compact:plugins/idle-compa.description: Compact once after 50 idle minutes, while the 1h prompt cache is still warm. Works in the desktop app and SDK sessions too.

Anerco/effort-cycle-mod:..name: effort-cycle
Anerco/effort-cycle-mod:..description: Alt+E steps the effort level up and Alt+Shift+E down, for the main thread or the subagent in view; the footer shows that agent's model and level as they change, with a ‹ and › to click while the pointer is over it

spiiritual/claude-code-stuff:plugins/bet.name: better-compaction
spiiritual/claude-code-stuff:plugins/bet.description: Compaction that waits for the model's turn to end, and summarizes at its own effort level.

spiiritual/claude-code-stuff:plugins/whi.name: whiteboard-defense
spiiritual/claude-code-stuff:plugins/whi.description: Understand what you ship: plan with a real diagram and decisions you make yourself, then get grilled on it after building.

anshc022/laya-claude-code:plugins/laya.name: laya
anshc022/laya-claude-code:plugins/laya.description: Runs the Laya decision model on your machine: checks each prompt, hints Claude at the right folder and task type, gives Claude a fast laya decide tool, and shows every decision in a band above the prompt.

Danneftw1/neon-sumi:plugins/neon-sumi.name: neon-sumi
Danneftw1/neon-sumi:plugins/neon-sumi.description: A status line and cockpit pane for Claude Code: context, 5h and weekly bars, PR / ticket / issue rows with titles, worktrees, ports that serve a page; /neon-sumi-cockpit opens your PRs, inbox, ports and skills in a pane. Neon tubes on an ink-wash scroll.

augbastos/afkswitch:..name: afkswitch
augbastos/afkswitch:..description: AFKSwitch by augbastos — Tell your agents when you're away and when you're back.

mediavee/cold-cache-guard:..name: cold-cache-guard
mediavee/cold-cache-guard:..description: Asks what to do before Claude Code re-sends a large conversation whose prompt cache has expired: on a cold resume, and on the first prompt after an idle spell.

renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.name: session-truth
renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.description: Observe-only: one authoritative record per session, mirrored to $CC_SESSION_TRUTH_DIR/<session_id>.json.

renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.name: fleet-permpend
renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.description: Permission-pending beacon v2: tool_use_id-keyed beacon in CC_PERMPEND_DIR, cleared when the gated call itself resolves; archives what caused each ask.

renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.name: fleet-core
renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.description: Fleet org-tier policy mod: keeps user-tier mods from gating tool calls above the fleet's shell PreToolUse hooks.

renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.name: spawn-governor
renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.description: Refuses subagent/teammate spawns the lead's context cannot absorb, caps oversized Agent returns to a file, and enforces spawn depth from exact parentAgentId.

renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.name: fleet-wake
renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.description: C5 prototype: wake an idle session when its mailbox has mail, and resume a turn that died on a rate limit once the window resets.

renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.name: desk-board
renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.description: Desk board: one docked pane over every live session and every account's 5-hour and weekly windows.

renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.name: fleet-core-c7
renchris/claude-infrastructure:docs/rese.description: Lead-side teammate lifecycle: tracks teammates, blocks one Stop while idle teammates are resident, exports the roster.

rennerdo30/agent-bridge:plugins/claude.name: agent-bridge
rennerdo30/agent-bridge:plugins/claude.description: Talk to OpenAI Codex from Claude Code: live peer messaging over a local pipe, plus headless delegation (ask_codex).

kartikeyaagr/fast-laya-compaction:..name: fast-laya-compaction
kartikeyaagr/fast-laya-compaction:..description: Verbatim Laya-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions (local, no API key).

jetsongdev/jet-router:..name: jet-router
jetsongdev/jet-router:..description: Experimental Claude Code effort router: fake and opt-in Jev shadow

HaiNNT/c-hottag:plugin.name: chottag
HaiNNT/c-hottag:plugin.description: Drive chottag (c-hottag) from Claude Code: switch the serving account, set the remote account, log accounts in, check limits and the install. On Claude Code 2.1.287+ a mod adds a status card, notices, /ct commands and a /login guard.

rezzminator/buddy:plugins/buddy.name: buddy
rezzminator/buddy:plugins/buddy.description: Claude Code buddy plugin: an ASCII companion above your prompt that remembers your rules and flags Claude's shortcuts

totally-tim/effort-router:..name: effort-router
totally-tim/effort-router:..description: Picks the reasoning effort for each turn of the main conversation with a System One classifier (hosted Jev or a compatible service) and shows the level on the spinner and on the line that closes the turn. In shadow mode it shows and logs its pick and sends the session's effort; in enforce mode it sends the pick. Requires CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

s2005/skill_state:plugin.name: skill-state
s2005/skill_state:plugin.description: SKILL.state explicit execution state: schema-validated state tool, action-bound tool gating and turn-end frame compaction

Sma1lboy/claude-mods:usageline.name: usageline
Sma1lboy/claude-mods:usageline.description: A status line under the prompt: context, cache hit rate, cache TTL countdown, today's spend for this project, and why a turn missed the cache. /usage prints the project ledger.

yai333/autonomous-loop:..name: autonomous-loop
yai333/autonomous-loop:..description: A state-machine graph engine that drives a ticket through claim -> worktree -> coding -> evaluate -> review -> human approval, spawning and monitoring subagents at each step.

furqan-khan07/pixelband:..name: pixelband
furqan-khan07/pixelband:..description: Animated pixel art above your Claude Code prompt that reacts while Claude works: seven scenes, or your own image or GIF. Zero tokens.

eighteyes/cactus:mods/cactus-pane.name: cactus-pane
eighteyes/cactus:mods/cactus-pane.description: A live cactus inbox pane for the session's project, answerable in place

xsyetopz/dotclaude:plugins/dotclaude.name: dotclaude
xsyetopz/dotclaude:plugins/dotclaude.description: A small Claude Code plugin with guards, model and effort rules, compaction and cache notes, and role agents.

xsyetopz/dotclaude:plugins/dotclaude-jev.name: dotclaude-jev
xsyetopz/dotclaude:plugins/dotclaude-jev.description: Gets a second opinion from TypeSafe Jev, a decision model, for a yes or no check, a pick from options, or a rating. Needs `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`.

aqaurius6666/claude-env-badge:..name: env-badge
aqaurius6666/claude-env-badge:..description: A badge under each Bash tool row naming the environment the command targets (AWS profile, kube context, ...). Rules, tiers, format and label scripts are configured in settings.json pluginConfigs. Display only: never touches tool output or model context.

tristankenney/laya-compaction:..name: laya-compaction
tristankenney/laya-compaction:..description: Verbatim context compaction for Claude Code, scored by a local Laya model.

lperezmo/topic-filter-mod:..name: topic-filter
lperezmo/topic-filter-mod:..description: Keep unrelated topics from pulling Claude off your code: listed terms become stable placeholder names (or their lines are dropped) in tool output, prompts, CLAUDE.md and skills before the model reads them. The system prompt is never changed.

gonzaloserrano/cc-prompt-stash:..name: prompt-stash
gonzaloserrano/cc-prompt-stash:..description: /stash: a git-stash-like stack of prompts, kept between sessions, popped back into the prompt box.

chrisns/spare10-mod:..name: spare10
chrisns/spare10-mod:..description: Keeps the last part of your 5-hour and weekly quota for you. At the reserve, spare10 holds all work and asks you whether to continue. After a Resume, it asks again at the floor, by default at 5% left. Shortly before the reset, it lets work use the reserve.

chadboyda/sotto:..name: sotto
chadboyda/sotto:..description: Full-duplex voice conversation with your running Claude Code session, powered by OpenAI gpt-live-1. Toggle with /talk.

HAR5HA-7663/jev-compact:..name: jev-compact
HAR5HA-7663/jev-compact:..description: Context compaction that prunes instead of summarising: rules drop exploration output and hook noise locally, Jev ranks the rest against a budget, a note says what was removed, and removed outputs are archived for the brain. Falls back to the built-in summary when it cannot do better.

HAR5HA-7663/jev-compact:trigger.name: jev-compact-trigger
HAR5HA-7663/jev-compact:trigger.description: Companion to jev-compact: watches context use after every turn and starts a compaction at the configured percentage. Separate plugin on purpose — the engine skips a plugin's own session.compact hook when that plugin raises the compaction, so the trigger must come from outside jev-compact for the pruning to run.

oikon48/prompt-rail:plugins/prompt-rail.name: prompt-rail
oikon48/prompt-rail:plugins/prompt-rail.description: A rail of your session's prompts beside the transcript or above the prompt; hover to read one, click to jump to it.

Akramovic1/jev-pilot:..name: jev-pilot
Akramovic1/jev-pilot:..description: TypeSafe's Jev decides how Claude Code works on each prompt: the main conversation's reasoning effort (low to xhigh, raised to max mid-turn when tool calls keep failing), each subagent's model, whether to split the work across subagents, and the one skill the prompt needs. Brings in custom OpenRouter models (a junior coder reviewed by Opus, or cheap bulk work) and Codex or OpenCode as reviewers, in modes you choose, each health-checked. Reads the prompt with recent context, records every decision, and suggests its own tuning. Backends: OpenRouter, TypeSafe's API, the Vercel AI Gateway, or Claude Code's built-in classifier. Built on claude-code-templates' jev-model-router and jev-skill-suggestion.

yu381792/superlcm:..name: superlcm
yu381792/superlcm:..description: One local conversation archive for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, Pi and dsh harness. Keep full originals, write background layered summaries, recall exact sources and continue tasks across tools. Connections default to native host compaction. Claude Code takeover is an explicit optional setting. Open /superlcm:console to manage connections and summary models.

csmoot99/Mafioso:.claude/mods/firstmate-.name: firstmate-calm
csmoot99/Mafioso:.claude/mods/firstmate-.description: Firstmate Calm for Claude Code: the sailboat working animation and conversation-only transcript presentation, sharing the per-home config/calm preference with the Pi Calm extension. Its hooks module may load through CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS or Claude Code's tengu_plugin_hooks_modules rollout flag, but the mod activates only when CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is exactly 1 and is otherwise a complete no-op.

Ahmad8864/cc-side:..name: cc-side
Ahmad8864/cc-side:..description: A separate agent conversation in Claude Code's right-hand pane, forked from the current context.

moelahmady/jev-model-router:..name: gear
moelahmady/jev-model-router:..description: Routes each turn's reasoning effort with TypeSafe's Jev decision model, keeping the prompt cache (Claude Code 2.1.280+). Model routing is available but off by default and refused above maxSwitchTokens, since a model switch re-writes the whole context.

jevcomp/jevcomp:..name: jevcomp
jevcomp/jevcomp:..description: Jev decides what Claude Code keeps when it compacts, instead of a model-written summary.

SuzumiyaAoba/claude-essential-conversati.name: essential-conversation
SuzumiyaAoba/claude-essential-conversati.description: Shows each turn's user prompt paired with Claude Code's last answer for that turn in a side pane (/conversation).

unclecode/jevshift:..name: jevshift
unclecode/jevshift:..description: Experimental Jev-assisted model and effort selection for Claude Code: observe, pin, off, and opt-in auto.

muratcakmak/jev-guard:..name: jev-guard
muratcakmak/jev-guard:..description: Probability-scored guardrails for Claude Code: deny rule-breaking edits and unasked-for deploys, route your own docs into each prompt, and check the final answer against the turn's own evidence.

masahide/agent-kit:plugins/agentctl.name: agentctl
masahide/agent-kit:plugins/agentctl.description: agentctl Mod: agentctl CLI (tools/agentctl) が ~/.agentctl/claude/<sessionId>/inbox/ に置いたメッセージを $.prompt.submit で Claude に届け、中断の依頼を $.turn.abort で行い、結果を acks/ に書く。付属スキル agentctl は、agent に agentctl の使い方を教える。

masahide/agent-kit:plugins/doc-desk.name: doc-desk
masahide/agent-kit:plugins/doc-desk.description: doc-desk Mod: Claude が質問票 JSON を open_form ツールに渡すと、ブラウザに一枚のフォームを出して人に答えてもらい、回答を【doc-desk 回答】の固定形にして Claude に届ける (waitSeconds 以内ならツールの結果として、過ぎれば user turn として)。書き上げた文書を open_review に渡すと、人が段落や文字列に付けた指摘を同じ固定形で届ける (指摘モード)。

wasd96040501/taskcut:..name: taskcut
wasd96040501/taskcut:..description: Compacts when the work moves on from one sub-task to the next instead of when the context window fills, including in the middle of a long turn. Once the context is past a floor, a model judges each step, reading what you asked for and where Claude has got to but never any tool output, for whether the work moves on from a finished piece to another; if it does, taskcut runs Claude Code's own compaction. Below the floor it does nothing and costs nothing.

shuletadev/certbuddycr:mods/git-status-b.name: git-status-band
shuletadev/certbuddycr:mods/git-status-b.description: A band above the prompt that says in plain words whether your work is saved and in sync with GitHub

shuletadev/certbuddycr:mods/party-pane.name: party-pane
shuletadev/certbuddycr:mods/party-pane.description: A side pane that shows the agents working on your requests as illustrated characters

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:chrome-switch.name: chrome-switch
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:chrome-switch.description: Switches the Claude in Chrome extension between named browser profiles with select_browser, which needs no approval click, and picks the default before the first browser call of a session.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:copy-band.name: copy-band
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:copy-band.description: Click-to-copy buttons above the prompt for every code block and quoted draft in the last answer, a durable stash of older ones, and a WhatsApp/Telegram wrap.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:deploy-verify.name: deploy-verify
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:deploy-verify.description: After a deploy command succeeds, curls the live URL with cache-busting and puts the verdict in the model's context, so a deploy cannot be claimed without evidence.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:diff-review.name: diff-review
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:diff-review.description: After every Edit, Write, NotebookEdit or sed -i, a docked pane shows that file's uncommitted hunk with [keep] and [revert] buttons; a press dismisses or runs git checkout with no model turn.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:done-blink.name: done-blink
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:done-blink.description: Blinks the iTerm2 tab orange when a turn lands, for up to three minutes or until you type again, so a finished session is obvious from any other tab.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:merge-gate.name: merge-gate
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:merge-gate.description: Denies a Bash merge (gh pr merge, git merge on main, push onto main) unless the latest human message says the word merge; ship, push and deploy do not count.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:mini-offload.name: mini-offload
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:mini-offload.description: Routes heavy Bash commands (test suites, builds, Docker) to a second machine over ssh, with the PATH export and working directory already right, and the commit synced first.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:money-band.name: money-band
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:money-band.description: A line above the prompt with liquid assets, CPF, debt and month-to-date spend, read from a pair of SQLite databases over ssh, and the emergency fund's fill in the prompt footer.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:receipt.name: receipt
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:receipt.description: Keeps a per-turn tally of edits, runs, curls and destructive commands and shows it on the turn footer; a claim with no run flags the spinner, a destructive Bash unfolds its tool group, and an edit-without-run turn suggests running the tests.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:scope-guard.name: scope-guard
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:scope-guard.description: Counts the distinct files a turn edits and stops at a threshold to make the goal get restated, so a small ask cannot quietly become a refactor.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:usage-band.name: usage-band
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:usage-band.description: A line above the prompt with the five-hour and seven-day limit windows, this session's context fill and cost, plus a nudge to clear when the window gets expensive. The footer shows the cost in Singapore dollars.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:wod-band.name: wod-band
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:wod-band.description: A pixel-art Ragtag athlete above the prompt who does a rep every turn: the session is an AMRAP of thrusters, burpees and pull-ups.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods:wod-timer.name: wod-timer
yash-gadodia/claude-mods:wod-timer.description: 3, 2, 1, GO above the prompt when you submit, a running gym clock while Claude works, and your split when the turn lands.

mukiwu/jev-search-mcp:..name: jev-search
mukiwu/jev-search-mcp:..description: Web search through Jev Search. Answers Claude Code's built-in WebSearch with Jev (sources and time window chosen by Jev, every result ranked by relevance) and falls back to the built-in search when Jev cannot answer. Also adds the jev_search MCP tool for explicit source or time filters, and a skill on when to use it.

HoshimuraYuto/cc-sidecar:..name: cc-sidecar
HoshimuraYuto/cc-sidecar:..description: See what codex, claude and gemini do when Claude Code delegates to them from Bash

satviksinha/jev-model-router:..name: jev-router
satviksinha/jev-model-router:..description: Routes each turn to a Claude model chosen by TypeSafe's Jev, asked through the Vercel AI Gateway.

fernandomoraes/loose-ends:..name: loose-ends
fernandomoraes/loose-ends:..description: A live checklist above the prompt of the conversation's loose ends: questions left unanswered, points made in passing, caveats and deferred work it moved past, kept up to date by a small model after each turn. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

ChaseWNorton/claude-doom:..name: doom
ChaseWNorton/claude-doom:..description: The original Doom engine, with Freedoom Phase 1, playable inside Claude Code. Run /doom.

synex1437/noctis:..name: noctis
synex1437/noctis:..description: Runs long Claude Code jobs overnight within your usage limits: pauses just before the 5-hour or weekly limit, resumes the same session after the reset (or relaunches it days later) and works through a list of jobs you hand it with /noctis:start <file>. Also runs in Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI, Droid and Copilot CLI.

karanb192/jev-skill-scout:..name: jev-skill-scout
karanb192/jev-skill-scout:..description: Before each prompt reaches the model, TypeSafe's Jev ranks your installed skills against it and attaches one line naming the skill to load. Sends the prompt text to api.typesafe.ai. Needs function hooks (early access).

octalide/sift:..name: sift
octalide/sift:..description: Typed judgement calls for Claude Code: two primitives, judge and rank, under packs that grade issues, pull requests, plans, commits, releases and rules, a repository watch, tool output pruning and an outbound text gate, backed by TypeSafe Jev or the session's small model.

m4cd4r4/clear-resume:plugin.name: clear-resume
m4cd4r4/clear-resume:plugin.description: Write a handover when a Claude Code session gets long, type /clear, and the next session picks up where you left off with nothing to paste.

togishima/better-ask-picker:..name: better-ask-picker
togishima/better-ask-picker:..description: Ask the user a question in a dedicated pane: show every option on one screen with a summary, single or multi-select, no 4-option limit.

karanb192/cache-tax:..name: cache-tax
karanb192/cache-tax:..description: A Claude Code mod that keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and stops a cold send once with its estimated rewrite cost. Warming uses model requests and costs tokens. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: action-pin
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: After an edit that adds a GitHub Actions step pinned to a tag or a branch, names the commit SHA to write instead, from the GitHub API.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: ask-autopick
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Picks the recommended option of a question that waited unanswered for a set time, so a session you left does not stop. Off until you turn it on.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: bash-diet
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Shrinks each Bash result before the model reads it: per-command filters for git, test runners, linters, package managers, containers and file tools, the full output kept in a file.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: bg-tasks
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Shows the background shell tasks of the session on the status line or in the shared sidebar, with the oldest one's age, and stops one from the /bg-tasks pane.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: bughunt
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Runs proof-driven bug hunt rounds with /bughunt: each round proves one bug with a failing command the mod runs itself, fixes it, and proves the fix, and the loop stops on a blocked or unverified round. /bughunt collab runs a read-only scanner, planner and critic in sequence.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: cache-warm
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm for a window you set, or with no end in every session under always, with one cache-shared fork per idle stretch and one keep-warm message after a resume, arms a window for you after a paid cold write, and shows the cache state, the cold price and this session's cold writes.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: commit-cadence
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Names the uncommitted files to you at the end of each turn, and tells the model at the next prompt to commit each finished piece as it lands.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: config-parse
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Parses each JSON, YAML, TOML or .env file an Edit or Write touches, notes a parse error at once instead of at the next build, and says so again when a later edit fixes it.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: context-restore
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Hands a skill or command call the current text of its file when the file changed on disk after the session loaded it, and hands the model a rules file or the global CLAUDE.md that changed on disk.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: contract-watch
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: After the model changes a function signature with Edit, adds the callers ripwire finds to the Edit's result, so the model fixes them before the build does.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: council
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Asks a council of models about a hard problem, when the model calls its tool or you run /council <question>: Claude models, and Gemini models when gemini-core has a key, answer in parallel, and the model of the session writes one verdict from their answers.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: dep-sentinel
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Checks each package the model installs against its registry and OSV.dev, and stops a missing, brand-new, look-alike, outdated or vulnerable one, naming the latest version.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: desk-notify
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Sends a desktop notification when a question or a plan waits for your answer, and when a turn ends or fails.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: diagram-render
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Renders the mermaid blocks of the model's replies with an installed mmdc after each turn and draws each picture under its reply.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: disk-janitor
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Measures the build artifacts of the repository, shows them on the status line from 5 GB, and deletes the ones you pick in the /disk-janitor pane; data directories are never listed.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: doc-drift-watch
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: After each commit the model makes, adds the doc lines that commit made stale (file:line references, symbol names) to the commit's result, from ripwire doc-drift, and holds each finding open until the doc holds again.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: edit-loop
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Adds a note to the fifth edit of one file in one turn, so the model re-reads the code path and states the root cause instead of trying again.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: effort-auto
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Has a small model rate how hard each prompt is and runs that turn and its subagents at the matching effort, within the levels you allow, on the models whose prompt cache survives an effort change.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: env-sync
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: After each commit the model makes, names the env variables its added lines read that .env.example lacks, with the file and line of each.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: error-poke
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Sends one continue prompt after a turn an API error killed, so the half-done work carries on instead of the session going idle, at most 99 times in a row by default.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: flaky-memory
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Remembers which tests failed on which code, and tells the model when a failing test has both passed and failed on the same code, so it runs the test again instead of changing code.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: gemini-advisor
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Gives the model a Gemini advisor tool it calls by itself: Gemini reads the whole conversation and the model's message and answers with a second opinion. Off until /gemini-advisor on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: gemini-compact
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Moves compaction from Claude to Gemini: in summary mode Gemini summarizes the conversation and the newest messages stay verbatim, in prune mode every message stays and Gemini keeps, cuts or drops older tool calls. Off until /gemini-compact on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: gemini-core
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Keeps the Gemini keys and tier of every Gemini mod, and each mod's model and thinking level, in one place: adds $.gemini, which builds their Gemini requests, reads the answers and moves to the next key after a quota or key error, and picks a model from Google's list.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: gemini-plan-review
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Has Gemini review each plan before the approval dialog, from the plan and the conversation, and sends a plan with a blocking finding back to the model, at most twice. Off until /gemini-plan-review on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: gemini-review
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Has Gemini review every git commit the model runs, from the staged diff and the conversation, and stops a commit with a blocking finding: a bug, data loss, a security hole or a committed secret. Off until /gemini-review on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: git-commit
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Ships a commit skill and holds every Bash git commit to it: a commit the skill did not open, a blanket git add, a signature trailer, a secret, an ignored path, or a push or branch change nobody asked for is stopped before git runs.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: i18n-watch
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: After an edit that calls translation keys, names the keys the JSON, Laravel PHP, YAML or gettext locale files lack, and the languages that lack them.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: idle-art
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Draws an ASCII animation above the prompt while the model works: matrix rain, fire, an aquarium, a cat, or a GIF of your own imported as a character clip for every project. Display only: nothing reaches the model.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: limit-watch
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Shows the subscription usage limits under the prompt or in the shared sidebar with a reset countdown and a projection, opens a /limit-watch pane, logs once when a limit passes 80% and 95%, and stops sampling entirely with /limit-watch off.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: lockfile-sync
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: After each commit the model makes, names the manifests whose dependencies it changed without their lockfile (npm, Composer, Cargo, Go, Python, Bundler, Dart, Mix).

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: mcp-doctor
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Tells you when an MCP server failed to connect or dropped, with the engine's reason and a reconnect button, and when it is back; claude.ai connectors are left out.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: memory-save
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Loads MEMORY.md into the session and saves project learnings to it after every turn through a tool-less fork in the background, without blocking the stop.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: mod-doctor
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Names each installed plugin, of every marketplace, whose local clone already offers a newer version, with the claude plugin update command that closes the gap.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: orphan-server
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Lists the servers a Bash call of the model started in this repository and left listening on a port, with their age and session, and stops one with SIGTERM, then SIGKILL.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: output-flood
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Measures how much context each Bash command spent and tells the model, past a size limit, which narrower command would have answered the same question.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: pin-note
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Keeps the notes you pin with /pin-note for the whole session and sends them to the model again, word for word, after each compaction and /clear. Off until /pin-note on.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: probe-runner
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: For mod development: runs a live check of plugins in a fresh Claude Code session in tmux, types the steps one by one, collects the pane and the transcript, then deletes the temp directory, its transcripts and the inline store files.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: prompt-deck
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Learns the short prompts you send often in this project and draws them, with the ones you pin by hand, above the prompt; with the prompt box empty, a digit key sends one at once.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: prompt-offload
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Writes a prompt longer than the limit (2000 characters by default) to a temp file and sends the model its first 200 characters with the path, so one paste does not fill the context.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: prompt-time
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Draws the time under each of your messages and each text block of the model's replies, also for a resumed session whose transcript is 4 MiB or smaller. Display only: nothing reaches the model.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: sage-memory
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Keeps project and global memories in SQLite through a shared local daemon, hands the model the entries that match its file tool calls, prompts and subagent tasks, and saves new ones with a haiku consolidator after each main-loop turn.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: self-command
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: For mod development: lets the model run a slash command in its own session, such as /reload-plugins after a plugin update, and read the output as the next prompt.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: session-watch
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Shows this session's state in the sidebar: context fill, token totals, cost, model and effort, the Claude Code version, the other sessions of this machine, and the git branch and status.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: shot-inline
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Draws each PNG or JPG the model saves or reads under its tool row: pixels in kitty and Ghostty, quadrant block cells in every other terminal.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: sidebar
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Opens one shared pane beside the transcript and draws the sections, lines and buttons every other mod writes into it through $.sidebar; each stream entry is stamped with its time and kept in a per-project log the next session takes back.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: slash-chain
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Runs slash commands joined with && one after another, waits for each command's turn, pane or dialog to end, and stops the chain at a command that failed or a turn that ended without an answer.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: sql-concat-watch
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: After an edit that builds SQL by joining or interpolating strings, names each line, so the model passes the values as query parameters.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: storage-guard
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: After an edit that keeps browser data in localStorage or sessionStorage, names each line, so the model stores the data in a cookie instead.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: subagent-ledger
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Shows each subagent of the session with its turns, time, model and tokens, the costliest first, yellow while it runs and green once it answered, and marks one that passed the token limit.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: task-poke
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Submits a continue prompt while the task list has unfinished tasks, at most 99 times in a row by default, and turns the task tools on for every model unless CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS is set.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: tool-coach
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: Stops the model from repeating a tool call that just failed with the same input, until a file or command has changed something.

KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.name: ua-fallback
KilimcininKorOglu/claude-code-mods:plugi.description: After a curl or wget an automated-client filter answered 403 or 429, gives the model the browser User-Agent to retry with, and the two cases where it must not.

Conte777/claude-lint:plugins/lint.name: lint
Conte777/claude-lint:plugins/lint.description: Formats and lints every file Claude Code edits, reported as one collapsible line.

getexcited/stepwarden:..name: stepwarden
getexcited/stepwarden:..description: Every tool call your agent makes, checked before it runs. Verifies each pending tool call against the session's plan using TypeSafe AI's Jev model, then allows it, asks you, or blocks it.

EliaAlberti/jev-rules:plugins/jev-rules.name: jev-rules
EliaAlberti/jev-rules:plugins/jev-rules.description: Jev picks which of your rules apply to each prompt, so Claude only sees the ones that matter.

Nasrallah-AL/jev-cli:plugin.name: jev
Nasrallah-AL/jev-cli:plugin.description: Cheap, fast, typed AI judgments inside Claude Code via the jevctl CLI (verify, screen, find, classify, extract, rerank, match, route, ask, batch), plus verbatim Jev-guided context compaction that replaces the built-in summary.

meganemura/draft-pane:plugin.name: draft-pane
meganemura/draft-pane:plugin.description: A pane beside the transcript that shows the model's newest open draft and sends your comments on it, span by span, as one prompt.

tamaratran/jev-pruner:tests/fixtures/lon.name: jev-long-session-observer
tamaratran/jev-pruner:tests/fixtures/lon.description: Capture synthetic live-test evidence without changing Jev requests.

sontixyou/sushi-uchi:sushida.name: sushida
sontixyou/sushi-uchi:sushida.description: 寿司打風の日本語タイピングゲームを /sushida でペインに開く。かな入力のローマ字表記揺れに対応。

duqaXxX/sidepad:.github/scripts/live/eng.name: engine-fixture
duqaXxX/sidepad:.github/scripts/live/eng.description: Tooling only, never installed: draws what sidepad avoids, so the limit scenarios of check:live can watch Claude Code do it.

duqaXxX/sidepad:plugins/sidepad.name: sidepad
duqaXxX/sidepad:plugins/sidepad.description: A read-only side pane beside the transcript: it opens the file Claude last edited at the end of the turn, lists directories one page at a time, draws code highlighted and Markdown rendered, and sends a selected passage back to Claude with a command or the next prompt.

kunchenguid/compact-adviser:packages/cla.name: compact-adviser
kunchenguid/compact-adviser:packages/cla.description: Suggests (or, opt-in, runs) /compact at a completed checkpoint, judged by TypeSafe Jev. Its hooks module activates only when CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is exactly 1 and is otherwise a complete no-op.

SaharCarmel/linear-mod:linear-mod.name: linear
SaharCarmel/linear-mod:linear-mod.description: /linear: your Linear projects, milestones and issues in a pane beside the transcript. Read an issue, then press plan, execute or product to send a ready prompt about it into this session. A Claude Code function-hooks (Mods) plugin.

surendranb/cc-radio:..name: ccradio
surendranb/cc-radio:..description: Music that plays while Claude Code is working, so you know by ear when it's done.

bannzai/SecChain:skills/secchain/hooks/m.name: secchain-mask
bannzai/SecChain:skills/secchain/hooks/m.description: Hides SecChain's secret values in prompts, tool results and instructions before the model reads them, through secchain mask.

MongLong0214/jev-gate:..name: jev-gate
MongLong0214/jev-gate:..description: Jev Gate in one plugin: the orchestration gate, the extractive compactor, the Vitest log folder, the Jev effort and model router and the jev_evidence tool. Every part is on by default; each has its own on/off option.

MongLong0214/jev-gate:mods/output.name: jev-gate-output
MongLong0214/jev-gate:mods/output.description: Folds runs of identical consecutive lines in a passing Vitest log the host saved to a file, so the model reads the whole run with exact counts instead of a 2 KB preview; on by default.

meganemura/grilling-pane:plugin.name: grilling-pane
meganemura/grilling-pane:plugin.description: A pane beside the transcript that shows the model's open interview questions and submits every pick as one prompt.

meganemura/jira-ticket-pane:plugin.name: jira-ticket-pane
meganemura/jira-ticket-pane:plugin.description: A pane beside the transcript that fetches one Jira issue by key and lets you attach it to your next prompt.

meganemura/buffer-pane:plugin.name: buffer-pane
meganemura/buffer-pane:plugin.description: A pane beside the transcript that holds the next things to tell the agent: write blocks of text while a turn runs, then press [+] to put one block into the prompt box.

BeLazy167/typesafe-mod:..name: typesafe-mod
BeLazy167/typesafe-mod:..description: Routes decisions to TypeSafe's Jev model: ranks installed skills for each prompt, and answers the agent's own this-or-that questions when confident.

iautom8things/bw-peek:..name: bw-peek
iautom8things/bw-peek:..description: A Beadwork ticket pane inside Claude Code: /bw <id> or a search box runs bw show and draws the digest, title, description and comments; every ticket id a reply mentions gets a button that opens it. Needs function hooks (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1).

AlmogBaku/ContextSaver:..name: contextsaver
AlmogBaku/ContextSaver:..description: Diagnoses wrong processes, workflows and habits in Claude Code sessions: fires on plan acceptance, workflow launches, pace complaints and the clock, names the lean alternative with its measured cost, and lets the user fix it in one click.

Agulhas-Labs/claude-plugins:plugins/cach.name: cache-guard
Agulhas-Labs/claude-plugins:plugins/cach.description: Warns once before a message that will cost far more than usual: a large Claude Code context whose prompt cache has expired, or a model or effort change that resets it. Shows the estimated cost, and offers a handoff file written by a cheap model in the background so you can /clear instead.

Agulhas-Labs/claude-plugins:plugins/logb.name: logbook
Agulhas-Labs/claude-plugins:plugins/logb.description: Keeps a live local page for a long Claude Code task: what needs you, what was built, what was verified, and what was decided without you. Hooks record it without spending model tokens, the page follows light, dark or your system's setting, and when the task ends the same page is the report.

bahaospanov/claude-mods:git-cleanup.name: git-cleanup
bahaospanov/claude-mods:git-cleanup.description: Cleans up after merged work, once it shipped: removing a branch needs git, the forge or the user to say it merged; removing it or filling in its issue waits for the pipeline holding it to pass; merged, clean work gets a follow-up to remove its worktree and branches.

bahaospanov/claude-mods:git-gates.name: git-gates
bahaospanov/claude-mods:git-gates.description: Gates git work: no commit, push or merge without the user's say-so in the current turn; a push to a branch that already landed is refused; a pushed series must leave the project working at every commit; commit messages (format and the issue it is about, then a Haiku review of the body) and MR descriptions kept tidy.

bahaospanov/claude-mods:lean-comments.name: lean-comments
bahaospanov/claude-mods:lean-comments.description: Comments worth keeping: limit-edits flags comment-heavy edits, limit-turns sends a follow-up when a turn's diff adds too many comments.

bahaospanov/claude-mods:lean-docs.name: lean-docs
bahaospanov/claude-mods:lean-docs.description: Docs worth keeping: docs-review asks Haiku whether new text will be read again, docs-no-repeat-code blocks lines that restate code, limit-docs sends a follow-up when a turn adds too much prose.

bahaospanov/claude-mods:lean-scripts.name: lean-scripts
bahaospanov/claude-mods:lean-scripts.description: Scripts worth keeping: scripts-review asks Haiku whether a new script could just be typed again when needed.

bahaospanov/skills:git-cleanup.name: git-cleanup
bahaospanov/skills:git-cleanup.description: Cleans up after merged work, once it shipped: removing a branch needs git, the forge or the user to say it merged; removing it or filling in its issue waits for the pipeline holding it to pass; merged, clean work gets a follow-up to remove its worktree and branches.

bahaospanov/skills:git-gates.name: git-gates
bahaospanov/skills:git-gates.description: Gates git work: no commit, push or merge without the user's say-so in the current turn; a push to a branch that already landed is refused; a pushed series must leave the project working at every commit; commit messages (format and the issue it is about, then a Haiku review of the body) and MR descriptions kept tidy.

bahaospanov/skills:lean-comments.name: lean-comments
bahaospanov/skills:lean-comments.description: Comments worth keeping: limit-edits flags comment-heavy edits, limit-turns sends a follow-up when a turn's diff adds too many comments.

bahaospanov/skills:lean-docs.name: lean-docs
bahaospanov/skills:lean-docs.description: Docs worth keeping: docs-review asks Haiku whether new text will be read again, docs-no-repeat-code blocks lines that restate code, limit-docs sends a follow-up when a turn adds too much prose.

bahaospanov/skills:lean-scripts.name: lean-scripts
bahaospanov/skills:lean-scripts.description: Scripts worth keeping: scripts-review asks Haiku whether a new script could just be typed again when needed.

WhiteKr/claude-plugin-mermaid:..name: mermaid
WhiteKr/claude-plugin-mermaid:..description: Render ```mermaid fences in assistant replies as Unicode box-drawing diagrams in the terminal transcript

darrell-tw/darrelltw-mods:mods/tw-stock-.name: tw-stock-mod
darrell-tw/darrelltw-mods:mods/tw-stock-.description: Watchlist band above the Claude Code prompt: Taiwan hours show the Taiwan list (紅漲綠跌), US hours show the US list (綠漲紅跌), in a broker-style table with a Solari split-flap footer, plus a 損益 mode (P&L view) for your holdings. 20 symbols a market, 10 on screen at a time. Live prices from Yahoo by default, no key and no account; 永豐 Shioaji (macOS/Linux) and 群益 Capital (Windows) are opt-in real-time routes the band runs itself, tried in your own preference order (twSources) - keep that order and any broker paths in a user-level ~/.claude/stock-band.json so a shared project config stays neutral. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal. Zero model tokens.

GhalebDweikat/winnow:..name: winnow
GhalebDweikat/winnow:..description: A calibrated context sieve for Claude Code. Every large tool result is judged by a System One model before it enters context; irrelevant blocks are replaced with a summary and a recall key.

tomada1114/clawd-band:plugins/clawd-band.name: clawd-band
tomada1114/clawd-band:plugins/clawd-band.description: An unofficial fan-made pixel cat that lives in the band above the prompt and reacts to what Claude is doing: thinking, editing, craning after a search, yowling in a shell, squeezing its eyes shut at a tool error, and folding its ears down to sleep between turns.

alexandernicholson/agent-router:agent-ro.name: agent-router
alexandernicholson/agent-router:agent-ro.description: Choose a model and effort for five agent roles and for agent team teammates with /agent-models, and inspect routing and usage. Requires Claude Code Mod function hooks enabled.

alexandernicholson/agent-router:keepaliv.name: keepalive
alexandernicholson/agent-router:keepaliv.description: A prompt cache bar for every conversation, subagent and teammate, a dashboard with /keepalive, per-conversation cache TTLs, and upkeep that keeps an idle cache warm or compacts it before it expires. Requires Claude Code Mod function hooks enabled.

giovaborgogno/cc-dino:..name: cc-dino
giovaborgogno/cc-dino:..description: The T-rex from the browser's offline page, above the Claude Code prompt: jump cacti and duck birds while Claude works. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

manfye/cc-dino:..name: cc-dino
manfye/cc-dino:..description: The Chrome offline dinosaur, above the Claude Code prompt. Jump the cacti and duck the pterodactyls while Claude works. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

Vatsa10/Meta-Harness:..name: meta-harness
Vatsa10/Meta-Harness:..description: Harness engineering for Claude Code: attribute every prompt/agent change, keep every candidate, diagnose from traces, hold out a split - and search over Claude Code's own scaffold against your repo's real failures.

meganemura/pull-request-pane:plugin.name: pull-request-pane
meganemura/pull-request-pane:plugin.description: A pane beside the transcript with the GitHub pull requests and issues related to the current session: drag a title or description to leave a comment on it, add as many as you like, then Submit sends them all as one prompt. Watch each pull request's checks, review decision and mergeability update on a timer.

karanb192/claude-code-mods:plugins/fable.name: fable-pin
karanb192/claude-code-mods:plugins/fable.description: Pins every subagent to the fable model: rewrites the model on agent.spawn unless the spawn is a fork, with /fable-pin on, off and status. Touches nothing but its own store. Needs function hooks (early access).

karanb192/claude-code-mods:plugins/image.name: image-peek
karanb192/claude-code-mods:plugins/image.description: Preview pasted images at their prompt markers on macOS. Ghostty, plus experimental iTerm2 and Herdr support with a startup override. Claude Code 2.1.287+.

karanb192/claude-code-mods:plugins/mod-b.name: probe-mod
karanb192/claude-code-mods:plugins/mod-b.description: [probe] Loaded headlessly by mod-builder so the engine writes the running build's types. Not a mod to install.

GGGODLIN/cc-mod-waitwhat:..name: cc-mod-waitwhat
GGGODLIN/cc-mod-waitwhat:..description: Buttons above the prompt: retell recent turns in plain words, or open what a background check flagged that you might miss. Results go to Claude Code's own pane; nothing enters the transcript or the model's context.

karanb192/awesome-claude-code-mods:examp.name: hello-mod
karanb192/awesome-claude-code-mods:examp.description: The smallest Claude Mod: logs one line when the session starts and refuses one Bash command. Three files, no dependencies, exists so you can see the validator print a footprint.

AnExiledDev/compact-handoff-plugin:..name: compact-handoff
AnExiledDev/compact-handoff-plugin:..description: Replaces the engine's compaction with a subagent's handoff, and measures whether it can be one

BeLazy167/claude-mods-skill:examples/bra.name: branch-band
BeLazy167/claude-mods-skill:examples/bra.description: Example: band above the prompt with the git branch, from $.process.run on a timer, held in $.state

BeLazy167/claude-mods-skill:examples/dic.name: dice-tool
BeLazy167/claude-mods-skill:examples/dic.description: Example: registers a tool the model can call and answers it

BeLazy167/claude-mods-skill:examples/hel.name: hello-mod
BeLazy167/claude-mods-skill:examples/hel.description: Starter mod: logs each tool call and blocks Bash commands that contain rm -rf.

BeLazy167/claude-mods-skill:examples/not.name: notes-pane
BeLazy167/claude-mods-skill:examples/not.description: Example: /note saves to $.store, /notes opens a pane with a Clear button

BeLazy167/claude-mods-skill:examples/red.name: redact-output
BeLazy167/claude-mods-skill:examples/red.description: Example: rewrites Bash output so the model never reads tokens

Arunjay4213/claude-mods:plugins/budget-g.name: budget-guard
Arunjay4213/claude-mods:plugins/budget-g.description: Stops a session before it runs past a budget. Three figures are guarded, each with a limit you set: the session cost in dollars, the 5-hour plan window and the 7-day plan window. It says nothing until a figure nears its limit, then pins a status line and warns once; past the limit it refuses tool calls and asks before sending another prompt. /guard shows the state and changes the limits.

Arunjay4213/claude-mods:plugins/context-.name: context-lens
Arunjay4213/claude-mods:plugins/context-.description: A live /context: a pinned line under the prompt with the window fill and the growth per turn, and /context-lens for a pane with the per-category bars and how many turns are left before auto-compaction.

Arunjay4213/claude-mods:plugins/quota-me.name: quota-meter
Arunjay4213/claude-mods:plugins/quota-me.description: Shows the subscription plan limits - the 5-hour window, the 7-day window and a gateway spend limit - as a pinned status line under the prompt, with a reset countdown and a projection of when you would hit 100% at the pace of the last few samples. /quota opens a pane with a bar, the reset clock time and the burn rate for each window.

Arunjay4213/claude-mods:plugins/token-le.name: token-ledger
Arunjay4213/claude-mods:plugins/token-le.description: A per-turn cost and token ledger: a pinned status line with the session cost, the last turn's tokens and the cache hit ratio, and /ledger for a table of the recent turns with their model, tokens, cache reads and writes, duration and cost.

JayDoubleu/aside:..name: aside
JayDoubleu/aside:..description: Read-only side chat: /aside opens a pane beside the transcript where you ask about the session so far; answers come from a tool-less fork of the session's own transcript and nothing is written back into the main thread.

Charlie0113-T/claude-agent-flow:..name: agent-flow
Charlie0113-T/claude-agent-flow:..description: The agent flow pane: /flow opens a live tree of the session's subagents and teammates beside the transcript, fed by engine events, with a text fallback where no pane can be drawn.

deonmenezes/claude-mods-pokedex:..name: cc-pokedex
deonmenezes/claude-mods-pokedex:..description: Catch wild creatures above the Claude Code prompt: where your prompt leads (water, grass, fire, bugs, plans, builds) decides what appears. Pick a partner that draws under the logo, beside the spinner and above the prompt, and levels up and evolves as Claude works. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

sezaakgun/cc-arcade:..name: cc-arcade
sezaakgun/cc-arcade:..description: Games above the Claude Code prompt (snake, Tetris, 2048, Minesweeper, Flappy, Pong, typing test, Space Invaders, Doom) plus a pet that grows as Claude tests, commits and edits. Clones of the genre, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tetris Holding, Taito, Atari or id Software. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

sezaakgun/cc-pr-tracker:..name: cc-pr-tracker
sezaakgun/cc-pr-tracker:..description: Watch GitHub PRs from a Claude Code session: merge state, review and required checks above the prompt, with alerts when they change

hatan4ik/prompts-and-agents:upstreams/cl.name: agents-md
hatan4ik/prompts-and-agents:upstreams/cl.description: AGENTS.md as project instructions, by one option. Under claude-md-or-agents-md a project with no instruction files of its own gets its AGENTS.md files instead: a prompt.context hook asks $.fs.ancestors for every AGENTS.md and .claude/AGENTS.md from the filesystem root down to the working directory and hands them to the engine as project instruction files, which it renders, announces and withholds from agents exactly as it does CLAUDE.md, skipping any file the engine already loaded by import or link; a tool.call hook on Read attaches the ones under the project root as the engine attaches a nested CLAUDE.md. Under claude-md-and-agents-md every AGENTS.md is loaded beside CLAUDE.md. Under managed-only the project's and the person's instruction files are dropped and the organization's managed ones kept. Under claude-md the engine's walk stands alone. claude-md-or-agents-md is the default.

hatan4ik/prompts-and-agents:upstreams/cl.name: diff
hatan4ik/prompts-and-agents:upstreams/cl.description: The diff pane as a plugin: /diff opens the session's uncommitted changes beside the transcript, file by file with their hunks, refreshed as Claude edits and runs commands; the first edit opens it where the terminal is wide enough, and a file's ask button rides its hunks on the next prompt.

hatan4ik/prompts-and-agents:upstreams/cl.name: sec-default
hatan4ik/prompts-and-agents:upstreams/cl.description: Security default for organizations: seated outermost, it keeps the organization's classic hooks, prompt content, settings and tool policy out of reach of the plugins a person installs, and adds no policy of its own; one managed option, allowManagedModsOnly, limits mods to the organization's.

yha9806/wishing-willow:plugin.name: willow
yha9806/wishing-willow:plugin.description: Shows how the model decoded your request, next to your verbatim prompt. It never judges whether they agree — you do.

NotTahaAli/sessclone:packages/plugin.name: sessclone
NotTahaAli/sessclone:packages/plugin.description: Sends Claude Code usage to a SessClone deployment.

tomstagl/cctop:plugin.name: cctop
tomstagl/cctop:plugin.description: btop-style live dashboard for Claude Code internals: /cctop opens it in a side pane, cctop-insights lets the session answer questions from its numbers

diegorv/claude-functions-hook:plugins/ac.name: activity-log
diegorv/claude-functions-hook:plugins/ac.description: Every event of the session, tool calls and their full results included, appended to a JSONL file per session

diegorv/claude-functions-hook:plugins/gh.name: gh-ci-status
diegorv/claude-functions-hook:plugins/gh.description: GitHub Actions runs of the session's repo, pinned above the prompt, with links to the PR and the run

diegorv/claude-functions-hook:plugins/ti.name: time
diegorv/claude-functions-hook:plugins/ti.description: The time you sent each message, drawn above it

Miracle0x0/CCometixLine:mods/agents.name: ccline-agents-mod
Miracle0x0/CCometixLine:mods/agents.description: Experimental in-process subagent activity for CCometixLine.

poindexter12/loadout:plugins/sidequest.name: sidequest
poindexter12/loadout:plugins/sidequest.description: The Loadout's core work board and orchestration loop for Claude Code. Tickets are classified into categories that route each one to a concrete model and effort, then dispatched to token-gated executors; side issues you mention mid-task get captured on the spot, and a live, self-hosted Kanban dashboard spans every project you work in.

hnkabraham/claude-code-mobile-mode:..name: mobile-mode
hnkabraham/claude-code-mobile-mode:..description: Phone-driven sessions end each turn with tappable AskUserQuestion options and a push notification, injected per-turn and scoped to the session you toggle it in.

radiator-engineering/eventlog:mods/event.name: eventlog-context
radiator-engineering/eventlog:mods/event.description: Replaces context compaction in the controller's interactive session of a log-driven repo: the conversation is rebuilt from .context/events.jsonl by `eventlog context`, plus the last few turns word for word. Rebuilds at the log's task boundaries and at a fill backstop; /rebuild queues a rebuild for the end of the next turn, and /compact rebuilds from the log at once. Inert in headless sessions, for other EVENTLOG_AS writers, with EVENTLOG_CONTEXT=off, and in a repo without the log. Falls back to the engine's compaction when eventlog fails.

savinofiore/lexi:jev.name: jev
savinofiore/lexi:jev.description: Three-level decision layer on TypeSafe's Jev: picks model and effort per session and per subagent, compacts context without rewriting it, and gates code review with calibrated closed questions. Pairs with lexi: the review runs after the last GREEN.

ray-amjad/awesome-claude-code-function-h.name: secret-redactor
ray-amjad/awesome-claude-code-function-h.description: Keeps secrets, email addresses and IP addresses out of the session transcript: swaps each one for a stable placeholder on the way in, and puts the real value back on the way into a tool call

ray-amjad/awesome-claude-code-function-h.name: vercel-deploy-status
ray-amjad/awesome-claude-code-function-h.description: Pins the Vercel deploy queue of the linked project under the prompt: every deploy queued, building or just finished, with its phase and elapsed time

michael-berardi/ultracompress:claude-cod.name: ultracompress
michael-berardi/ultracompress:claude-cod.description: Deterministic local compaction for Claude Code: replaces the stock compaction summarizer with the local UltraCompress binary (no model call, no API cost per compaction) and serves a recall tool over the raw session transcript.

bajzaa975/claude-alapcsomag:cache-timer.name: cache-timer
bajzaa975/claude-alapcsomag:cache-timer.description: Status line: minutes left until the main thread's prompt cache goes cold (assumes a 60-minute cache; it is 5 minutes during usage overage, which the mod cannot detect)

bajzaa975/claude-alapcsomag:nightrun-pan.name: nightrun-pane
bajzaa975/claude-alapcsomag:nightrun-pan.description: /nightrun: pane with the newest claude-orchestrator night run's sprint states and log tail (reads only the runtime/nightrun layout; not bajzi night-run's NIGHT_DIR)

ricardosuman/maestro:mods/lanes.name: maestro-lanes
ricardosuman/maestro:mods/lanes.description: Shows Maestro external lane runs above the prompt.

smashandclash/plugin:com.anthropic.claud.name: smash-and-clash-mod
smashandclash/plugin:com.anthropic.claud.description: Play Smash&Clash, a two-player strategy board game where every move matters, in a pane while Claude works. /smash opens the board.

Kiy-K/oxide:.agents/skills/jev-model-rou.name: jev-model-router
Kiy-K/oxide:.agents/skills/jev-model-rou.description: Picks the model and the reasoning effort for each task with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model reached either through TypeSafe's own API or the Vercel AI Gateway. Routes subagent models at agent.spawn and the main loop's effort and model at turn.step, in both directions, falling back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.

RedesignedRobot/cdx:..name: cdx
RedesignedRobot/cdx:..description: Run OpenAI Codex and Google Antigravity execution lanes from Claude Code with background event delivery, status tracking, and raw command protection.

OpenScribbler/Katharsis:..name: katharsis
OpenScribbler/Katharsis:..description: An output style that classifies each message by exchange type and shapes the reply to fit it: the answer first, a ceiling per type, reference codes that survive the session, and decisions handed back as questions

mephistopheles4/grimoire:..name: grimoire
mephistopheles4/grimoire:..description: A spellbook of agent skills for AI. Cast wisely. Four skills: eagle-eye, which lays coupled decisions out as a morphological box and renders one self-contained page that reads any configuration back; groundtrack, which turns a plan or a written change into a call graph with recorded traces through it, on a page a reader can step; contract, which interviews a person to agree the terms for a skill or an agent of their own, then generates its file from that contract and checks its format; and head-chef, which makes a Claude Desktop session the lead of the sessions it starts, with their model and effort set, their milestone reports, relays between them, and cleanup when the owner says a session is done. And one pane for Claude Code: Brigade, opened with /brigade, which shows the sessions a lead session started, each with its work, phase, live busy or idle state and latest report.

unpaged/plugins:plugins/unpaged.name: unpaged
unpaged/plugins:plugins/unpaged.description: Renders Claude Code plans as whiteboards on Unpaged. /unpaged:visual-plan turns the plan in your conversation into a canvas of phases, tasks, and dependencies and listens to its @agent comments (delivered automatically by a listener inside Claude Code, with a line above the prompt showing what you listen to; a background Monitor on older builds); approving the plan stamps the canvas EXECUTING. While the plan is implemented the session keeps a Decision log on the canvas; /unpaged:as-built then compiles the as-built record — what shipped vs the plan, every decision and its why, the data flow, a reviewer's guide — as a frozen canvas nested under the plan. Every plan is filed in the Visual plans folder of your Unpaged library.

charanjit-singh/ClaudeVsCodeMinimal:mod/.name: agent-mailbox
charanjit-singh/ClaudeVsCodeMinimal:mod/.description: Mailboxes for Claude sessions: names, cross-profile messages that wake idle sessions, and a band with your account, context, and plan limits.

TransmuteLabs/Catalyst-CC-Patch:tools/sp.name: spawnprobe
TransmuteLabs/Catalyst-CC-Patch:tools/sp.description: Measurement instrument for the agent.spawn function-hook site. Not a product mod.

andrewbakercloudscale/claude-code-cost-s.name: usage-panel
andrewbakercloudscale/claude-code-cost-s.description: The usage panel in a sidebar inside Claude Code: this session, today, the last 30 days, projects, top sessions, the day's costliest turns and insights, with graphs, and, where Claude Burst is installed, the context it really sends by part and Plan Utilisation: how much of the plan's 5-hour and weekly limits is used, with a warning as one gets close. /usage-panel opens it, /usage-panel pin and /usage-panel unpin choose whether every session opens it

ippoan/gh-actions-live:mods/pr-bridge-wa.name: pr-bridge-watch
ippoan/gh-actions-live:mods/pr-bridge-wa.description: gh pr create / pr-push.sh で PR ができたら、その branch の CI を gh-actions-bridge の ws /watch に Monitor で繋ぐ Claude Mod (function hooks)

float-ritual-stack/pi-herdr-outliner:cla.name: pi-outliner
float-ritual-stack/pi-herdr-outliner:cla.description: Pi Outliner integration for Claude Code, following the outline the session folder is bound to: typed outline, workboard and door tools for agents (read, find, edit, comment, changes, draft.patch, ep0ch act), clickable references, and completed responses that mention [[pages]], ((block ids)) or Work IDs in the Outliner's Recent Mentions navigator.

mahuebel/segmem:..name: segmem
mahuebel/segmem:..description: Segmented, scoped memory for agents: one file, SQLite, no daemon. Wake at session start, recall on every prompt, staleness nag at stop.

Allan-Nava/qrspi:plugins/qrspi-pane.name: qrspi-pane
Allan-Nava/qrspi:plugins/qrspi-pane.description: A pane showing each QRSPI task in thoughts/: which phase it is in, what blocks it, and the /qrspi:next command to run

Bulls-Work/bullswarm:mods/bullswarm.name: bullswarm
Bulls-Work/bullswarm:mods/bullswarm.description: Bullswarm as a Claude Mod: live subscription meters for every installed coding-agent CLI above the prompt, quota-aware routing of Claude's own subagents to whichever pool has surplus, a verdict note on every bullswarm command the model runs, a /bullswarm command, and $.bullswarm for other plugins.

ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:engine/mods/harnes.name: harness-mods
ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:engine/mods/harnes.description: Harness Mod layer: heartbeat/canary, native usage, rewrite explanations, measured subagent accounting, supervisor routing, secret redaction. Modes per guard in ~/.claude/mods/mods-config.json (classic | shadow_mod | mod).

ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/l.name: spike-compact
ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/l.description: Spike: does $.session.compact() work from a plugin, and what does the session.compact event carry?

ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/l.name: spike-describe
ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/l.description: Spike: does a tool.describe rewrite reach the model, does agent.offer hide a type, does prompt.suggest fire?

ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/l.name: spike-handoff
ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/l.description: Spike: safe-boundary handoff (bundle written at turn.complete from the runtime bus) and $.turn.abort semantics

ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/l.name: xray
ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/l.description: CLAUDE RUNTIME X-RAY: wildcard inspector with filters (/xray all|tools|subagents|session|usage|ui|errors|unknown|off), a HUD above the prompt, and a black-box timeline file

ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/p.name: costclaw-live
ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/p.description: COSTCLAW LIVE: per-request cost, cache decay and repeated-read detection while the session runs, and it serves the Nth identical Read of an unchanged file from its own cache instead of paying for it

ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/p.name: prodguard
ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/p.description: PRODUCTION GUARD: ambient project/environment context + a transport-independent policy core (DashClaw evidence classifier + offlocal policy engine) enforced natively on tool.call and tool.check. Blocks, asks, or contains before the command runs. /prodguard

ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/p.name: supervisor
ucsandman/Agnostic-AI:labs/claude-mods/p.description: SUBAGENT SUPERVISOR: routing-and-budget Mod. Rewrites a spawn's model onto the capability graph instead of denying it, keeps a measured per-agent-type token ledger in $.store, caps tool calls per subagent, and shows live subagents + the last routing decision above the prompt. /supervisor prints the routing log and the ledger.

sKeLe100/firstmate:.claude/mods/firstmat.name: firstmate-calm
sKeLe100/firstmate:.claude/mods/firstmat.description: Firstmate Calm for Claude Code: the sailboat working animation and conversation-only transcript presentation, sharing the per-home config/calm preference with the Pi Calm extension. Its hooks module may load through CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS or Claude Code's tengu_plugin_hooks_modules rollout flag, but the mod activates only when CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is exactly 1 and is otherwise a complete no-op.

JeongJaeSoon/claude-vimium:plugin.name: hintvim
JeongJaeSoon/claude-vimium:plugin.description: Vimium-style hints over the Claude desktop app: /hintvim or Ctrl+;. Needs the hintvim app on macOS.

JeongJaeSoon/hintvim:plugin.name: hintvim
JeongJaeSoon/hintvim:plugin.description: Vimium-style hints over the Claude desktop app: /hintvim or Ctrl+;. Needs the hintvim app on macOS.

just-every/12ui-plugin:..name: 12ui-design
just-every/12ui-plugin:..description: A Design workspace in Claude Code: see design options for a UI as images, select one, ask for more, ask for a change with a note and hand an option off to be built. Your agent runs the 12ui command line once per request, which draws every option at once with your own Codex sign-in.

ucsandman/claude-harness:engine/mods/har.name: harness-mods
ucsandman/claude-harness:engine/mods/har.description: Harness Mod layer: heartbeat/canary, native usage, rewrite explanations, measured subagent accounting, supervisor routing, secret redaction. Modes per guard in ~/.claude/mods/mods-config.json (classic | shadow_mod | mod).

ucsandman/claude-harness:labs/claude-mod.description: Spike: does $.session.compact() work from a plugin, and what does the session.compact event carry?

Blocks, asks, or contains before the command runs. /prodguard

ucsandman/claude-harness:labs/claude-mod.description: SUBAGENT SUPERVISOR: routing-and-budget Mod. Rewrites a spawn's model onto the capability graph instead of denying it, keeps a measured per-agent-type token ledger in $.store, caps tool calls per subagent, and shows live subagents + the last routing decision above the prompt. /supervisor prints the routing log and the ledger.

akparhi/context-engineering:plugins/swit.name: switchboard
akparhi/context-engineering:plugins/swit.description: Shared Switchboard gateway, setup, status and reversible Claude startup integration.

kcsujeet/kc-claude-kit:plugins/image-pre.name: image-preview
kcsujeet/kc-claude-kit:plugins/image-pre.description: Thumbnails of the images you paste, above the prompt: the real picture in Ghostty and kitty, colored cells in other terminals, and the real file behind a copied Finder icon

kcsujeet/kc-claude-kit:plugins/usage-ban.name: usage-band
kcsujeet/kc-claude-kit:plugins/usage-ban.description: A row of pills above the prompt: model, context fill, 5h and 7d rate limits with reset times, input/output/cache tokens, and session cost

luisfmontes/rainforest-mind:..name: rainforest-mind
luisfmontes/rainforest-mind:..description: O problema não é falta de ideia, é o que recebe luz agora — planeja antes de implementar, responde em número, avisa no desvio e não chama de pronto sem a saída que prova

PromptSign/promptsign-plugin:..name: promptsign
PromptSign/promptsign-plugin:..description: Verifies signatures on the instruction files Claude Code loads, meaning CLAUDE.md, skills, and agent definitions, before they reach model context. It re-checks a skill bundle before the Skill tool runs it. Sigstore keyless, offline verification against a pinned trust root, no telemetry.

vivi-0124/me:mermaid-live.name: mermaid-live
vivi-0124/me:mermaid-live.description: Claude の応答が流れてくる途中から Mermaid で図解する Mod。図にすべきか・どの図か・もう描いていいかの判断だけを Jev（TypeSafe AI の System One モデル）に確率で聞き、Mermaid のソースは決定的に組み立てる。

superfly/sprites-claude-plugin:plugins/s.name: sprites
superfly/sprites-claude-plugin:plugins/s.description: Use Sprites from Claude Code to create, inspect, and operate remote isolated development environments.

kgaidev/kgai:mods/kgai-mod.name: kgai-mod
kgaidev/kgai:mods/kgai-mod.description: Experimental kgai add-on for Claude Code with function hooks: checks each code-editing turn for a structural decision on the side, records it without a line in the transcript, and draws kgai's own tool calls as one line each. Requires the kgai plugin.

sayre4ux/autopilot:..name: autopilot
sayre4ux/autopilot:..description: Multi-agent orchestrator harness for Claude Code: command loop, ledger, dispatch protocol, review cycle, model-economics, and a registry-driven external-worker layer.

mmurakaru/cueloop:..name: cueloop
mmurakaru/cueloop:..description: Claude Mod for cueloop Threads: plan, reply, prototype, diff, review, and refine

ray-manaloto/knowledge-base:.claude/mods.name: kb-settings-guard
ray-manaloto/knowledge-base:.claude/mods.description: Denies a delegated agent lane any write to this repo's Claude settings files.

ray-manaloto/knowledge-base:.claude/skil.name: model-registry
ray-manaloto/knowledge-base:.claude/skil.description: Report model drift and deny only positively invalid stale-pin launches.

ray-manaloto/knowledge-base:tests/fixtur.name: fnhook-fixture-escape-hatch-unconsulted
ray-manaloto/knowledge-base:tests/fixtur.description: Deny-capable module declaring the escape-hatch set but never consulting it

ray-manaloto/knowledge-base:tests/fixtur.name: fnhook-fixture-no-escape-hatch
ray-manaloto/knowledge-base:tests/fixtur.description: Deny-capable module that permits no escape-hatch tool

TransmuteLabs/Catalyst:plugins/catalyst-.name: catalyst-probes
TransmuteLabs/Catalyst:plugins/catalyst-.description: Consultation and prompt engine for Claude Mods. The module is the core; [probe.<id>] tables in probes.toml are the consultants and [prompt.<id>] tables author a system-prompt section, a tool description or a command description. The only carrier is the mod: a CLAUDE_*_CARRIER handle set to mod or left empty/unset arms the probe here; any other value loudly refuses the calls this probe acts on (the patch-side copy is gone).

TransmuteLabs/Catalyst:plugins/catalyst-.name: catalyst-refusal-watch
TransmuteLabs/Catalyst:plugins/catalyst-.description: Makes every response the service filter stopped visible at once and adds a rule: report it, do not drop work silently.

TransmuteLabs/Catalyst:plugins/catalyst-.name: catalyst-statusline
TransmuteLabs/Catalyst:plugins/catalyst-.description: Multi-line status HUD above the prompt over data families (hooks/data/*.ts pure collectors, one core subscription per event), with the /statusline-mod pill panel: live preview, six tabs (layout, elements, per-element settings, view axes, themes, number formats). Based on konsta95/ClaudeCodeMods statusline 0.3.2 (MIT, c49ad4a).

TransmuteLabs/Catalyst:plugins/catalyst-.name: catalyst-swe-request

home-dev-lab/workflow-toolbox:plugin.name: workflow-toolbox
home-dev-lab/workflow-toolbox:plugin.description: Toolbox for Claude Code's Workflow tool — author deterministic multi-agent workflow scripts (workflow-composer, with the @workflow-toolbox compile-time pattern toolkit as its standard library), scaffold a build-clean workflow skeleton from a spec (toolkit-scaffold), diagnose a failed run from its journal and decide whether resumeFromRunId helps (workflow-debugger), re-verify the runtime surface after a Claude Code upgrade (upgrade-canary), run a bias-free multi-lens analysis of any subject when relevant (independent-analysis), and run a deep-grounding pass that collects and verifies evidence against the real sources before asserting or analyzing (deep-grounding), and install, check, and migrate editable, versioned copies of the plugin's own rules and agent definitions into a project's or user's config directory (adopt). Ships the independent-analysis workflow that skill triggers (domain-agnostic adversarial multi-lens analysis), a Stop hook that auto-surfaces a finished Workflow run's cost + traceability audit report (always a notice; grabs the session when the run looks like trouble, was degraded by a silently-denied tool call, or requested external delegation whose agents show no real external-CLI invocation), and a tracker-agnostic actionability Stop gate that blocks only while startable work remains with nothing running, paired with a Planka producer that writes the snapshot it reads automatically from board-reading tool calls (never a guess: it writes nothing from a partial read or a read without card descriptions, uses the project's own dependency parser when one exists and the shipped one otherwise, and never counts a card without a Depends-on line as startable). Also ships the pilot agent suite (pilot / pilot-orchestrator / pilot-watchdog) and the pilot-wave composer skill for driving tracked task-tracker cards by delegation, plus a conditional SessionStart hook that injects a generic delegation ladder where a project does tracked/delegated work and points at the delegation-chain skill (a non-user-invocable reference on spawn shapes, the upward report chain, wake signals, and what each shipped watcher/guard does and does not cover) before a delegation decision is made. Ships two Planka kanban skills for any project that wants board-based task tracking: planka-tracking (onboard a project — create the board, migrate an existing progress.md into cards, write the pointer) and what-next (propose the logical next step from that board, or from progress.md/conversation when there's no board), both requiring only a reachable planka MCP server.
