5dive-ai/5dive-plugins:plugins/mod.name: mod
5dive-ai/5dive-plugins:plugins/mod.description: 5dive telemetry producer, seat panel, command surface and tool-call policy guard for Claude Code function hooks (early access). Publishes turn and session boundaries and the account's usage reading from inside the harness process to a per-seat JSONL sink, so the heartbeat, the pacing floor and the self-update's pending-restart sweep can read a first-class signal instead of inferring idle/busy from pane samples and the task board. Registers /task and /gate, which dispatch to the 5dive CLI in-process. It also draws one line above the prompt naming the row the seat holds, its gate, its grader and its token burn against its budget, at zero context cost. On the NON-FRESH seats it can additionally compact the conversation at a turn boundary, so the next dispatched goal lands on a summary instead of the whole accumulated window; that half pins any unanswered human gate or standing directive back into the compacted transcript. And it enforces a table-driven deny list over tool calls (policy/guard.json), so a rule that today costs every seat tokens on every turn and is caught after the fact is refused before the tool runs, with the reason handed to the model. Every capability is off unless the seat opts in; the compact hook is the only one that rewrites a call and the guard is the only one that can refuse one.

AnatoliyShk/bulgolingo:.claude/skills/je.name: jev-skill-suggestion

The winner's SKILL.md is attached to the prompt, so the skills can be hidden from the model altogether (/jev-skill-suggestion:setup makes them user-invocable-only and /context counts them at 0). Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.

leeovery/tick:.claude/skills/workflow-ga.name: workflow-gates

leeovery/tick:.claude/skills/workflow-ga.name: workflow-gates-rows
leeovery/tick:.claude/skills/workflow-ga.description: Draws the transcript row of an answer the workflow-gates mod sent as the question it answered and the answer, instead of Claude Code's framing.

darkroomengineering/cc-settings:plugins/.name: compaction-trigger
darkroomengineering/cc-settings:plugins/.description: Requests a session compaction when the live context passes a token threshold, so verbatim compaction plugins run near the working ceiling instead of at the model window.

darkroomengineering/cc-settings:plugins/.name: context-report
darkroomengineering/cc-settings:plugins/.description: Prints which instruction files the engine loaded (tier, path, @ imports, size) once per context load, and hints when a project CLAUDE.md keeps its AGENTS.md from being read.

darkroomengineering/cc-settings:plugins/.name: drift-fuse
darkroomengineering/cc-settings:plugins/.description: Scores each unattended turn against the task the person asked for with TypeSafe's Jev model, and after consecutive off-task turns redirects or pauses the next machine-submitted prompt.

jayteealao/agent-skills:plugins/sdlc-wor.name: sdlc-workflow
jayteealao/agent-skills:plugins/sdlc-wor.description: One command — `/wf` (`$wf` under Codex), the single SDLC entry point for Claude Code and Codex from one plugin tree — driving a 10-stage lifecycle from intake through retro, with per-slice artifacts, runtime-truth verification, and PO-confirmed stack fingerprinting. 24 keys: the stages, standalone/drivers (design, brainstorm, probe, simplify, auto, yolo, campaign), the task minimal lifecycle (non-code work with observed outcomes), navigation (status, recap), lifecycle (close), and routers (ship-plan, docs, observability). Code review is the `/wf review` key; design is `/wf design`; observability foundation is `/wf observability`; quick/standalone flows are `/wf intake` modes (including the audit defect hunt) plus the `/wf probe` and `/wf simplify` keys.

ukwhatn/.claude:skills/idle-compact.name: idle-compact
ukwhatn/.claude:skills/idle-compact.description: Compacts the main conversation once it has sat idle for idleMinutes, while the prompt cache is still warm, and hands every compaction of the main conversation (manual, auto, plugin, precompute) the Compact Instructions section of the user's AGENTS.md. Skips while a turn runs, below minMessageTokens of conversation, and past cutoffMinutes (a wake from sleep, when the cache has likely expired), saying which in the transcript; a reload of the plugin keeps the pending idle stretch.

djnsty23/claude-auto-dev:plugins/autodev.name: autodev-core
djnsty23/claude-auto-dev:plugins/autodev.description: Autonomous development workflow: brainstorm, auto, iterate, audit, review, ship, plus the prd.json sprint system.

nalyk/nalyk-skills:plugins/proctor.name: proctor
nalyk/nalyk-skills:plugins/proctor.description: Hook-enforced development discipline for Claude Code. Skills teach methodology; hooks enforce compliance mechanically (git gates, planning mode, step budgets, quiet mode, pre-flight checks, self-diagnosis, autonomy metrics); store + tracing survive compaction.

nalyk/nalyk-skills:plugins/superpowers-t.name: superpowers-tracker
nalyk/nalyk-skills:plugins/superpowers-t.description: Live tracker for obra/superpowers: a stage rail above the prompt, a dashboard pane, resume detection, toasts and optional guards.

kys0213/kys-claude-plugin:plugins/discor.name: discord-connector
kys0213/kys-claude-plugin:plugins/discor.description: Discord 멘션을 headless Claude 실행으로 연결하고, 실행 중 질문을 Discord 버튼으로 중계하는 connector

tdimino/claude-code-minoan:plugins/jev-c.name: jev-compact-gate
tdimino/claude-code-minoan:plugins/jev-c.description: Jev decides when the session compacts, inside a 280k–400k token band; Claude's own summary does the compacting.

yonatangross/orchestkit:mods/lesson-card.name: lesson-cards
yonatangross/orchestkit:mods/lesson-card.description: Displays lesson hint cards when tool calls match known patterns. Additive surface during pilot; the classic --strict guard keeps its 12 block-severity denies.

yonatangross/orchestkit:mods/memory-lens.name: memory-lens
yonatangross/orchestkit:mods/memory-lens.description: Recalls the few memories related to each prompt: one line for the human, one context entry for the model. Local files only, no network on the hot path.

yonatangross/orchestkit:mods/promote-lig.name: promote-lights
yonatangross/orchestkit:mods/promote-lig.description: Shows CI status lights above the prompt while a promote PR (base main) is open. One REST page per minute, PR-open only. Cancelled is not-pass.

yonatangross/orchestkit:mods/secrets-vei.name: secrets-veil
yonatangross/orchestkit:mods/secrets-vei.description: Masks secret values in tool results before the model reads them: named vendor variables, value-shape patterns, and high-entropy tokens. No reveal path.

yonatangross/orchestkit:tests/fixtures/f.name: fn-hooks-canary
yonatangross/orchestkit:tests/fixtures/f.description: Fixture-only plugin. Not shipped, not installed. Pins the Function Hooks module contract so CI notices when upstream moves it (orchestkit#3917).

gabfssilva/skyward:plugins/skyward.name: skyward
gabfssilva/skyward:plugins/skyward.description: Skyward for Claude Code: the `/sky` panel over the daemon's computes, plus skills for the Python SDK and the `sky` CLI.

ShiftinBits/constellation-claude:..name: constellation
ShiftinBits/constellation-claude:..description: Upgrade Claude from text search to code understanding.

tomada1114/tomada-claude-plugins:tomada-.name: my-mod
tomada1114/tomada-claude-plugins:tomada-.description: A band above the prompt. Replace with what your mod actually does.

saadshahd/moo.md:hope.name: hope
saadshahd/moo.md:hope.description: Thinking discipline for AI work. Clarify intent, shape approach, consult experts, guard unsupervised work, hand work back so you own it. The slop hook needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

saadshahd/moo.md:hunch.name: hunch
saadshahd/moo.md:hunch.description: A grab bag of hunches — experimental skills and plugin features tried here before they earn a place in hope or sound. Everything graduates or dies. The tend mod needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

jagreehal/autotel:packages/autotel-claud.name: autotel
jagreehal/autotel:packages/autotel-claud.description: OpenTelemetry for Claude Code plugins: adds $.autotel in the engine.create fold so a plugin records spans, traces every hook dispatch with the chain beneath it, and shows each tool call's settled duration on its row. Exports OTLP/HTTP to OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT (autotel-devtools claude sets it).

hex/claude-sessions:mods/cs.name: cs
hex/claude-sessions:mods/cs.description: cs's in-session mod: the rotate band above the prompt, forced rotation past CS_ROTATE_FORCE_CTX, and the wrap key

hex/claude-sessions:mods/cs-update.name: cs-update
hex/claude-sessions:mods/cs-update.description: Release notes for a pending cs update, once per launch, with 1 to install it in place; /cs-update reopens the pane.

anthropics/claude-plugins-official:plugi.name: code-modernization
anthropics/claude-plugins-official:plugi.description: Guided modernization for any legacy codebase: start with /modernize, get an assessment, an interactive map, the business rules mined from the code, and a plan you approve, then an upgrade, a rewrite or a rebuild with independent proof that the new code behaves like the old. Includes security hardening, a one-page report, specialist agents, and an optional live progress pane (early access).

xtrm-dev/specialists:plugins/specialists.name: specialists
xtrm-dev/specialists:plugins/specialists.description: Specialists execution runtime in Claude Code: specialist activation and dispatch over MCP, session continuity hooks, and the supervising-activations skill. Consumes the Substrate work authority; it is not Substrate.

xtrm-dev/specialists:plugins/specialists.name: specialists-ui
xtrm-dev/specialists:plugins/specialists.description: Teammate-style transcript rows for Specialists in Claude Code: channel wakes, the fallback wake, and Specialists MCP tool calls under native labels. Companion to the specialists plugin, which raises those rows and therefore cannot draw them itself.

r3dbars/transcripted:Tools/TranscriptedL.name: transcripted-live
r3dbars/transcripted:Tools/TranscriptedL.description: The meeting Transcripted is recording, inside Claude Code: Claude gets the call as context, a live dashboard (now, asked of you, action items), prompt suggestions for questions aimed at you, and an after-call wrap-up that gains speaker names once Transcripted saves the meeting. Needs the transcripted-live helper running.

musingfox/cc-plugins:calendar.name: calendar
musingfox/cc-plugins:calendar.description: [Experimental] Upcoming Google Calendar events in-session — /cal toggles a band above the prompt with the next 7 days, /cal N for N days (Claude Mod; needs Claude Code 2.1.287+ and the claude.ai Google Calendar connector)

musingfox/cc-plugins:mermaid-inline.name: mermaid-inline
musingfox/cc-plugins:mermaid-inline.description: [Experimental] Every ```mermaid block Claude writes drawn as plain box art in place in the transcript — flowchart, sequence, class, state and xychart; CJK labels aligned (Claude Mod fork of claude-mermaid; needs Claude Code 2.1.287+)

musingfox/cc-plugins:obsidian-workspace.name: obw
musingfox/cc-plugins:obsidian-workspace.description: Obsidian Workspace — project-scoped vault productivity (capture / notes / PM). Skills own folder layout and templates; /obw:pm splits a spec into blocking tickets; /issue is a Claude Mod pane that lists a view of the project's dashboard, draws Mermaid as text diagrams, and can open a card in the browser through viz. Vault I/O uses the Obsidian CLI via the official obsidian-cli skill.

musingfox/cc-plugins:omp-quota.name: omp-quota
musingfox/cc-plugins:omp-quota.description: [Experimental] Every omp provider's remaining quota in-session — a /quota band above the prompt, /quota refresh, and a toast when a provider worsens from ok (Claude Mod; needs Claude Code 2.1.287+)

bengous/claude-code-plugins:todos.name: todos
bengous/claude-code-plugins:todos.description: Shows the repository's TODOs in a band above the prompt, newest first: TODO.md items and TODO/FIXME/HACK code comments dated with git blame, a Mine filter, issue links, and a toast when an edit adds one

ushironoko/dotfiles:claude/.claude/skill.name: agents-view
ushironoko/dotfiles:claude/.claude/skill.description: A pane listing this session's subagents (Agent tool and workflow agents) with their status; select one to see its prompt, text, tool calls and results.

ushironoko/dotfiles:claude/.claude/skill.name: file-view
ushironoko/dotfiles:claude/.claude/skill.description: Click a file path under a Read, Edit or Write row to show that file's contents in a pane beside the transcript.

ushironoko/dotfiles:claude/.claude/skill.name: pr-view
ushironoko/dotfiles:claude/.claude/skill.description: A pane listing the project root repository's open pull requests with titles; click one to open it in the browser.

thkt/dotclaude:.ja/mods/redact.name: redact
thkt/dotclaude:.ja/mods/redact.description: Read ツールの結果に含まれる認証情報の形をした文字列を、モデルが読む前に伏せる。

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: admin-capability-lockdown
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Organization control mod: withholds the http and process nouns from $ so no plugin beneath it can reach the network or spawn processes, refuses user-tier plugins by name allowlist or by the $ calls their source declares, and withholds the Bash tool (shellPolicy "deny", default) or, in "guardrail" mode, denies well-known network clients as a bypassable speed bump. Hooks engine.create, plugin.register and tool.call; seat it in the managed prepend tier.

2048 above the Claude Code prompt: slide and merge tiles up to 2048. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. A single game split out of cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs an interactive terminal with a mouse.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: cc-arcade
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Games above the Claude Code prompt (snake, Tetris, 2048, Minesweeper, Flappy, Pong, typing test, Space Invaders, Doom) plus a pet that grows as Claude tests, commits and edits. Clones of the genre, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tetris Holding, Taito, Atari or id Software. Needs an interactive terminal.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: chess
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Play chess against Claude (or Jev, when a Jev key is set) in a side pane while you work. Click a piece and a square, or type a move; Claude answers through a fork of the session, Jev through TypeSafe's decision API, and the pane shows the tokens each move cost as the API reported them, and the running total. Docked beside the transcript in the fullscreen layout, above the prompt otherwise.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: diff-invaders
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Space Invaders above the Claude Code prompt where every wave is the code Claude just wrote: each line an Edit or Write added becomes a row of the formation and every two characters one alien, so you shoot your own diff. Ship, one shot at a time, bombs, three lives, best score. Zero tokens. Needs an interactive terminal.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: doom
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Doom above the Claude Code prompt: a corridor shooter: imps, a shotgun, and the floor below. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. A single game split out of cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs an interactive terminal with a mouse.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: flappy
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Flappy above the Claude Code prompt: flap through the gaps in the pipes. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. A single game split out of cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs an interactive terminal with a mouse.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: invaders
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Space Invaders above the Claude Code prompt: shoot each wave before it lands. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. A single game split out of cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs an interactive terminal with a mouse.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: minesweeper
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Minesweeper above the Claude Code prompt: open every cell that is not a mine. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. A single game split out of cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs an interactive terminal with a mouse.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: pacman
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Pac-Man above the Claude Code prompt: a 19×15 maze, four ghosts that chase, scatter and flee, power pellets, three lives and faster levels. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. Needs an interactive terminal.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: pet
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: A virtual pet above the Claude Code prompt that grows as Claude works: passing tests, commits and edits grant XP and mood, failing tests cost mood, idling drains it; egg → baby → kid → adult → legend. Zero tokens. Split out of cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs an interactive terminal.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: pong
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Pong above the Claude Code prompt: first to 5 against the computer. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. A single game split out of cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs an interactive terminal with a mouse.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: snake
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Snake above the Claude Code prompt: eat, grow, and keep off the walls and yourself. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. A single game split out of cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs an interactive terminal with a mouse.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: tetris
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Tetris above the Claude Code prompt: fit the falling pieces and clear lines. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. A single game split out of cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs an interactive terminal with a mouse.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: tool-defense
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: A tower defense above the Claude Code prompt where every enemy is one of Claude's real tool calls: Bash sends runners, an Edit or Write a slow tank, a web or MCP call a flyer, an Agent a boss. Build and upgrade towers by clicking beside the road, hold the base through Claude's turn. Zero tokens. Needs an interactive terminal with a mouse.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: typing-test
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Typing test above the Claude Code prompt: retype a line of code as fast as you can. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. A single game split out of cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs an interactive terminal with a mouse.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: linear-tickets
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Your Linear tickets in a side pane, with their status and a chart of how you are progressing: tickets grouped by state (in progress, todo, backlog, done), a stacked status bar, a bar chart of tickets closed per day over the last two weeks and, when your tickets sit in a cycle, that cycle's scope and completed burn-up. Read-only; it polls Linear's GraphQL API. /linear opens it. Needs a Linear API key.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: neon-branch-per-session
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: A Neon database branch for each Claude Code session: created from your default (or chosen) branch when the session starts, handed to every command Claude runs as DATABASE_URL, and set to expire on its own (or deleted when the session ends). Claude can migrate, seed and break the branch without touching production data. /neon shows it, keeps it or deletes it. Needs a Neon API key.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: vercel-deploys
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Your Vercel projects in a side pane: each connected site with the state of its latest deployment (building, ready, failed), the production domain, the Git commit behind it and whether the site answers right now. It polls Vercel's REST API (faster while something builds) and toasts when a deployment finishes or fails. /vercel opens it. Needs a Vercel access token.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: websearch-to-exa
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Overrides the built-in WebSearch tool and routes queries to the Exa search API through $.http.fetch, answering in WebSearch's own result shape, with automatic fallback to the built-in search. A tool.call hook that replaces a core tool.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: prompt-cache-control
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Prompt-cache meter above the Claude Code prompt: how many tokens each request read from, wrote to and sent past the cache, a live countdown to the cache's expiry, and what to do about it (keep going, compact or clear). The TTL follows Claude Code's own rules for your account (1 hour on a Claude subscription, 5 minutes on an API key, cloud provider or usage credits, plus the TTL variables and setting) and corrects itself from request timing. /cache opens a per-turn table.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: universal-audit-log
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: One hook on * that records every event on $ (tool calls, prompts, turns, other plugins' fs/http/process calls) as JSON lines with origin plugin and tier, duration and outcome, including denials. Buffered and flushed to a JSONL file through $.fs at the end of every turn.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: aitmpl
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: /aitmpl opens a side pane for the aitmpl.com catalog: search box, the site's Browse menu with an icon, colour and count per type, an Installed section (agents, commands, skills and mods found in .claude/ and ~/.claude/), a Popular/Results list with download counts, and view/install on every row. Install runs the fixed CLI argv ($.process.run, validated path, no shell). The catalog is read live through $.http.fetch; browsing costs no tokens.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: jev-model-router
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Picks the model and the reasoning effort for each task with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model reached either through TypeSafe's own API or the Vercel AI Gateway. Routes subagent models at agent.spawn and the main loop's effort and model at turn.step, in both directions, falling back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: jev-skill-suggestion
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Keeps the skill listing out of the context window and lets TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model, pick at most one skill per prompt from the skills' descriptions, the way TypeSafe's skill-suggestion cookbook does: one request ranks every skill and asks whether the prompt needs a skill at all, a second re-reads the top three with their SKILL.md and can reject them all. The winner's SKILL.md is attached to the prompt, so the skills can be hidden from the model altogether (/jev-skill-suggestion:setup makes them user-invocable-only and /context counts them at 0). Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: npm-to-pnpm-rewriter
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Rewrites npm and npx invocations to pnpm (or yarn / bun) before the Bash tool runs them and tells the model what ran through context. A tool.call hook that forwards a modified event (the modifying placement).

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: session-time-machine
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: /timemachine draws the session as a timeline of prompts, tool calls and turn ends from its own transcript. Press a point and give a new instruction: the mod writes a copy of the transcript cut there under a new session id and gives you the `claude --resume` command that continues it, so you can try the other approach without losing this one. Hooks session.start, command.run, turn.complete and ui.render on Pane.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: webfetch-cache
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Short-circuits repeated WebFetch calls for the same URL and prompt within a session, answering { result } from cache without a network round trip. A tool.call hook with TTL and size limits.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: block-destructive-commands
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Denies Bash commands that match destructive patterns (recursive rm on roots, force push, hard reset, destructive SQL, disk formatting) before they run. A tool.call hook with a Bash matcher that returns { deny } without calling next.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: jev-auto-mode
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: A permission layer driven by a JSON policy: allow, ask or deny every tool call (Bash, edits, web, MCP, subagents, skills), every slash command or skill you type, and every skill preloaded into a subagent. Rules decide first (deny > ask > allow, compound Bash commands split); what no rule covers can go to TypeSafe's Jev, which judges the action against your latest request with thresholds you set. Claude can never edit the policy.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: jev-guardrails
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Screens every prompt going into the conversation and every reply coming out of it with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model, the way TypeSafe's guardrails cookbook does: one request per message asks a battery of hazard questions (jailbreak, harm or a crime, a diagnosis or a dosage, self-harm) and scores how much harm complying would do. The thresholds live here, in a named policy (strict or permissive), and turn the probabilities into pass, review (the user is asked), block (the prompt is dropped, or the reply withheld) or support. Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: jev-vercel-sandbox
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: A Vercel Sandbox Claude sends work to on purpose: long test runs in the background, someone else's repository, an installer of unknown origin, a bulk change to preview as a patch, a clean build. TypeSafe's Jev reads each Bash command and spots those jobs; by default you are asked whether it runs in the sandbox or locally (confirmSandbox), or it always goes to the sandbox with the question off. Claude also gets sandbox_run, sandbox_jobs, sandbox_result and sandbox_apply. Each job starts from the project as it is now (tracked files, credentials left out) in its own worktree, every result is marked remote, and a job's changes reach your disk only as a patch you apply after a question. /jev-vercel-sandbox starts it and opens a side pane with the jobs. Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier without a Jev key.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: large-edit-confirmation
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Asks the user, in the engine's AskUserQuestion dialog ($.ui.ask), before Claude edits or overwrites a file larger than a configurable line count; denies by default when nobody can answer (headless runs). A tool.call hook on Edit and Write using $.fs.read.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: protected-paths-guard
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Denies Edit, Write and NotebookEdit calls on sensitive paths (.env files, lockfiles, CI workflows, git internals, private keys) with a glob allowlist override. A tool.call hook with an array matcher.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: secret-redactor
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: Redacts API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys and connection strings from every tool result before the model reads them, notes the redaction through context, and refuses to echo a redacted placeholder back into a Bash command. A tool.call hook in the after placement.

davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.name: agent-flow
davila7/claude-code-templates:cli-tool/c.description: A side pane that draws the session's agent flow live: the main loop's context window, every subagent it spawns as a tree, and for each one the context handed down (its prompt, or the whole parent context for a fork), what it did with it (steps, tools, context size) and the answer it handed back up. Docked beside the transcript in the fullscreen layout, above the prompt otherwise.

ruvnet/ruflo:plugins/ruflo-bbs-federatio.name: ruflo-bbs-federation
ruvnet/ruflo:plugins/ruflo-bbs-federatio.description: AgentBBS cross-host agent federation for ruflo (ADR-164). Phase 1 exposes room coordination — federation_bbs_register / federation_bbs_publish / federation_bbs_watch / federation_bbs_human_join. Phase 2 (v3.40.0) adds signed cross-host federation — federation_bbs_identity (persistent Ed25519 node identity), federation_bbs_peer_add (pin a peer by nodeId + public key), federation_bbs_peers (audit/unpin), federation_bbs_serve (read-only pull endpoint), and federation_bbs_sync (pull pinned peers and union-merge what verifies). Every merged envelope is Ed25519-verified against a pinned key; unsigned/misattributed/oversize/over-hop envelopes are dropped and counted. Transport is HTTP pull and works on any network (Tailscale, LAN, VPN, loopback) — no tailnet required. Coordinates work ownership via claim messages (ClaimIssued/Released/Handoff/Ack). agentbbs lives in optionalDependencies; every handler gracefully degrades to {degraded:true} when the package is missing (ADR-150 pattern). As a mod (ADR-445 pattern): a tighten-only tool guard, a local slash command, and a status file the console shows.

ruvnet/ruflo:plugins/ruflo-browser.name: ruflo-browser

ruvnet/ruflo:plugins/ruflo-business-pods.name: ruflo-business-pods
ruvnet/ruflo:plugins/ruflo-business-pods.description: ADR-164 Phase 2 — business-domain pod templates for the federated business autopilot. Ships the sales pod template (templates/sales.json) and a single-tick runner (scripts/pod-tick.mjs) that pre-flights templates via business_pod_validate, reserves budget through a file-based stub ledger (atomic SQLite tracker is Phase 3 per ADR-164.1), resolves each agent role against ruflo's agent registry, constructs dry-run prompts, and posts an envelope summary to the room via federation_bbs_publish. Dry-run by default — --live is reserved for Phase 3 Managed-Agent + claude-p wiring. As a mod (ADR-445 pattern): a tighten-only tool guard, a local slash command, and a status file the console shows.

ruvnet/ruflo:plugins/ruflo-console.name: ruflo-console
ruvnet/ruflo:plugins/ruflo-console.description: ruflo's cockpit inside Claude Code and the one /ruflo command for every ruflo mod (function hooks, early access). Views: overview with health alerts, swarm topology graph, claims flow with TTL rings, federation map, plugin health matrix, learning curve and pipeline, MetaHarness radar and audit trend, memory, cost gauge, agent timeline, approvals queue, event stream, a main menu, an x.ruv.io federation board, an AI terminal (codex, claude or both in remembered sessions, streamed), Skills (npx skills), a Hive-Mind view, a MetaHarness lab, agent drill-down; a command palette for confirm-gated actions through the ruflo CLI; a band above the prompt. Reads ruflo's files and the CLI's local JSON; anything not measured reads n/a. The one network call it makes by itself is a daily read of the published plugin.json at github.com/ruvnet/ruflo to offer an update (Settings → Updates: ask, auto, or off); it installs only through Claude Code's own claude plugin update, and never a new major version without asking.
